title: Product Manager – Operations Systems (m/f/x)
description:
Ready to become part of the most important mission on this planet? 

We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media, and we are looking for you! Our mission: to make circular living accessible to all, one transaction at a time. By giving products a second chance, we reduce resource consumption and avoid unnecessary e-waste.

Our global team of 500 drives things forward collaboratively, takes personal responsibility, values constructive critical thinking, and is dedicated to serving our customers and planet.

The Role 

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product team and own the internal, backend-heavy products behind our operations. 

Every item rebuy sells has been through our hands. Before a pre-owned book, DVD, or game reaches a customer, it has been bought in, received, identified, tested, graded, stored, picked, packed, and shipped. The systems that run this flow are the focus of this team, and the users are the hundreds of colleagues in our operations teams. 

You will own the tools and services behind inbound processing, grading and quality control, fulfillment, and returns. Your users are warehouse operators, graders, pickers, and operations leads. Your customers are, in the end, every rebuy buyer and seller who relies on the condition and delivery promise we make. 

For this role we need someone who is genuinely detail-oriented, who reads the data before forming an opinion, who understands systems and data flows end-to-end, and who can translate operational reality into precise requirements and measurable outcomes. 

As a Product Manager you work hand in hand with operations leadership, team leads, engineering, and data to deliver measurable efficiency and quality improvements. You will spend time on the floor with the people who use your products, translate their goals and constraints into a roadmap you own, build the business case with unit economics together with operations and finance, and negotiate scope and timing with engineering. Improvements are co-created with the people who run the operation, not handed to them. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Drive domain product roadmap: Translate ops strategy (throughput, unit cost, quality, lead time) into a 6–12 month roadmap with the Strategy Manager and Ops Product Lead. Make and document trade-off decisions with ops leaders 

- Understand operational reality: Spend time at the warehouse mapping processes and data flows end-to-end to uncover system gaps and unmet needs early 

- Drive data-backed decisions: Analyze KPIs, pull data, avoid measurement traps, and connect feature changes to unit economics improvements 

- Write precise requirements: Specify business rules, edge cases, data models, state transitions, integrations, and failure modes for engineering 

- Ship iteratively without disruption: Sequence releases safely using pilots, feature flags, parallel runs, change management, and pre-defined metrics 

- Collaborate across teams: Engage in technical discussions and manage scope, time, and urgency trade-offs with tech and ops leads 

- Build stakeholder buy-in: Align ops, CS, tech, finance, and leadership on shared metrics via clear written communication 

Requirements: 

- 3+ years of experience in product management , with a focus on backend, internal, workflow, or operational products (for example warehouse, logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, order management, inventory, marketplace operations, fintech back-office, or similar) 

- Hands-on data skills : you can work fluently in an analytics environment, build your own analyses, define metrics rigorously, and spot when a number is misleading 

- Strong attention to detail : experience writing precise specifications covering business rules, edge cases, data models, and failure modes, and catching problems before they reach production 

- Systems thinking : you can map a multi-step operational process and the data flowing through it, identify bottlenecks and inconsistencies, and reason about second-order effects of a change 

- Experience collaborating with engineering on technical decisions, including integrations and data migrations, and negotiating scope and time-to-market trade-offs 

- Clear, structured communication skills, written and verbal, with the ability to build buy-in with operations team leads, engineering, and product leadership 

- Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to accelerate daily work such as analysis, writing, and prototyping 

- Fluency in English and German 

Location: 

- Berlin

- Hybrid model (Must be willing to have regular presence at our operations sites located in Rudow)

Purpose, a great company culture and incredible benefits - what to expect at rebuy: 

- Work with a friendly team that is passionate about circularity and wants to make the world a little more sustainable, one transaction at a time.

- Feel comfortable in an environment where independence and new ideas are welcome.

- Benefit from flat hierarchies and the greatest possible transparency so that things don't take longer than they have to and you always feel well informed.

- Use employee discounts on rebuy.de , sustainable products at Futurebens , offers for sustainable micro-mobility and massages directly in our office.

- Have fun at our legendary team and company events.

- Use our mental health offers as part of a cooperation with Nilo . 

- Take care of your work-life balance with 30 vacation days.

*At rebuy all people are welcome and supported! We would like to talk, regardless of age, disability, national and social origin, skin color, religion, gender identity and sexual orientation. Just be who you are.

- Exposure to iPaaS or low-code integration tools (for example, MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or Power Automate).

description:

You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

About the Team

Our Infrastructure teams build the foundation that engineers at Wolt, Deliveroo, and DoorDash build on: the compute, cloud, and networking capabilities that enable Engineering teams to develop, deploy, and run services at global scale. The EU Compute team has a specific focus on provisioning, scaling, and the efficient operation of GPU infrastructure for AI and ML workloads. This is an emerging space with plenty of greenfield opportunities.

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to be a hands-on technical leader for this infrastructure work that crosses team and brand boundaries. You'll set direction for the platform, turn complex problems into deliverable plans, write and review production code, and help other engineers make sound decisions. It's an exciting time to join: we're building a global platform and the choices made now will shape how engineers across the company ship for years.

What you’ll be doing

You'll own some of the hardest infrastructure problems in the company and make the platform easier to operate and safer to build on. We’re determined to build great platform products and user experiences, and you’ll be pivotal in making this reality.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

- Set technical direction for shared AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure, balancing reliability, security, developer experience, and cost.

- Lead substantial initiatives from design through rollout and operation, coordinating dependencies and decisions across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash, focusing on workloads targeting GPUs.

- Evolve Kubernetes clusters, cloud networking, identity, and infrastructure provisioning to support growing and varied workloads.

- Build reusable Terraform patterns and self-service tooling that help teams provision infrastructure safely and consistently.

- Improve deployment and operational practices, including GitOps, observability, capacity planning, incident response and recovery.

- Use production signals and developer feedback to find platform friction, choose where to invest and measure whether changes actually help.

- Assist with supporting the platform, with deep focus on GPU infrastructure, as well as broad focus on compute in general.

- Gracefully sunset legacy infrastructure and tooling, and create strategies to reduce toil.

- Mentor engineers through design reviews, implementation and incidents, raising the quality of infrastructure work across teams.

Our humble expectations

- Deep experience building and operating Kubernetes and AWS infrastructure in production. Familiarity with GPU workloads and orchestration is a plus.

- Strong software engineering skills: you use Go, Python or a similar language to build maintainable tools and automation.

- Experience with infrastructure as code (we use Terraform) and with designing systems that other engineering teams depend on.

- A track record of leading complex technical work across teams, including architectural decisions, delivery, and operational follow-through. You have the breadth to collaborate and design across team and domain boundaries, and the depth to have hands-on impact.

- Strong judgment on trade-offs in distributed systems, networking, security, reliability, and cloud cost.

- Clear communication, and the ability to bring people together around a practical technical direction.

What we offer

- Scope and influence. Shape infrastructure used globally, while staying close to the engineering. Your work will help product teams ship services with greater ease and confidence.

- Real problems at global scale. Multi-cluster Kubernetes, AI / ML workloads, cloud networking, GitOps, and progressive delivery across a global company.

- Autonomy and ownership. Set direction and see it through from design to operation, with the backing of a global engineering organisation spanning Europe and the US.

- Growth. Room to expand your scope, whether through deeper technical leadership or broader cross-domain influence.

- Great people. Work with talented engineers and leaders in a diverse, international environment, mentoring and learning from others.

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. - Experience improving customer-visible reliability and performance across client and backend systems, with practical expertise in observability and production validation.

- A track record of leading consequential technical change across teams through influence rather than reporting authority.

title: Director of Product Design
description:
OUR MISSION 

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE 

We’re looking for a Director of Product Design to lead our design team and help us build the next version of Carwow.

Reporting to the VP of Product, you’ll be a key partner in shaping our product vision and turning it into a great experience for both customers and dealers.

Carwow is a two-sided marketplace. We help people work out what car is right for them, buy their next car and sell their current one. At the same time, we help dealers find customers, source the right stock and sell more cars.

We want these experiences to feel much more connected. Our ambition is to build a car-changing platform that becomes the natural place to go when you’re thinking about changing your car and an increasingly important part of how dealers run their businesses.

That’s the challenge we want this person to help us solve.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

- Shape the experience with us: Work closely with the VP of Product and our Product and Engineering leaders to define what the Carwow experience should become over the next few years.

- Design for both sides of our marketplace: Make sure we deeply understand both customers and dealers. Look for opportunities where making one side of the marketplace better also makes the other stronger.

- Connect the experience: We have great products, but they don’t always feel like one product. You’ll help us connect discovery, buying and selling across web and app, while doing the same for the dealer experience.

- Raise the bar for design: Help us make simpler, more useful and better-designed products. Set a high standard, but stay close enough to the work to help teams reach it.

- Build a great design team: Lead, coach and develop our Product Designers. Hire brilliant people when we need to and create an environment where designers can do the best work of their careers.

- Stay close to the problem: This isn’t a role for someone who wants to manage design from a distance. We want you talking to customers and dealers, reviewing work, challenging thinking and getting involved in our hardest product problems.

- Use data and experimentation: Work with Product and Analytics to understand how our designs perform, test our assumptions and use what we learn to make the experience better.

- Explore what AI makes possible: AI is changing both the products we build and how we build them. We want someone who has used AI in real products and, more importantly, has good judgement about where it genuinely improves the experience and where it doesn’t.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 

- We’re looking for someone who has led Product Design in a strong digital product business and still loves the work itself.

- You’ll have strong product judgement, care deeply about craft and know how to make complicated things feel simple.

- You’ll have experience designing for a marketplace, platform or similarly complex product with very different types of users. You’ll understand that designing for consumers and designing tools that professionals use every day are different challenges, and be comfortable balancing the needs of both.

- You’ll also need to be a great partner to Product and Engineering — able to challenge, listen, bring people together and make the product better.

- Automotive experience isn’t important. We’d much rather find someone who brings a fresh perspective and has helped build products people genuinely love using.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 

- A year from now, we should be able to see and feel the difference.

- We should have a clear, shared vision for the Carwow experience across customers and dealers, with meaningful progress towards making it real.

- Our customer and dealer experiences should feel more connected, and we should be able to point to measurable improvements in the experiences and outcomes that matter most.

- The quality and consistency of our design should be noticeably higher, with a stronger design team doing some of the best work of their careers.

- Most importantly, we should be closer to building a Carwow that customers want to come back to whenever they change their car, and that dealers wouldn’t want to run their business without.

WHY CARWOW? 

- Genuine scale and impact: your work is used by millions of car buyers and sellers

- An AI-forward culture where new tools and workflows are embraced, not resisted — with access to the best tooling available

- A senior, supportive design team that takes craft seriously

- Hybrid working, competitive salary and equity, private healthcare, enhanced parental leave, and a car-buying perk you'd expect from us

Right now it's the opposite: a dealer buys through us, then has to manage collection, payment and resale largely on their own, stitching together workflows across multiple platforms and channels, much of it manual.

For a dealer, speed is money. This team sits across our ambitions to make car changing a seamless journey, this role's job is the handover itself: the operational moment between buying and being ready to sell again. - Contract / Lease Support - Support the Development team in all areas of land / power acquisition and Colocation leasing and contracting, providing cost annexes in the agreed contract form.

- Market Intelligence - Retain current market benchmark costs and reintegrate as-built costs of developments into pre-development modelling and estimates.

- Development Governance & Gateway Approvals - Own cost deliverables, assurance and reporting for Gate 0-2 approvals.

title: Property Manager
description:
About Letly 

Letly is the AI-Native operating company built for the home. We believe the home should be autonomously run and we're building the software that will run all rental properties end-to-end.

Our landlords hand us their most valuable asset, often on a guaranteed rent, so how well a property is run is our product. Property Managers own every property after the tenant moves in: compliance, maintenance, rent, renewals and the relationship with the landlord and tenant.

We've raised a $4m pre-seed and are a small, high-agency team, growing revenue at >100% month-over-month. We're hiring to keep service quality ahead of that growth.

How we manage 

We run portfolios, not inboxes. Every property has an owner who knows its compliance dates, its contractors, its rent position and its tenant by name. Problems get fixed before the landlord or tenant has to chase.

We're honest about what's ours to fix and what isn't. Repairs are triaged on liability and urgency, quoted against evidence and closed out with proof. AI handles the triage, chasing and admin, so a PM's time goes on decisions, contractors and people.

When a guaranteed property sits empty or arrears build, it's our money on the line, so a PM thinks like an owner.

What we're looking for 

- Experience. ~2+ years running a residential lettings portfolio as a property manager, at an agency, BTR operator or block manager.

- Working knowledge of landlord compliance: gas safety, EICR, EPC, smoke and CO alarms, deposit protection, Right to Rent, HMO and selective licensing.

- Up to date on the Renters' Rights Act 2025 and what it changes for possession, rent increases and repairs.

- A track record of managing contractors on cost, quality and turnaround.

- Driven, with an entrepreneurial mindset. You build the process when there isn't one yet, and you want to grow with the business.

Nice to have 

- ARLA Propertymark qualification (or working towards it).

- Experience with Fixflo or similar maintenance tools.

- HMO or guaranteed-rent portfolio experience in London.

How you work 

- Hyper-focus on detail. A missed certificate date or an unprotected deposit is a fine, not a typo.

- Ownership mentality. You own the property's outcome from start to end, without being chased.

- Commercial judgement. You know when to repair, when to replace, and who should pay.

- Communication clarity. Calm and direct with tenants, landlords and contractors, especially when the news is bad.

- AI-Native. You use our tools to cut the admin and spend your time where judgement matters.

Benefits

description:
Our Global Structure 

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Why Deliveroo (part of DoorDash) 

Deliveroo, part of the DoorDash group, is building the leading local commerce platform, connecting consumers, merchants, and couriers in real time. Paris is one of our most strategic and complex markets globally, with unmatched density, brand concentration, and competitive intensity.

As we move towards our 2026 ambition , we are evolving our commercial organisation to match the scale and sophistication required to win in Paris. This includes increased seniority, clearer regional ownership, and stronger execution across Inner and Outer Paris.

The Senior Client Partner – Paris Inner Ouest role is a newly strengthened position, designed to combine strategic partner leadership, regional ownership, and organisation building .

The Role 

As a Senior Client Partner, you'll lead a team of Account Management Lead, Senior Account Manager and Account Manager and you will report to the Regional Director of Paris, part of the Commercial team. The position is based in Paris. 

You are accountable for the growth and performance of strategic brand portfolios across one of Paris' most critical zones. You will act as the senior commercial owner for your territory, ensuring alignment between Paris-wide strategy and local execution. Beyond partner management, this role plays a central part in aligning the organisation to business challenges and ambitions . You will design, lead, and continuously evolve the account management setup to ensure the right level of seniority, coverage, and execution quality across the territory. 

This is a senior leadership role with direct impact on revenue, partner satisfaction, and team development.

Key Responsibilities 

1. Lead Commercial Strategy & Execution Excellence 

- 
Own the end-to-end growth of brand portfolios within your Paris Inner cluster

- 
Ensure 5★ account management standards across the team, with clear portfolio sizing

- 
Build and maintain relationships with senior and C-level stakeholders

- 
Lead contract negotiations, renewals, and upsell strategies

- 
Create and execute joint business plans addressing partner growth, profitability, and operational performance

- 
Act as a trusted advisor, providing insights on Deliveroo capabilities, competitors, and market trends

- 
Responsible for a commercial initiative for Paris : engage team, drive performance and proactively adjust structure, focus, or processes

2. Regional & Portfolio Ownership

- 
Own a zone cluster, defining and executing the strategy to win

- 
Translate Paris-wide and national priorities into clear, actionable regional strategies

- 
Improve Client Value Proposition (CVP) across the territory in collaboration with other commercial departments

3. Talent Development & Succession

- 
Lead and develop a team of up to 10 AMs / SAMs, either directly or through mid-management

- 
Coach and mentor high-potential talent, building a strong internal succession pipeline

4. Cross-Functional Leadership

- 
Partner closely with Operations, Marketing, Product, Strategy, and Finance

- 
Represent your portfolio and organisation in Paris and France leadership forums

- 
Influence roadmap and prioritisation through structured partner and market feedback

What We're Looking For 

Experience 

- 10+ years in commercial, client partnership, or account management roles

- Proven experience managing complex, strategic brand portfolios 

- Demonstrated success leading multi-layered teams in fast-paced environments

- Experience in F&B, Hospitality, Retail, FMCG, or Marketplace businesses preferred

- Strong commercial and financial acumen (P&L understanding)

- Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management skills

- Ability to design and scale organisations and coverage models 

- Data-driven, structured, and execution-focused

- Senior, credible, and resilient leader

- High ownership mindset with a bias for action

- Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving change

- Passionate about people development and raising standards

Life at Deliveroo 

At Deliveroo, you'll work on some of the most complex and impactful challenges in local commerce. We move fast, value ownership, and believe that strong teams build great outcomes.

This role offers significant scope, visibility, and influence in shaping how Deliveroo wins in Paris.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

title: Founding AI Engineer @Plato (backed by Hexa)
description:
⚖️ Who are we 

Plato is building the AI OS for litigation lawyers. 

With AI, the legal industry is on the verge of a major transformation. Litigation lawyers are overwhelmed by complex and repetitive tasks: complex damage calculations, thousands of documents to review, days spent drafting legal documents, and more.

Our mission: Build the leading AI OS for litigation lawyers , enabling professionals to work 5x faster , by putting their whole firm on autopilot.

Plato already supports more than 30 law firms and 1 major insurance company’s legal team, who use our solution daily to manage hundreds of active cases.

Founded in January 2026 by Ben (CEO) and Alexandre (CTO), we are backed by Hexa (formerly eFounders), Europe’s leading startup studio. Hexa has launched over 35 companies, including unicorns such as Front, Aircall, and Spendesk, collectively generating more than €230M in ARR and raising over €750M in funding.

Plato is live with real users, real data and real revenue, solving concrete legal workflows in production. We’re now looking for a Founding AI Engineer to help us turn the latest advances in AI into reliable products used every day by legal professionals.

🎯 Your mission 

You’ll work directly with Alexandre , our CTO, at the intersection of AI, software engineering and product .

Your job is not to do AI research for the sake of research. You’ll experiment with models and approaches, understand what works, and turn the best solutions into reliable production systems .

You'll work on problems such as building agentic workflows, making sense complex legal documents, designing autonomous long-running agents, and improving the quality and reliability of AI-generated outputs.

Responsibilities 

Build AI-powered product features 

- Design and ship AI features used directly by lawyers

- Be at the bleeing edge of the agentic stack: memory, sandboxes, code mode, lots of tools, subagents…

- Turn prototypes and experiments into production-ready feature

Work with complex data 

- Extract, structure and reason over large volumes of unstructured legal documents

- Build robust data and document-processing pipelines

- Experiment with different models and approaches to improve accuracy and reliability

Make AI work in production 

- Evaluate and improve agent outcomes through testing, evals and iteration

- Optimize systems for quality, latency and cost

- Build the backend services and infrastructure needed to run AI reliably at scale

Shape the product

This is a high-autonomy role. You will own several critical workstreams end-to-end — from KYC and entity housekeeping to cap table management and contract administration — and you will be expected to exercise sound judgment, escalate when needed, and drive automation wherever possible.

What you'll do 

1. Cap Table & Share Register 

Own the cap table across different systems with rigor and precision. Record all share movements — issuances, transfers, ESOP/BSPCE, funding rounds. Maintain the legal share register and reconcile against articles, shareholders' agreements, and board minutes. Produce cap table extracts, shareholder lists, and ownership reports for KYC, audit, board packs, and investors — always under NDA and with judgment on what can be disclosed. Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, reconciliation) are essential.

2. Entity Management, Corporate Formalities & Notarisation 

Handle entity creation from incorporation to corporate maintenance across jurisdictions (SAS, Inc, Ltd, Pte, GmbH, etc.) with confidentiality and attention to detail. Manage the annual formalities calendar, board/shareholder minutes, resolutions, powers of attorney, and the entity housekeeping file for each group company. Coordinate notarial formalities — share transfers, capital changes, statutory modifications, pledges. Handle apostilles, legalisation, and certified translations for documents used abroad via the Legal Vision Platform. Maintain up-to-date KYC packs for each entity: Kbis, articles, directors, beneficial ownership, administrative certificates. Respond to inbound KYC requests from banks, clients, and investors. Log every formalité for a complete and auditable record.

3. Insurance & Document Management 

Manage insurance policies, certificates (COIs), and the renewal calendar. Handle COI requests by checking them against contractual requirements and following up with brokers. Keep a register of policies and claims. File and archive documents with naming conventions and versioning in our document management tools. Manage e-signatures (DocuSign). Maintain the contract register with expiry dates and notice periods. Provide up-to-date insurance certificates and policy summaries as part of KYC documentation for each entity.

4. Procurement Contracts 

First-level review of NDAs, order forms, and simple SOWs against Mistral templates, flagging deviations for escalation. Version comparison and clean redlines. Understand the procurement policy to know when legal review is mandatory. Coordinate with Procurement, business teams, and Finance to move deals to signature. Complete supplier onboarding questionnaires (anti-bribery, sanctions, ESG, security) and supplier portals (Ariba, Coupa) as part of the vendor KYC process. Comfortable with tools like Ironclad, Notion, and Slack; keen to automate and reduce manual work.

What you bring 

- 10+ years of experience in a legal field, with a strong preference for corporate law (M&A, banking, funds, or large corporate groups).

- Experience in a law firm (corporate/M&A/banking), investment fund, bank, or a large multinational group (e.g., CAC 40).

- Proven experience with KYC processes, questionnaires, and administrative certificates.

- Strong understanding of confidentiality, data protection (GDPR), and the judgment to know what can and cannot be shared externally.

- Hands-on experience with cap table management tools (Ledgy, Axiocap) or share register administration.

- Familiarity with French corporate law (SAS) and international entity structures (Delaware Inc, UK Ltd, Singapore Pte, German GmbH).

- Experience with contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools and e-signature platforms.

- Exposure to procurement contract review and vendor onboarding.

- Fluent in English and French (both written and spoken). Additional languages are a plus.

title: Account Development Representative - France
description:
Who we are 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 

About the Role 

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. 

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our French EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Paris and London and we offer remote working from France and the United Kingdom.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CET. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. 

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

- You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.

- You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.

- You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.

- You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara’s mission.

- You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will: 

- Drive pipeline through personalised outreach to prospects via phone, emails and LinkedIn

- Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.

- Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling

- Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles

- 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum

- Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales

- Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles

- Excellent communication skills, verbal and written

- Curious and able to ask insightful questions

- A champion of a Growth Mindset

- Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has: 

- Experience in closing-sales roles

- Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)

- Willingness to collaborate and influence in a “win as a team” environment

- Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways

- Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways 

Through Samsara’s ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs’ understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

- ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.

- The next level in the program is ADR II , where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.

- The highest level within our organization is ADR III . These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Please submit an English CV with your application.

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

title: Director of Cybersecurity & IT
description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. 

Are you ready to join us?

Back Market is looking for a Director of Cybersecurity & IT to define and lead the next phase of our security and technology operations maturity. Reporting to the VP of Platform Engineering, you will be a strategic leader at the intersection of cybersecurity, IT, risk, compliance, and business growth.

You will lead a multi-disciplinary organization through its existing functional managers, creating the clarity, operating rhythm, and investment focus needed to protect Back Market while enabling the company to move quickly. The scope includes cybersecurity strategy and risk management, security operations, governance and compliance, IT operations, IT support, and the corporate technology foundations that keep our people productive and our business resilient.

This is a director-level role, not a super-sized operational manager role. You will not be expected to personally own every process or make every technical decision. Your impact will come from setting direction, developing leaders, aligning stakeholders, making sound investment choices, and ensuring that the organization delivers measurable outcomes. You will be the senior voice who makes cybersecurity and IT understandable, actionable, and connected to the business. 

To know more about our engineering teams:

- A video of our VP Platform: https://youtu.be/zvTlw4BNNdc 

- Our company purpose: http://bit.ly/3OsScpl 

- Our engineering blog: https://bit.ly/3ASJNID 

How we work with the existing teams 💚 

The Director sets direction, creates clarity, secures resources, removes organizational obstacles, develops leaders, and ensures that the overall portfolio delivers against agreed outcomes. The functional managers and senior experts retain ownership of day-to-day execution, technical practices, operational processes, and delivery within their domains. The Director creates the conditions for those leaders to succeed and makes sure their work adds up to a coherent company-wide strategy.

Your next missions 👇 

Set the strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities 

- Define and evolve a multi-year Cybersecurity & IT strategy aligned with Back Market's business goals, risk appetite, technology strategy, and growth plans

- Translate that strategy into a focused portfolio of initiatives, with clear outcomes, sequencing, ownership, dependencies, and measures of success

- Own the operating rhythm for the full scope: planning, budgeting, program tracking, KPI and SLA reporting, risk reviews, and executive communication

- Make pragmatic investment and prioritization recommendations, balancing resilience, customer trust, regulatory expectations, employee experience, and engineering velocity

- Establish the governance forums and decision mechanisms needed to keep priorities clear and accountability visible

Lead and grow a high-performing leadership organization 

- Lead through the managers and senior individual contributors responsible for Security Operations, Governance Risk & Compliance, IT Operations Engineering, IT Support, and relevant security engineering or product security capabilities

- Coach, challenge, and develop your leaders, helping them grow their scope, judgment, influence, and ability to build strong teams of their own

- Create clear career paths, succession plans, and development opportunities across the organization

- Build a high-trust environment where teams have genuine ownership, collaborate across boundaries, and are encouraged to improve how work gets done

- Attract and retain exceptional talent, define what great leadership and execution look like, and continuously raise the bar without creating unnecessary bureaucracy

- Ensure that responsibilities, decision rights, and interfaces between the teams are explicit, understood, and respected

Turn cybersecurity into a business enabler 

- Act as a trusted advisor to the VP of Engineering, CTO, Executive Committee, and senior leaders across the business

- Explain complex security, IT, and risk topics in clear business language, including the trade-offs, options, costs, and consequences of different decisions

- Engage with Heads of and cross-functional streams across Back Market to advocate for security and resilience in all areas of the business

- Build alignment rather than relying on authority, and help teams adopt secure and resilient ways of working because they understand the rationale and value

- Partner with Finance and senior technology leadership on investment cases, budget stewardship, vendor strategy, and the value delivered by the portfolio

Steer enterprise cyber risk and trust 

- Own the cyber risk management process at the strategic level, using the GRC framework as the foundation for security decisions and prioritization

- Ensure that material risks, control gaps, exceptions, and remediation plans are visible, understood, and actively managed

- Escalate critical risks when they exceed the organization's risk appetite or require executive arbitration

- Support security compliance efforts across the organization, ensuring alignment and buy-in from peers and key stakeholders across ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, NIS2, and contractual partner requirements

- Partner with the VP Legal and DPO on the company's data privacy strategy, ensuring privacy and security requirements are considered early in business, product, and technology decisions

- Represent Back Market's security maturity and risk posture to investors, auditors, regulators, strategic partners, and major customers

- Serve as the senior escalation point for major or complex security incidents, ensuring the right executive communication, decision-making, learning, and follow-through without displacing the operational ownership of the incident response teams

Enable secure products and resilient technology 

- Partner with Engineering, Product, and other Bureau of Technology directors to ensure security requirements are integrated into product and feature development from the beginning

- Sponsor and evolve Product Security and secure software development lifecycle practices, including security-by-design, threat modeling, appropriate testing, and pragmatic guardrails

- Ensure the security roadmap addresses the most important risks across cloud infrastructure, corporate systems, identity and access, endpoints, applications, data, and third-party services

- Set the expectations for Security Operations across threat intelligence, vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident readiness, risk assessment and project design reviews, fraud support, AI security, and associated SLA and KPI tracking

- Ensure IT Operations and IT Support provide a reliable, scalable, and high-quality experience for Back Makers across our global offices and remote workforce

- Champion automation, standardization, and engineering-led approaches that reduce manual work and improve reliability, while leaving day-to-day technical ownership with the appropriate functional teams

Build security culture and external credibility 

- Foster a security-aware culture through clear communication about the evolving threat landscape, key initiatives, practical expectations, and the role every Back Maker plays in protecting the company

- Sponsor awareness, education, and Security Champion programs that make secure behavior accessible and relevant to different audiences

- Represent Back Market in relevant security communities, industry groups, partner forums, and regulatory conversations

- Build trusted relationships with strategic technology partners, auditors, insurers, and external security providers

- Help Back Market demonstrate that strong security, responsible technology, and business agility reinforce one another

You could be a good fit if you've: 

- A proven track record of building, scaling, and developing organizations that span multiple security and/or IT domains

- 12 to 15+ years of experience across cybersecurity, information security, IT, or related technology leadership roles, including at least 5 years leading managers and multi-team organizations

- Experience operating as a strategic partner to a CTO, VP Engineering, executive committee, or equivalent senior leadership group

- Proven expertise and a solid grasp of the domains listed below: security operations, cyber risk and governance, compliance and assurance, security architecture, product security, cloud security, IT operations, or corporate technology

- Demonstrated ability to turn business strategy and risk appetite into a practical security and IT roadmap, investment plan, and operating model

- Experience communicating security and technology risk to executive, board-level, investor, partner, audit, and non-technical audiences

- A mature, risk-based approach. You understand that perfect security does not exist, and that good leadership means making explicit, informed trade-offs and focusing resources where they have the greatest impact

- Experience leading through managers and senior experts, with a genuine passion for developing people, building leadership capability, and creating meaningful career paths

- Strong understanding of modern cloud, SaaS, identity, endpoint, application, data, and infrastructure security concepts, even if you are not the deepest technical expert in every domain

- Experience with security-by-design, secure software development lifecycle practices, and effective partnership with Engineering and Product teams

- Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to make complex topics clear, concrete, and compelling. French is a plus

- The judgment, calm, and influence required to operate effectively in ambiguity, during incidents, and across competing stakeholder priorities

- Genuine excitement about Back Market's mission and the belief that cybersecurity and IT are essential enablers of sustainable growth

Nice to have 

- A recognized certification such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, CCSP, or an equivalent professional qualification

- Experience with ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, NIS2, or other relevant European regulatory and assurance frameworks

- Experience with GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, modern cloud-native security tooling, or SaaS-first environments

- Experience in marketplace, e-commerce, fintech, or another business with meaningful customer, partner, or regulatory trust requirements

- Experience with AI security, fraud prevention, third-party risk, or software supply chain security

- Experience working in a fast-growing, international organization with distributed

Hiring process

- Deep-dive interview on Leadership and management with your future manager, the VP of Engineering - 60 min

- Stakeholder interview with cross-functional partners, including the CTO and relevant Security and IT leaders - 60 min 

- Cultural and Values interview with a C-level leader from Back Market - 45 min

title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer, Internship
description:
Le poste 

Les Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSE) travaillent directement avec les clients afin de comprendre rapidement leurs problèmes les plus importants et ainsi concevoir et implémenter des solutions qui vont utiliser leurs données afin de résoudre ces problématiques. Nos clients s’appuient sur les plateformes de Palantir pour certaines de leurs opérations les plus critiques, et les projets débutent souvent par une question ouverte, par exemple : « Comment évaluer le risque d’incendie de forêt et, par conséquent, comment optimiser le réseau électrique ? » ou « Comment évaluer rapidement notre chaîne d’approvisionnement alimentaire et l’adapter afin d’apporter à temps une aide vitale ? » En tant que FDSE, vous appliquez votre capacité à résoudre les problèmes, votre créativité et vos compétences techniques pour aider les organisations à exploiter au mieux leurs données et avoir ainsi un impact réel sur le monde. Vous avez l’opportunité d’obtenir des informations rares et de contribuer à certaines des industries et institutions les plus importantes au monde.

Responsabilités principales 

En tant que stagiaire chez FDSE, vos responsabilités s’apparentent à celles que l’on trouve dans une petite start-up, tout en bénéficiant des ressources, de la stabilité et de l’accompagnement d’une entreprise technologique bien établie. Vous travaillerez en petites équipes avec une supervision minimale et serez responsable de l’exécution de bout en bout de projets à enjeux élevés. Votre journée peut consister à discuter de l’architecture avec d’autres ingénieurs, à gérer des données à grande échelle, à coder une application web personnalisée, à discuter avec l’équipe dirigeante du client ou à établir une stratégie pour votre équipe.

Les stagiaires FDSE sont traités exactement comme des ingénieurs à temps plein, et bénéficient d’une grande liberté et d’une grande autonomie dans leur travail. Ils assument la responsabilité des projets et des résultats réels sur lesquels nos clients comptent.

Nos principes: 

- Impact : nous gérons des projets significatifs et enthousiasmants qui rendent le monde meilleur.

- Responsabilité : nous menons nos projets du début à la fin, en surmontant tous les obstacles que nous pourrions rencontrer. Nous nous faisons mutuellement confiance afin de gérer efficacement le temps et les priorités et donner aux individus l’espace nécessaire pour réfléchir par eux-mêmes.

- Collaboration : nous travaillons en interne avec des personnes d’horizons variés, tels que d’autres FDSE, des équipes Produits et des Deployment Strategists. Nous travaillons également en externe avec nos clients, souvent sur site, afin de comprendre et de répondre à leurs problèmes.

- Développement : nous pensons que l’apprentissage par l’expérience est l’une des meilleures écoles et nous nous encourageons nous-mêmes tout comme nos pairs à rechercher de nouveaux défis et de nouvelles opportunités de croissance, ainsi qu’à trouver de nouvelles façons d’innover et de partager les connaissances.

Le profil recherché 

- Propension et intérêt à se déplacer sur les sites client en fonction des besoins. Capacité de passer 25 à 50 % du temps en déplacement de préférence, mais les exigences peuvent varier selon l’équipe et l’emplacement.

- Capacité démontrée à apprendre continuellement, à travailler de manière autonome et à prendre des décisions avec un minimum de direction.

- Capacité à collaborer avec des équipes de personnes techniques et non techniques, et à être à l’aise pour travailler dans un environnement en évolution constante avec des objectifs dynamiques et des itérations avec les utilisateurs.

- Volonté de résoudre de façon créative les problèmes techniques liés aux structures de données, aux systèmes de stockage, à l’infrastructure cloud, aux frameworks front-end et à d’autres outils techniques.

- Intérêt à travailler avec des données à grande échelle et à les utiliser pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels importants.

Les exigences 

- Expérience en ingénierie, de préférence dans des domaines tels que l’informatique, les mathématiques, le Software Engineering, la physique et la science des données.

- Maîtrise de langages de programmation tels que Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript ou similaire.

- Vous devez prévoir d’obtenir votre diplôme en 2027. Il doit s’agir de votre dernier stage avant d’obtenir votre diplôme.

Pour postuler, veuillez soumettre ce qui suit : 

- Un CV à jour

- Des réponses réfléchies à nos questions de candidature

Date limite de l’offre 

Afin de renforcer la transparence de notre processus de recrutement, nous aimerions vous faire part de nos attentes concernant la date limite de l’offre. En postulant à ce poste, vous vous engagez à confirmer votre décision dans les deux semaines suivant la réception de votre offre écrite.

La vie chez Palantir 

Nous tenons à ce que chaque Palantirien(ne) atteigne son meilleur potentiel, c’est pourquoi nous célébrons les forces, les compétences et les intérêts des individus, de votre premier entretien à votre croissance à long terme, plutôt que de nous appuyer sur les échelles de carrière traditionnelles. L’attention portée aux besoins de notre communauté nous permet d’optimiser nos possibilités de croissance et contribue à garantir de nombreuses voies de réussite chez Palantir. Promouvoir la santé et le bien-être dans tous les domaines de la vie des Palantiriens n’est que l’une des façons dont nous investissons dans notre communauté. Apprenez-en davantage sur la vie chez Palantir et notez que nos offres peuvent varier selon les régions.

Conformément aux valeurs et à la culture de Palantir, nous estimons que les employés sont « meilleurs ensemble » et que le travail en présentiel permet d’obtenir des résultats plus créatifs. En conséquence, nous encourageons les employés à travailler depuis nos bureaux pour favoriser la connectivité et l’innovation. De nombreuses équipes proposent des options hybrides (télétravail un jour ou deux par semaine), ce qui permet à nos employés de trouver le bon compromis pour leur productivité personnelle. En fonction des besoins de l’entreprise, il existe quelques postes qui permettent de travailler « à distance » de manière exceptionnelle. Si vous postulez à l’un de ces postes, vous devez travailler depuis la ville et/ou le pays dans lequel vous êtes employé(e). Si le poste précise « sur site », vous devez travailler depuis un bureau.

Si vous souhaitez donner aux organisations les plus importantes au monde les moyens d’agir, votre place est ici. Palantir valorise l’excellence, d’où qu’elle vienne. Nous nous engageons à rendre le processus de candidature et d’embauche accessible à tous et offrirons des aménagements raisonnables aux personnes vivant en situation de handicap. Si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement pour le processus de candidature ou d’embauche, veuillez et nous indiquer comment nous pouvons vous aider.

Attention : il ne vous sera jamais demandé d’envoyer un paiement ou de partager des données financières pour participer à notre processus d’entretien. Si vous pensez avoir été contacté par un escroc, nous vous conseillons de cesser toute communication avec la personne et d’envisager de la signaler aux autorités compétentes, telles que l’ Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3) du FBI aux États-Unis. 

A World-Changing Company 

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role 

Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions to use data against them. Our customers rely on Palantir’s platforms for some of their most critical operations, and projects often start with an open-ended question like, "How do we evaluate wildfire risk and optimise a power grid as a result" or "How do we quickly assess our food supply chain and modify it to deliver life saving assistance on time?" As an FDSE, you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organisations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the world’s most important industries and institutions. 

Core Responsibilities 

As an FDSE Intern, your responsibilities look similar to those at a small startup, with the resources, stability and mentorship of an established tech company. You’ll work in small teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. Your day might span discussing architecture with fellow engineers, wrangling massive-scale data, coding a custom web app, speaking with customer executives, or establishing strategy for your team.

FDSE Interns are treated just like full time engineers, with significant freedom and ownership over their work. Interns take responsibility for real world projects and outcomes that our customers rely on.

Our Principles: 

- 
Impact: We address meaningful and exciting projects that change the world for the better.

- 
Ownership: We see projects through from beginning to end, working through any obstacles we may encounter. We trust each other to effectively handle time and priorities and give people the space to think for themselves.

- 
Collaboration: We work internally with people from a variety of backgrounds — such as other FDSEs, product teams, and Deployment Strategists. We also work externally with our customers, often on site, to understand and tackle their problems.

- 
Growth: We believe experiential learning is one of the best teachers and encourage ourselves and our peers to seek new challenges and opportunities for growth, as well as find new ways to innovate and share knowledge.

What We Value 

- 
Willingness and interest to travel as needed to client sites. Ability to travel 25-50% preferred, but requirements vary by team and location.

- 
Ability to continuously learn, work independently, and make decisions with minimal direction.

- 
Ability to collaborate in teams of technical and non-technical individuals, and comfortable working in a constantly evolving environment with dynamic objectives and iteration with users.

- 
An eagerness to creatively solve technical problems with data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and other technical tools.

- 
Interest in working with and using large scale data to solve valuable business problems.

What We Require 

- 
Engineering background, preferred in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, and Data Science.

- 
Proficiency with one or more programming languages, such as Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar.

- 
Must be planning on graduating in 2027. This should be your final internship before graduating.

To apply, please submit the following: 

- 
An updated resume / CV

- 
Thoughtful responses to our application questions

Offer Deadline 

In an effort to build more transparency into our recruitment process, we’d like to share our offer deadline expectations. By applying to this position, you commit to confirming your decision within two weeks of receiving your written offer.

Life at Palantir 

We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and n

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers. 

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.

As a certified B Corp , we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries —from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.

We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn , backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

As Senior Product Manager in our Pro Business Unit, you'll own the mid-market product line end to end. You'll lead a "pod" - a small, cross-functional team of a PM or designer, and 2-3 full-stack engineers - through the whole cycle: identifying the problem, shaping the solution, building it, shipping it, and measuring the result. You're the single point of accountability for that team.
The role blends product management, product design, and engineering judgment, all supported by AI tools. So we welcome candidates from a PM, design, or engineering background, as long as you're comfortable working across all three.
You'll report into the Product Engineering director within the BU, alongside other pods led by senior PMs, designers, or engineering managers.

Your impact at Brevo: 

- Gather client signals and usage data and translate them into clearly defined problems, then shape the pitch — appetite, solution, risks and no-gos — and defend it at the betting table.

- Act as the pod's sole design reference: frame the user experience, make interaction and interface decisions, and create prototypes in line with our Naos design system leveraging Claude or our in-house prototyping tool.

- Run the build cycle against the pitch, using lightweight written status artefacts rather than recurring status meetings, and adjust scope rather than extend timelines.

- Agree on one or two measurable outcomes before the build begins, then deliver a clear post-launch verdict: continue, adjust, or discontinue.

- Own the launch: run the beta programme, equip PMM for go-to-market, and get Sales, CSM and Support ready ahead of release.

- Be the pod's single point of contact for the wider BU — surfacing risks early, coordinating with peer Pod Leaders, and applying AI tools by default across discovery, prototyping and analysis.

Who you are: 

- You have a relevant background as a PM or Product Designer, or Lead Engineer — no single track is preferred.

- You can own an experience end-to-end: framing user problems, making interface/interaction decisions, and producing or validating prototypes (Figma and design-system literacy required).

- You have a go-getter, get-things-done mentality: you take initiative, push through ambiguity, and drive things to completion rather than waiting to be told.

- You can write and defend a complete pitch: problem, appetite, sketch, rabbit holes, no-gos and success metrics.

- You have a track record of shipping against a committed appetite using lightweight, async cadence artefacts (e.g. hill charts) rather than heavyweight Scrum rituals.

- You're comfortable pulling and interpreting usage data (Amplitude, funnel, retention) and running discovery interviews to turn signals into problem statements.

- You're tech-credible: comfortable reading AI-generated code and partnering with a Lead Engineer on trade-offs — and you integrate AI tools by default into your day-to-day work, with a critical validation step on their outputs.

- You are fluent in English and in French

Why people love working at Brevo: 

- 
A place to grow together: Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighborhood.

- 
Practical perks for everyday balance : RTT days off, 50% public transport reimbursement, Sustainable Mobility Package, and daily Swile meal vouchers (€12.50/day).

- 
Learning, every step of the way : Access to English classes and 155,000+ courses on Udemy, plus a strong internal culture of knowledge-sharing and support.

- 
Flexible for life : A remote-friendly setup, budget to support your home workspace, and relocation assistance for international talents.

- 
Wellbeing that works : Top-notch private healthcare (70% covered), 6-week second-parent leave, extra time off if your child is sick, and several services related to prevention, health, and personal and professional wellbeing on the Welii platform.

- 
A culture that cares : From inter-office trips to regular team events, there are plenty of ways to connect beyond your day-to-day. You'll also find active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ communities, plus Work Council benefits via Leeto.

Our candidate journey: 

- Introductory TA call (30 min)

- Interview with our Head of Product Engineering (60 min)

- Live Use case (1 hour)

- Final interview with the General Manager of the BU Pro (30 min)

Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Product Manager
description:
Wanna join the adventure? 

At Loft, we are convinced that space programs should not have to be rebuilt from scratch every time. Our philosophy has been to productize them: we develop our own proprietary technology blocks, hardware and software, so that a customer payload can be integrated faster and more reliably than any bespoke program allows. That approach has delivered — it is why our customers reach orbit in months rather than years, and it is what makes working here different from working in the rest of the industry.

We are now taking the next step: launching and operating our own constellations, and building a new set of services on top of them. That includes a full product suite enabling third-party AI applications to run directly onboard our satellites, and a growing ecosystem of partners whose needs we have to understand and design for. Loft is expanding at a very high pace, and the range of what we build is expanding just as fast.

This is why Product Management matters so much here. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company.

You will need to be comfortable talking to anyone here. In the same week you might sit with a system engineer to understand a design constraint, join a BD call with an institutional customer, and present a recommendation to the executive team. Ideas at Loft get discussed openly and on their merits, wherever they come from, so being able to ask a naive question without ego — and to disagree with someone senior without making it personal — matters more than seniority.

About this role: 
Understand what is possible, and turn it into requirements 

- Spend the bulk of your time with engineering: understanding architectures, constraints, and dependencies well enough to judge what is realistically doable in a given timeframe.

- Translate strategic direction into clear requirements and use cases that engineering can act on directly, and follow them down to the Jira tickets.

- Surface and shape the good ideas that come from engineering — many of the best ones do — and connect them to a product rationale.

- Define success criteria for each capability, and verify they are actually met through implementation and delivery.

- Maintain an accurate, shared view of Loft's product capabilities, what is in development, and where the gaps are.

- Run customer discovery interviews alongside business development, and debrief missions to see how Loft's capabilities are actually used in operations.

- Engage directly with the partners building on our platform, including the onboard AI application ecosystem, to understand their needs and constraints.

- Track market trends and competitive moves closely enough to know where our offering stands.

- Own the roadmap for your perimeter, reconciling customer needs, engineering reality, and Loft's strategy into a single coherent plan.

- Build the analysis behind every recommendation — sizing, segmentation, business cases, operational data — so decisions are grounded in evidence rather than intuition alone.

- Negotiate scope and delivery commitments with engineering leadership, and re-plan when capacity or mission timelines shift.

- Challenge, constructively and with data, business development, engineering leadership, and your own assumptions.

Communicate 

- Own internal communication on your perimeter: keep engineering, program leadership, and executives working from the same technical reality.

- Develop the technical narratives and proof points that marketing and BD then turn into their own customer-facing material.

- Prepare recommendations and presentations for top-executive-level audiences.

Must Haves: 

- 7+ years of professional experience, including hands-on product management.

- Domain experience in at least one of: earth observation, embedded systems, aerospace systems, security & defense.

- Comfort at both ends of the spectrum — understand the market, and the technology

- Structured and data-driven: you bring your experience and your intuitions, but when you put a recommendation on the table you can show the analysis it stands on.

- Real product obsession: you think about the bigger picture and product-market fit before you think about features.

- Relentless curiosity. In a single month you might move from a satellite bus constraint, to onboard AI inference, to a defense accreditation requirement — and you need to find that stimulating rather than exhausting.

- High autonomy and a bias for action: handed a broad perimeter, you organize it yourself and come back with a plan.

title: Account Executive - Financial Services
description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision 

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane 

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 300,000 TPE/PME et plus de 8000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

Le compte professionnel représente un enjeu central dans la stratégie de Pennylane :

- Pour ses clients : Assurer le meilleur service possible en intégrant le compte professionnel directement dans leur outil de gestion/compta, assurant la possibilité de gérer l’entièreté de leur activité depuis 1 seul et même outil : Pennylane

- Pour Pennylane : Faire grossir la part des Financial Services dans le revenu global de Pennylane.

C’est pourquoi nous créons une équipe dédiée sur ce périmètre.

- Transformer tous les utilisateurs en utilisateurs du compte pro Pennylane,

- Faire des financial services un des principaux leviers de croissance de Pennylane.

- Part des Financial Services dans le revenu de Pennylane : x2,3

2027

L’équipe AE Financial Services - SME a pour mission de transformer les TPEs (0-9 employés) clientes de Pennylane, en titulaires et utilisatrices d’un Compte Professionnel intégré à leur outil, leur permettant de gérer depuis Pennylane leurs achats (paiements fournisseurs, notes de frais, cartes bancaires, dépenses online) et vente (réception des paiements clients).
