title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-doctorant en vision et apprentissage : Détection automatique de défauts thermiques dans des prises de vues intérieures de façades pour l’aide au diagnostic de qualité des bâtiments
description:
Présentation de l’Ecole et du laboratoire 

Créée en 1857, l’École Centrale de Lyon figure parmi le top 10 des écoles d'ingénieurs en France. Elle forme plus de 3 000 élèves de 50 nationalités différentes sur ses campus d'Écully et de Saint-Étienne (ENISE, école interne) : ingénieurs généralistes, ingénieurs de spécialités, masters et doctorants. Avec le Groupe des Écoles Centrale, elle dispose de 3 implantations à l’international. La formation dispensée bénéficie de l’excellence de la recherche des 6 laboratoires labellisés CNRS présents sur ses campus, des 2 laboratoires à l’international, des 6 réseaux de recherche internationaux et des 10 laboratoires communs avec des entreprises. Sa recherche d’excellence et son enseignement de très haut niveau lui permettent de nouer des accords de doubles diplômes avec des universités prestigieuses et des partenariats de pointe avec de nombreuses entreprises. Autour des thématiques de sobriété, d’énergie, d’environnement et de décarbonation, Centrale Lyon entend répondre aux problématiques des acteurs socio-économiques sur les grandes transitions.

Ce projet de recherche sera mené au sein du Laboratoire LIRIS (UMR 5205), et en particulier de l’équipe Imagine dont les travaux visent notamment à développer de nouveaux modèles d’apprentissage et de vision pour l’analyse et la compréhension de données visuelles telles que les images et vidéos.

Présentation de la thématique : 

Cette mission s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet Therm_I_Bat associant le LIRIS à l’entreprise CMDL Manaslut Ing. et dont l’objectif est de proposer de nouvelles méthodes d’IA et de Vision par Ordinateurs pour la détection automatique de défauts thermiques dans des prises de vues intérieures de façades pour l’aide au diagnostic de qualité des bâtiments.

Description de la mission 

La performance énergétique réelle des bâtiments neufs ou rénovés reste souvent en deçà des performances visées en conception, créant un « energy gap » qui freine la décarbonation du secteur. CMDL a développé une solution robotisée capable de réaliser des campagnes de mesures exhaustives (thermographie infrarouge et images RGB) sur des plateaux de bureaux, logements ou usines d’environ 5 000 m² en une nuit. Cependant, aujourd’hui, le traitement est opéré par un expert sur un nombre restreint de fichiers. La multiplication du nombre de fichiers ne permet pas d’imaginer la mobilisation de l’expert, et seul un traitement automatisé sur la base d’un apprentissage du type Intelligence Artificielle est envisageable.

Le projet THERM_I_BAT vise à concevoir et valider une preuve de concept de diagnostic intelligent des façades de bâtiments, à partir de prises de vues intérieures réalisées par une plateforme robotisée.

Scientifiquement, le projet s’inscrit dans les travaux de recherche et R&D sur l’analyse d’images multimodales et l’apprentissage frugal, en développant de nouveaux modèles d’IA capables de fonctionner avec des jeux de données limités mais fortement contextualisés. Industriellement, il prépare une solution de diagnostic automatisé de la qualité d’enveloppe, compatible avec les outils de la filière (BIM, jumeau numérique) et économiquement acceptable pour un déploiement massif à la réception des bâtiments.

Le planning envisagé est le suivant :

Phase 1 – Acquisition et préparation des données (M1–M12) 

• Définition des protocoles de mesure avec CMDL (typologies de bâtiments, scénarios de défauts).

• Réalisation de campagnes de mesures robotisées (IR + RGB) sur plusieurs sites pilotes.

• Constitution d’un jeu de données annoté (défauts, zones saines, contexte BIM).

Phase 2 – Contextualisation spatiale et fusion multimodale (M3–M5) 

• Alignement spatial des images IR et RGB, prise en compte de la géométrie des façades.

• Développement de méthodes de fusion multimodale pour produire des représentations conjointes robustes.

Phase 3 – Segmentation sémantique et filtrage des perturbations (M6–M9) 

• Développement de modèles de segmentation sémantique pour distinguer les zones pertinentes (parois, menuiseries, éléments techniques) des perturbations (mobilier, objets, reflets).

• Intégration de connaissances expertes CMDL pour guider les classes et les règles de filtrage.

Phase 4 – Détection d’anomalies et classification des défauts (M10–M16) 

• Mise en place de modèles de détection d’anomalies thermiques et de classification des défauts (ponts thermiques, défauts d’étanchéité à l’air, artefacts liés aux matériaux).

• Apprentissage frugal à partir de jeux de données limités, complétés éventuellement par des données simulées.

Phase 5 – Génération du diagnostic et validation en environnement pertinent (M16–M18) 

• Génération automatique de diagnostics structurés (liste de défauts, typologie, sévérité) et localisation dans le plan/BIM.

• Campagnes de validation sur de nouveaux bâtiments, comparaison avec l’analyse d’experts humains (temps, précision, taux de faux positifs/faux négatifs).

• Consolidation de la preuve de concept (TRL 5) et préparation des suites de valorisation.

Profil recherché / Compétences attendues 

Diplômes : Doctorat en Informatique 

Connaissances requises : Vision par Ordinateurs, Apprentissage automatique, Apprentissage profond 

Compétences opérationnelles : Bonne maîtrise du langage Python et de librairies d’apprentissage profond telles que PyTorch, de l’anglais, et bonnes qualités rédactionnelles et de communication orale 

Compétences comportementales : Motivation, rigueur, autonomie, proactivité. 

Le processus de recrutement se déroule en deux étapes, supervisé par une commission de recrutement, en conformité avec la politique OTMR de Centrale Lyon . 

· Étude du dossier écrit : CV + lettre de motivation + diplôme de doctorat

· Entretien de sélection : en présentiel ou en visioconférence

Each year, 140M children are born. Birth defects affect 1 in 33 births in developed countries, and in 50% of cases, they are not detected during prenatal examinations. Prenatal medicine is particularly complex, and the scans impose heavy responsibilities on healthcare professionals. They can also be a source of stress for future parents.

title: Ingénieur Patrimonial - Stage (Juillet 2027)
description:
Qu'est-ce que Finary ? 

Notre mission est de transformer la façon dont l'argent peut travailler pour vous. Nous construisons le one-stop-shop de l'investissement, où vous pouvez suivre votre patrimoine, gérer votre budget, investir et apprendre, afin de redonner le pouvoir aux investisseurs. Mounir a lancé Finary en 2021, et nous avons depuis franchi le cap du million d'utilisateurs. Nous livrons des produits à la pointe, avec ces petites attentions qui font la différence, et nous accordons une grande importance à l'expérience, à la performance et à la simplicité d'usage.

Pourquoi maintenant ? 

Une nouvelle génération d'investisseurs émerge : ambitieuse et impliquée. L'argent n'est plus tabou, et le système de retraite est soumis à une pression énorme. Nous imaginons un monde dans lequel investir permet à chacun de vivre la vie dont il a toujours rêvé. Pour porter cette ambition, nous avons levé 25 M€ en Série B en septembre 2025, soutenue par PayPal Ventures, Hedosophia, Y Combinator et Speedinvest, aux côtés de fondateurs et d'opérateurs de classe mondiale comme Steve Anavi et Alexandre Prot (Qonto), Matthieu Rouif (Photoroom), Eric Demuth (Bitpanda), Axel Weber (ancien président d'UBS) et Harsh Sinha (CTO de Wise). Et depuis juillet 2026, nous sommes l'un des très rares acteurs français à détenir à la fois un agrément d'Entreprise d'Investissement et un agrément MiCA, délivrés par l'AMF. Il n'y a jamais eu de moment plus stimulant pour nous rejoindre.

Ce que nous offrons 

Nous recrutons des personnes qui élèvent le niveau de l'équipe : des A-players aussi bienveillants qu'exigeants. Nous avançons vite, nous visons haut et nous considérons l'ownership comme une évidence. Notre culture est directe, transparente et fondée sur les principes de radical candor et du lean management . Cet environnement correspond aux personnes qui aiment repousser leurs limites chaque jour.

Nous sommes convaincus que la maîtrise de l'IA est la compétence la plus importante de la décennie à venir, et c'est une véritable exigence ici, pas un simple mot à la mode. Chez Finary, chacun a repensé sa façon de travailler autour de l'IA. C'est le premier réflexe, pas une expérimentation annexe. 

Pour en savoir plus sur nos valeurs : About Finary 

Ce qui vous attend 

- Une équipe ultra-performante : travaillez avec des A-players dans chaque domaine, dans un environnement qui vous challenge et vous aide à progresser vite.

- De l'ownership dès le premier jour : liberté, responsabilité et confiance. 

- Un impact qui compte : construisez un produit qui aide les gens à prendre en main leur avenir financier.

- Un mode hybride : des coéquipiers partout en France et en Europe, qui se retrouvent en personne à Paris quatre fois par an.

A propos de Finary One

L'offre Finary One accompagne ses clients sur leurs enjeux patrimoniaux les plus complexes (protection, transmission, structuration, fiscalité) avec une approche indépendante, rigoureuse et centrée sur les besoins du client, et en synergie avec ses conseils juridiques.

Nous recherchons un·e stagiaire en ingénierie patrimoniale (6 mois, démarrage juillet 2027) pour intervenir sur trois volets : le suivi des dossiers clients, la veille juridique et fiscale, et la conception d'outils patrimoniaux next gen .

Missions

Produit & innovation

- Contribuer à la rédaction de scripts vidéos/podcast/articles portant sur des thématiques d’ingénierie patrimoniale

- Faire remonter les besoins terrain aux équipes produit et tech pour améliorer en continu les outils

- Participer à l'intégration de l'IA dans les processus d'ingénierie patrimoniale

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

- Rejoindre un acteur de référence : Intégrer l'un des principaux acteurs de la gestion de patrimoine digitalisée en France, positionné pour devenir la référence du secteur

- Outils modernes et IA : Travailler au quotidien avec des outils technologiques de pointe, notamment basés sur l'intelligence artificielle

title: Product ML Engineer
description:
About us 

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

Role Summary

We're looking for a Product ML Engineer to join one of our product experience teams — SMB, Scaler or Enterprise — and own the ML side of short, high-impact projects.

You'll work on focused ML problems with a clear product outcome, sometimes fine-tuning one of our models, sometimes integrating the best externally available model, but always choosing the fastest and most effective path to customer value.

You'll bring the technical depth of an Applied Scientist while operating with the pace and pragmatism of a product engineer. You'll own the journey from framing the problem through to shipping, measuring and iterating on the feature in production.

This is not a research role. Your time horizon is weeks rather than quarters, and success is measured by what reaches users and the impact it creates.

About the role

- Embed directly within a product team. Work closely with the SMB, Scaler or Enterprise team on focused ML problems tied to clear customer and business outcomes.

- Own ML projects end to end. Frame the problem, choose the approach, execute the plan, ship the feature and monitor its performance in production.

- Make the build vs. buy decision. Determine when to fine-tune or build a model yourself versus integrating an external model, API or existing library.

- Move from idea to production quickly. Work on projects scoped in weeks rather than quarters, prioritising rapid iteration and customer impact.

- Work closely with the ML team. Leverage shared infrastructure, evaluation tooling and expertise while remaining embedded in the product team's priorities and cadence.

- Stay close to users. Get rapid feedback from customers, monitor how people use what you've shipped and use those insights to drive the next iteration.

- Balance technical depth with pragmatism. Know when deeper modelling work is necessary and when an existing solution is already good enough to ship.

- Write production code. Work directly in the product team's codebase rather than operating primarily through research notebooks and experiments.

- Own quality in production. Build sound evaluations, monitor performance and investigate failures once the feature is live.

About You

- You've shipped ML into production. You have 2+ years of hands-on experience building and shipping ML-powered products, with strong experience in PyTorch or equivalent frameworks such as TensorFlow or JAX.

- You have applied-science depth. You can fine-tune vision or diffusion models, design meaningful evaluations and debug training runs when necessary.

- You're a pragmatic builder. You care about solving the customer's problem rather than proving that your own model is the best approach. You'll happily use an external model, API or existing library when that's the fastest route to value.

- You're product-minded. You measure success through shipped features, user behaviour and business outcomes rather than papers or benchmarks alone.

- You're comfortable in production codebases. You can move between experimentation and production engineering, writing maintainable code that lives inside a real product.

- You have strong ownership. You're comfortable taking an ambiguous ML problem, deciding what matters, choosing an approach and driving it through to production.

- You iterate quickly. You enjoy short feedback loops and would rather ship something useful, learn from users and improve it than spend months optimising something that hasn't reached production.

- You're curious and collaborative. You can both explain your expertise and learn from the deep technical expertise around you. You value knowledge sharing and humility.

- You're fluent in English. French isn't required.

Nice to have: experience shipping generative image models or diffusion models into production; experience evaluating third-party AI APIs against internal alternatives; experience working in a fast-growing startup or directly within a product team.

Benefits

- 30 days annual leave

À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Le poste est ouvert au sein le centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des Solides Divisés, de l'Énergie et de l'Environnement) UMR CNRS 5302 d’IMT Mines Albi, dans le cadre du projet de collaboration avec GRDF sur l’intégration de nouveaux gaz renouvelables dans le réseau de gaz naturel.

Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs. La plateforme VALTHERA est rattachée au centre RAPSODEE. Les travaux réalisés sur la plateforme le sont essentiellement à l’échelle pilote et sont centrés sur les procédés thermochimiques pour la production d’énergies renouvelables.

GRDF est le gestionnaire du plus grand réseau de distribution de gaz en Europe. GRDF s’inscrit dans une trajectoire de décarbonation, avec une volonté de multiplier par cinq la production de gaz renouvelable pour attendre 20% de gaz renouvelable dans le réseau GRDF à l’échéance 2030, mais également d’aider les consommateurs de gaz à réduire leur empreinte carbone. Dans ce cadre, GRDF souhait renforcer la connaissance et maîtrise des procédés d'épuration du syngaz, étape clé pour garantir sa compatibilité avec les procédés de méthanation et, à terme, la production de méthane conforme aux exigences d’injection dans le réseau de gaz.

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE : 

En qualité d’ingénieur de recherche, vous intégrerez une équipe comprenant des ingénieurs, techniciens et enseignants chercheurs travaillant dans la recherche sur les procédés thermiques de valorisation de biomasse et déchets.

Le projet que vous devrez développer cherche à analyser les différentes technologies d’épuration à intégrer dans une chaîne d’épuration globale de gaz de synthèse. La chaîne d’épuration a un impact conséquent sur les coûts d’investissement et d’opérations du procédé de production de biogaz par gazéification de biomasse ou déchets. Il est essentiel de simplifier le schéma d’épuration et d’essayer de minimiser la génération d’effluents afin de réduire les coûts des opérations unitaires. Le choix des briques technologiques dépend de la qualité du gaz de synthèse produit qui dépend du gisement utilisé, de la technologie du gazéifieur et des conditions opératoires.

Le projet n’inclut pas de travail expérimental. Il sera basé exclusivement sur l’analyse bibliographique et la modélisation 0D de la chaîne d’épuration. La modélisation sera réalisée via des logiciels commerciaux et plus idéalement grâce à des logiciels Open source.

Les principales tâches que le candidat retenu devra prendre en charge sont :

· La réalisation d’un état de l’art des différentes briques technologies de traitement et d’épuration de biogaz, ainsi que des différentes chaînes existantes dans la littérature.

· Une meilleure appréhension de l’impact de la composition des gisements sur la qualité du gaz en sortie du gazéifieur et l’impact de celui-ci sur la chaine d’épuration.

· L’identification des verrous techniques, des incertitudes et des lacunes de connaissances limitant la maîtrise des différentes briques technologiques.

· Une proposition de modèles des chaines d’épuration (simulation 0D) afin d’établir les bilans de matières et d’énergie et d’estimer la performance globale du procédé.

· L’identification de critères permettant de guider les choix de construction d’une chaîne d’opérations.

· La participation aux réunions de suivi du projet et la rédaction des comptes-rendus de réunion.

· La rédaction de rapports du projet en français et des publications scientifiques en anglais et la création de supports de présentation.

CAPACITE ET ATTITUDES : 

Ce poste nécessite des compétences en génie des procédés, procédés thermiques, thermodynamique et modélisation de procédés. Le candidat doit avoir une expérience dans la modélisation 0D des procédés. La connaissance et la pratique d’un ou plusieurs logiciels de simulation de procédés libres ou commerciaux sera considéré un plus.

Le candidat doit faire preuve rigueur, être doté d’un bon sens de l’analyse et savoir travailler en autonomie au sein d’une équipe. Les qualités d’analyse bibliographique et rédactionnelles sont un point essentiel pour ce poste.

Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. - Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to identify how to expand the robot's autonomous operational envelope

- Strong understanding of sim-to-real transfer, domain randomisation, reward shaping, and policy robustness techniques

- Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch); working knowledge of C++

- Strong knowledge of Linux systems and middleware frameworks for integrating learned components into a larger software stack

- Pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset — comfortable balancing research exploration with production delivery

- Excellent communication skills in English

- Experience training and deploying RL policies on physical robots — not just in simulation

- Development of scalable and modular robot architectures of motion control systems

- Experience with navigation systems and autonomous mobile robot operation in unstructured environments

- Interest in agentic engineering toolchains

- Experience leading software architecture design and software engineering best practices

- A solid grasp of physical systems, specifically multibody dynamics, electromechanical drive physics, energy optimization, and contact physics, to ensure learned policies respect hardware limits and transfer successfully from simulation to the real world

title: Technical Founder
description:
Technical Co-founder / Founding Tech Lead 
Europe · Remote + on-site in the Netherlands · Start alongside your current work · Milestone-based equity

99 agents. One co-founder missing. 

There’s never been a better time to build. But building something is getting easier for everyone.

The interesting question: what makes it worth building and hard to copy?

Our conviction: data is the ultimate anti-commodity. Unique, useful data should be at the heart of every proposition we pursue.

We're looking for a technical founder who gets excited about that. Someone to spot opportunities with me, challenge them, build them, and turn the strongest into businesses.

What we’re getting into 

We’ll explore customer problems within our network, select two propositions, and work towards product–market fit.

You bring the technical depth and the urge to make things happen. We figure out the business together.

Global ambition, a European base, and an eye on what we can learn from US speed, Chinese coordination, and Europe’s collective strengths.

You’ll probably enjoy this if… 

- You think about the customer before the stack. Who has this problem? How painful is it? Will they pay? Then: how do we solve it?

- You’re already building. Show us something people use and tell us what you personally made happen.

- You use AI throughout your work. Our ambition is to spend 80% of our time on creativity, strategy, people, and delivery, with AI handling as much of the rest as possible.

- You ship, learn, and ship again. A customer using an imperfect solution teaches us something. Another month of polishing assumptions doesn’t.

- You can own the difficult bits. Infrastructure, security, data quality, permissions, reliability. AI can help; the judgment is yours.

- You don’t wait for a backlog. You can talk to a customer, identify the problem, and decide what to try next.

- You stay with the outcome. When something breaks or a customer gets stuck, you help get it sorted. You care what happens after deployment.

You should be comfortable moving between a customer conversation, a product decision, and a production issue. That’s the work.

The practical part 

You must be based in Europe and able to work together in the Netherlands regularly. We’ll combine remote work with in-person sessions.

We’ll start alongside our current activities until we find product–market fit, with a clear weekly commitment agreed upfront. Bring urgency, follow-through, and room in your life to build.

Remuneration starts with milestone-based equity , with milestones and ownership terms agreed before we begin. Cash compensation follows once revenue supports it.

Skip the polished cover letter. Show me something. 

Apply with three short answers and take the AI intake (rubric + interview, appr 15-20 min):

- What have you shipped? Share a link or demo, your contribution, and what happened when people used it.

- Where do you see a customer problem with a data advantage worth building around?

- Where are you based, how much time can you commit, and can you work together in the Netherlands?

Warm introductions from people who know your work are welcome. Please apply through this page so everything lands in one place.

If you’ve been looking for someone to build with, let’s see what we can make happen. 

-----------------------------------------

NOTE

At 10x , there are two types of opportunities (inhouse-jobs at 10x excluded):

1. Traditional freelance missions 
These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on.

2. AI Lab roles to get access to the 10x platform 
For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities and once approved you will get access to the 10x platform.

The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings . AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. When an AI Lab request comes in, we often need to respond within 24 hours with suitable talent.

Matching depends on the specific needs of each AI Lab project and your niche expertise. Once your profile is reviewed and approved, you may be matched to relevant AI Lab projects when suitable opportunities arise.

This can happen within hours, but it may also take months, depending on the researchers at the AI labs and their project needs.

title: KVGM Medewerker
HR Stagiair
Team Lead - Platform Engineering
description:
About the role: 

We are looking for a new team lead for one of the teams within our Infra Platform Group. Your mission in this role is to architect and deliver foundational services that empower the product engineering teams building our e-commerce platform.

Together with your team, you will be tackling challenging engineering problems, working on high-performing and scalable services written in Haskell and Rust, while also providing a high-quality developer experience for the teams that use them via Python. 

Your time will be split approximately 50-50 between leadership tasks and hands-on development. In your leadership role, you are a mentor to your team members, unblocking them when they face challenging roadblocks, and you help them grow both their hard and soft skills. As part of your hands-on work, you are contributing to the architecture and the ongoing development and maintenance of our services. 

You will initially be managing a team of four experienced Haskell and Rust engineers, and you will be working closely together with the other teams in the group, the engineering manager of the Infra Platform Group, and the stakeholders from other engineering teams that consume our services.

If you don't have direct experience with Haskell, but you have solid experience with Rust or Scala and a willingness to learn Haskell, please submit your application, as we are still happy to consider it! 

Your responsibilities: 

Your Team Lead tasks will include: 

- Organizing the work and managing priorities 

- Collaborating with the other team leads in the Infra Platform Group on the long-term roadmap 

- Mentoring team members, helping them grow and holding half-yearly performance reviews with them 

- Setting up project teams and mentor project leads 

- Hiring new team members 

- Implementing and improving upon our processes for the team 

- Establishing the team culture and fostering a collaborative environment 

Your Development tasks will include: 

- Designing, developing and testing new features in our services 

- Improving the reliability and robustness of our application 

- Working on scalability and performance improvements 

- Collaborating with and review PRs of other engineers 

- Breaking down big projects into smaller issues 

- Writing clear and actionable issues 

- Debugging and fixing issues, and teaching team members to do the same 

- Working together with our product engineering teams and DevOps team on requirements and issues 

Who are you? 

You like working in a dynamic team of skilled engineers, discussing technical decisions openly and collaboratively. It is easy for you to break down big issues into smaller tasks and to prioritize work pragmatically. 

To set you up for success in this role, we think you'll benefit from having the following skills and experience: 

- You have previous experience leading an engineering team, or you are an experienced engineer, excited to start your career as a leader. 

- You can give detailed code reviews both from a high-level and a low-level perspective. 

- You have the technical depth to help your team members grow and can remove roadblocks for them. 

- You have substantial backend development experience, you are experienced with functional programming concepts, and are comfortable working with either Haskell, Scala, or Rust. Experience with Python is a plus. 

- You are familiar with relational databases (ideally PostgreSQL), Linux and git. 

- You have experience with web development, web technologies, and APIs 

- You have strong communication and problem-solving skills 

- You are a people-oriented individual who helps others with an open and approachable attitude. 

- You value high software engineering standards. 

- You are pragmatic and empathic towards your team members and other stakeholders (i.e. colleagues from other departments etc). 

- You like helping the team focus on the most important tasks, making sure its priorities and plans align with the rest of the company (we use the OKR framework for this). 

Practical requirements: 

- EU citizenship or a valid work permit for the Netherlands; you are preferably already living in the Netherlands 

- Available for at least 32 hours a week, with two days spent at the Utrecht office 

Important note: We understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow. 

Who are we? 

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht and is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals from more than 40+ nationalities. 

Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, to help, to take ownership, and create an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn ! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read. 

Why Channable? 

At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other. 

What do we offer? 

- Gross annual salary ranging from € 77k-103k, including 8% holiday allowance and based on a 40-hour work week. This salary range reflects our career framework. Your final role level will be determined throughout the recruitment process, based on alignment with this framework. 

- Savings for old age: we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary. 

- Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on your professional growth. 

- Stock Appreciation Rights: you can profit from Channable’s success. 

- Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets. 

- 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours, with the possibility of buying up to 5 extra vacation days per year. 

- Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave! 

- Commuting to our office? Choose between an NS Business Card or a €0.25/km travel allowance for alternative transport. 

- Work from our office in central Utrecht at least 2 days a week, and from home for the rest (we'll provide the gear and a budget for extra supplies). Plus, enjoy flexible working hours with a morning start window between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. 

- We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks if you live as an expat in the Netherlands! 

- Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources. 

- Fresh daily lunch: enjoy fresh meals prepared Monday to Thursday by our in-house Chef (fully catering to vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets). On Fridays, we switch it up by ordering in tasty sandwiches and salads. 

- Additional working conditions include massages, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, an in-office bar, and many more! 

- Channaweek & Channaweekend: connect with your global colleagues at our annual team gathering in Utrecht, and pack your bags for Channaweekend, our annual company-wide getaway. 

How can you introduce yourself to us? 
Are you interested? To ensure your application reaches the right team quickly, please submit it in English directly through our careers page by clicking the “Apply” button. Applications submitted via email won’t be considered. 
If it's a match, Ioana (Tech Talent Acquisition Partner) will get in touch with you for an introductory call. After that, you'll be invited for interviews. We look forward to hearing from you as soon as possible!

Contact by job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of €250 for Make-A-Wish. 

At Channable, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration and we believe in diverse and inclusive teams.

title: Marketing Afstudeerstage
description:
Ben jij onze toekomstige Marketeer? 

Wij vertellen enterprise-klanten al jaren hetzelfde: dat content zonder structuur niet schaalt. Onze eigen marketing heeft dat fundament nog niet. Bouw jij dat met ons mee? 

Over Twentyseven 

Wij bouwen content platforms voor enterprise-organisaties die wereldwijd opereren. Steeds vaker bouwen we ook de laag erboven: orchestration, content intelligence en governance. Denk aan Haskoning met zo'n 6.000 engineers wereldwijd, TIAS Business School en Itho Daalderop. Het zijn organisaties waar content dagelijks door tientallen markten en tijdzones reist. 

We zitten in Eindhoven en zijn onderdeel van Handpicked: 11 bureaus en zo'n 300 collega's. We zijn drie keer uitgeroepen tot Best Agency in Digital Development (Emerce100), waarvan twee jaar op rij! Het team bestaat uit engineers, architects en strategen. We zijn direct, kritisch op ons eigen werk en niet onder de indruk van hiërarchie. Een goed argument wint hier altijd van een functietitel. 

Wat de stage inhoudt 

Naast je afstudeeronderzoek werk je mee in de dagelijkse praktijk om de marktpositie van Twentyseven verder te versterken: 

- Marketing Workflows & Automation: Je bouwt en optimaliseert geautomatiseerde marketingprocessen (van contentcreatie tot posting en opvolging) met behulp van moderne AI-tools. 

- Contentcreatie & Thought Leadership: Je schrijft en redigeert scherpe B2B-content die onze expertise claimt. 

- Website & Conversion Optimization: Je analyseert (o.a. via Google Analytics) de performance van onze website en optimaliseert de content voor betere conversie. 

- Sales & Partner Marketing: Je helpt bij het verbinden van marketing met onze outbound salesactiviteiten en bouwt samenwerkingen met partners verder uit. 

- Bureaucoördinatie: Je werkt samen met en coördineert de opdrachten naar de interne zusterbureaus binnen Handpicked die ons ondersteunen op creatief en visueel vlak. 

- Events & Fundament: Je helpt mee bij het organiseren van relatie-events en legt richtlijnen vast voor onze Tone of Voice en marketingguidelines. 

Dit is onze ideale Marketingstagiair: 

- Je volgt een HBO-opleiding in de richting van Marketing, Communicatie, Digital Business, Commerciële Economie of een gerelateerde studierichting; 

- Je hebt uitstekende copywriting- en redactievaardigheden in het Nederlands (en bij voorkeur Engels); 

- Je bent nieuwsgierig naar AI-tools en weet hoe je deze praktisch kunt inzetten voor marketingefficiëntie; 

- Je hebt affiniteit met data en analyse (kennis van Google Analytics is een pré) om beslissingen te onderbouwen; 

- Je kunt 'uitzoomen': je kijkt niet alleen naar een losse post, maar begrijpt hoe marketing bijdraagt aan de strategische doelen van een B2B-organisatie; 

- Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en durft kritische vragen te stellen. 

De realiteit 

- De doelgroep. Je schrijft voor CMO’s en CTO’s van grote organisaties. Ze zijn sceptisch en druk, en hebben al te veel AI-keynotes gezien. Oppervlakkige content valt bij hen direct door de mand. 

- De organisatie. Je werkt tussen directie, projectmanagement, sales en een extern creatief team. Je leert afstemmen, prioriteren en voet bij stuk houden. 

- Het fundament. Wat jij neerzet, gebruiken wij na je stage nog steeds. Dat vraagt om keuzes die je kunt uitleggen en documentatie die anderen begrijpen. 

Wat wij bieden 

- De praktische kant. Je krijgt €400 per maand. Je komt werken in de hub in Eindhoven, met mogelijkheid om hybride te werken. Je bent voor 32-40 uur per week beschikbaar. 

- Een afstudeeropdracht die blijft staan. Wat jij bouwt, gebruiken we na je stage nog. Je scriptie beschrijft dus iets wat echt draait, en geen casus die na je presentatie in een la verdwijnt. 

- Begeleiding van dichtbij. O.a. onze algemeen directeur en onze senior projectmanager begeleiden je. De lijnen zijn kort, je krijgt regelmatig feedback en we zijn eerlijk, ook als dat even schuurt. 

- Ruimte om te experimenteren. Je krijgt toegang tot onze AI-tooling en mag die loslaten op onze eigen marketing. Als iets niet werkt, leren we daar allebei van. 

- Direct contact met de doelgroep. Je bent erbij als we executive events organiseren. Daar hoor je uit eerste hand wat directeuren van grote organisaties echt bezighoudt, en dat leer je niet uit een marketingboek. 

- Een groot netwerk achter een klein team. Twentyseven is onderdeel van Handpicked: 11 bureaus en zo’n 300 collega’s. Je werkt samen met Weekend en kunt kennis halen bij specialisten in het hele digitale vakgebied.

description:
Intro

Wil jij als creative deel uitmaken van een snel groeiend en tech gedreven creatief advertising & content bureau in de Houthavens en samen met een leuk team werk maken dat opvalt, werkt én connact? ACT. Now! 

Advertising, Content en Technology, samen met jou 

ACT.agency staat voor Advertising, Content & Technology together. Wij geloven dat advertising en content via een geïntegreerde aanpak ontwikkeld moet worden, versnelt door technology. Met onze ACT.vertising aanpak zorgen we ervoor dat merken zich strategisch en creatief onderscheiden, always-on communiceren en zo consistent blijven op de lange én korte termijn. In ons kantoor in de Amsterdamse Houthavens werken we met 32 mensen aan accounts als Odido, PwC, Mercedes-Benz Trucks, Schiphol, Museumkaart, Noordhoff en Prinses Máxima Centrum.

ACT zoekt een medior Social Creative. Of ben je juist een medior creatief met veel social ervaring? Allebei kan. Want dat is ook precies waar wij ons als ACT begeven: tussen advertising en content, met veel social werk. Je bedenkt alleen of samen in een team het concept, schrijft het uit en maakt het zelf, snel en met de nieuwste technologie.

Taken

Als creative bij ACT bedenk je concepten die kloppen, de kern raken en waar iedereen energie van krijgt. Social is jouw vak: ongeveer 80% van je werk. De rest is breder creatief werk, zoals campagne-ideeën en pitches.

Je schrijft het script, pakt zelfs eventueel de camera en kan het ook zelf monteren. Van idee tot eindresultaat is het van jou. Je idee staat als t moet als eerste versie binnen een dag. Je weet wat er speelt op Insta, TikTok en YouTube Shorts.

Je presenteert je ideeën intern en bij de klant, onderbouwt ze op basis van de briefing en denkt tactisch mee, met gelaagdheid in je campagnes. Je spart dagelijks met de creative directors en werkt samen met strategie, account, social media manegers en community management.

Wij vragen

- Je hebt minimaal 2 tot 3 jaar ervaring als creative bij een creatief bureau, met veel social ervaring

- Je hebt een portfolio met werk dat je zelf hebt bedacht én gemaakt, met aantoonbare resultaten

- Je kunt idealiter zelf filmen en monteren, bijvoorbeeld in Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut of DaVinci

- Je maakt zelf content en brengt een idee in korte tijd van concept naar een eerste versie

- Je bent nieuwsgierig naar technologie en gebruikt AI-tools in je dagelijkse werk, bijvoorbeeld voor beeld, video, geluid of tekst.

- Je schrijft soepele social en short copy

- Je bent een nieuwsgierige, sterke persoonlijkheid met humor en energie, die goed kan samenwerken maar ook goed alleen kan werken

- Je weet wat er speelt in het vak en je ideeën plus tone-of-voice zijn van deze tijd

- Je hebt smaak, oog voor detail en werkt gestructureerd en nauwkeurig

- Je werkt het liefst samen met je team op kantoor. Dit is geen hybride functie!

Wat we bieden

- Een ambitieus bureau waar goed werk en samenwerken centraal staan

- Een klantportfolio dat je elke dag uitdaagt om je talent te laten zien en het beste werk te maken

- Ruimte om met nieuwe technologie en AI te experimenteren in echt klantwerk

- Een platte organisatie waarbij elke mening telt, en directe sparring met de creative directors

- Een gezellig team in een open werkomgeving

- Een mooi kantoor in het Amsterdamse Westelijk Havengebied, een lekkere lunch, regelmatig een borrel en bij lekker weer ons grote dakterras

- Een marktconform salaris

- 32 tot 40 uur per week

- Pensioen, laptop en OV-kaart zijn voor ons de standaard

- Én niet te vergeten: onbeperkt vakantiedagen

Laat van je horen!

Ben jij de Social Creative die ons omver gaat blazen met je ideeën? Stuur geen lange motivatiebrief, maar je beste werk: een showreel of portfolio, één ding waar je trots op bent en een korte intro van jezelf (mag een video zijn). Laat snel van je horen!

title: AI platform engineer
description:
Wil jij werken op het snijvlak van cloud, platform engineering en AI? Bij Itility krijg je de ruimte om te bouwen aan een platform dat onze engineers en klantenteams helpt slimmer, efficiënter en veiliger te werken. Je ontwikkelt niet alleen nieuwe functionaliteiten, maar denkt ook actief mee over hoe we AI en automation kunnen inzetten om onze dienstverlening verder te verbeteren.

Wat jij gaat doen 

Je bouwt mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van ons platform en vertaalt behoeften vanuit onze klantenteams naar concrete, herbruikbare oplossingen. Je werkt aan features vanuit de roadmap, maar signaleert ook zelf waar verbeteringen mogelijk zijn.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van je werk is het toepassen van AI en automation. Je ontwikkelt bijvoorbeeld AI-agents die informatie verzamelen en analyseren, engineers ondersteunen bij troubleshooting of binnen duidelijke kaders zelfstandig acties uitvoeren. Je zorgt ervoor dat deze oplossingen niet bij een proof of concept blijven, maar daadwerkelijk in productie worden gebruikt.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

- Het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van nieuwe platformfunctionaliteiten.

- Het doorontwikkelen van onze centrale dashboard- en beheeromgeving.

- Het bouwen van AI-agents, agentic workflows, API's en integraties.

- Het ontwikkelen en verbeteren van Terraform-modules en andere automatiseringen.

- Het inrichten van human-in-the-loop-processen, approvals en guardrails.

- Het analyseren en automatiseren van terugkerende operationele werkzaamheden.

- Het ondersteunen bij incidenten, troubleshooting en wijzigingen wanneer dat nodig is.

Je krijgt de ruimte om zelf verbeterkansen te signaleren, ideeën uit te werken en oplossingen te realiseren. Daarbij houd je altijd rekening met security, betrouwbaarheid en beheersbaarheid.

Waar kom je terecht? 

Je maakt deel uit van het Platform Team binnen onze MSP-organisatie. Dit team ontwikkelt en beheert de centrale diensten waarop onze klantenteams vertrouwen. Het platform vormt de basis voor onze cloud-, data- en AI-dienstverlening en helpt engineers om hun werk efficiënt, veilig en consistent uit te voeren.

Binnen het team werken we met onder andere:

- Microsoft Azure en AWS voor cloud-, data- en AI-foundations.

- Terraform voor Infrastructure as Code en herbruikbare infrastructuurmodules.

- LogicMonitor voor centrale monitoring.

- Puppet voor configuration management.

- Centrale dashboards en tooling voor het beheer en de ontsluiting van onze platformdiensten.

We blijven investeren in de verdere ontwikkeling van dit platform. Daarbij willen we AI en automation een steeds grotere rol geven, zodat onze engineers minder tijd kwijt zijn aan repetitieve werkzaamheden en meer ruimte hebben voor complexe vraagstukken en innovatie.

Daar hoort natuurlijk ook een aantrekkelijk arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket bij. Naast een salaris dat past bij jouw ervaring, achtergrond en potentie, kun je rekenen op:

- Een Leaseauto met tankpas of een mobiliteitsvergoeding met kilometervergoeding;

- €115 onkostenvergoeding per maand;

- 26 vakantiedagen per jaar;

- 50% bijdrage aan je ziektekostenverzekering van jou én die van je partner;

- 60% bijdrage aan je pensioenregeling;

- Een variabele bonusregeling gebaseerd op jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling en gezamenlijke successen;

- Laptop en telefoon;

- Hybride werken;

- Gebruik van gym op kantoor

Dit ben jij

Je bent in de eerste plaats een hands-on engineer. Je vindt het leuk om zelf oplossingen te ontwerpen en te bouwen, maar kijkt ook verder dan het individuele ticket. Je neemt initiatief, zoekt actief de samenwerking met de teams die ons platform gebruiken en signaleert waar processen en diensten beter kunnen.

Je denkt in herbruikbare oplossingen en vraagt jezelf regelmatig af hoe werkzaamheden slimmer kunnen worden ingericht. Daarbij verlies je security, betrouwbaarheid en beheersbaarheid niet uit het oog.

Je brengt mee; 

- Een bachelor of masterdiploma in Informatica, Software engineering, Data Science/ AI of vergelijkbaar,

- Sterke kennis van Microsoft Azure en/of AWS, met diepgaande ervaring in minimaal één van beide.

- Ervaring met Python, .NET of een vergelijkbare programmeertaal.

- Ervaring met API's en integraties.

- Ervaring met Infrastructure as Code, bij voorkeur Terraform.

- Kennis van AI- en LLM-oplossingen en interesse in of ervaring met AI-agents en agentic workflows.

- Ervaring met CI/CD en moderne software-ontwikkelmethoden.

- Een proactieve houding, eigenaarschap en de motivatie om zelf verbeterkansen te signaleren en te realiseren.

Nice to have; 

Ervaring met een of meer van de volgende technologieën en onderwerpen is een pré:

- Azure OpenAI, Azure AI-services, AWS Bedrock of andere AWS AI-services.

- LogicMonitor en Puppet.

- Observability en event-driven architecturen.

- Multi-tenantplatformen.

- Werken binnen een MSP-omgeving.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

The Buyer domain's Data Science teams build and iterate on our most critical ML systems—like ranking, retrieval, and recommendations—that serve millions of users. As our ambition and the complexity of these models grow, we are scaling our MLOps capabilities to match: 

We are hiring an MLOps Engineer to solve this. This is a high-impact "bridge" role, not to build new platforms, but to be the expert user of our existing platforms (GCP/Vertex AI, Vespa, Triton). Your mission is to take our Data Science team's work, rectify the current ad-hoc solutions, and build the robust, automated, and high-quality "path-to-production" our advanced models require.

Also by joining Vinted, you’ll become part of an active community of engineers who are keen on sharing knowledge, organizing learning workshops and so much more!

In this position, you’ll 

- Productionise ML models: be responsible for migrating all existing model training code from experimental or proof-of-concept stages to robust and automated pipelines.

- Build continuous training (CT) pipelines: design, build, and maintain automated workflows for data preparation, model training, and batch scoring.

- Automate model serving & integration: package and deploy traditional ML models (e.g., in ONNX format) to our existing serving infrastructure, primarily Vespa and/or Triton.

- Close the deployment loop: automate model deployments where they are still manual. For example, building a GitHub Action that deploys a new model to Vespa, triggered by a webhook from a successful Vertex AI training pipeline.

- Build the missing quality gates: build the automated quality and evaluation gates that our pipelines lack today. This includes:

- Establish and uphold ML Model Lifecycle Standards: Take ownership of and continuously improve the standards, quality, and governance of the complete ML model lifecycle.

About you 

- We are looking for an "ML-literate" Software Engineer, not a Data Scientist. You are a builder and an automator with a strong service mindset.

- Must-have technical skills: deep expertise in GCP/Vertex AI (or equivalents like SageMaker), Kubernetes, and Docker.

- Automation expertise: proven experience building robust CI/CD and automation pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.).

- ML-Literate: you understand ML workflows and concepts (training, evaluation, inference) well enough to debug pipelines and build meaningful quality gates.

- Soft skills: a strong "service mindset," excellent communication, and the ability to act as a bridge between the highly technical worlds of Data Science and Infrastructure. You are pragmatic and driven to get high-quality work into production.

- Bonus Points: familiarity with ML serving platforms like Vespa search engine or NVIDIA Triton and model formats like ONNX.

- Willingness to learn and master new technologies and concepts.

- We value pragmatism, big-picture thinking, curiosity, and problem-solving skills.

Work perks

Working at Vinted

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Equal opportunity

title: Full Stack Developer (Onboarding & Enablement)
description:
We turn every customer interaction into an opportunity. We connect conversations, customer data and payments with AI Agents so that companies can deliver personal customer journeys at scale: both online and in person.

“The entire customer journey. One platform”

What we value 

Every CM.com colleague, connects to our 4 shared values :

Drive and Lead 

You take initiative, make decisions and recognize opportunities. Making mistakes is part of moving forward.

Grow and Learn 

The growth of our colleagues and our customers is our priority. You like to experiment, learn continuously and actively share knowledge and insights with others.

Together and Care 

We work together and we believe that diverse perspectives lead to stronger outcomes. You value the social side of work, you show genuine interest and care about one another’s well-being.

Speed and Change 

By welcoming AI Agents into our organisation, we fundamentally change how work is done. You are comfortable with change and you love working in a high paced environment.

The Role 

As a Full Stack Developer in the Onboarding & Enablement team, you'll own the front door of CM.com connectivity: the self service experience where customers sign up and start messaging in minutes, without a sales call or a single email. It is one of the most important topics at CM.com today, and your team is the conductor behind it.

In today's tech market, speed wins. Customers choose the provider they can start with right now, and they value ease over a long list of requirements. Think of how quickly you can take out a phone subscription: that is the experience we want to offer. Our customers are people, but increasingly also AI agents, and neither wants to wait for a callback.

Behind that one simple interface sits a complex platform. Every channel works differently. For example: WhatsApp runs via Meta, RCS via Google and Orange, and more channels and suppliers are joining. Customers should never notice any of that. The complexity is ours, not theirs.

You will 

- Build the self service onboarding experience that takes customers from sign up to their first message in minutes

- Turn every customer request into the right configuration across our own systems and external suppliers, fully automated

- Make it easy to plug in new channels and supplier partnerships, so the platform grows without adding complexity for the customer

- Drive automation across the full customer journey, for people and AI agents alike

- Own your work from idea to production, including how it runs on our infrastructure

- Use AI tools actively to improve your own work: experiment, automate, and share what works with your team

- Medior to senior full stack developer with hands on experience in both front end and back end

- Strong in Angular on the front end, and in C# and .NET on the back end

- Solid knowledge of relational databases, such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL

- Fluent in English and Dutch

- Nice to have: experience with DevOps or system engineering, as the team also manages its own infrastructure

- Genuinely curious about AI: you experiment with tools like ChatGPT or Copilot and you're open to working differently as they improve

Believe you’d be a great fit for this role, even if you don’t tick every box? Reach out to our Recruitment team! We’d be happy to connect and see if we can make it work together.

What we offer 

As a CM.com club member, you’ll have the following benefits:

- Onboarding : Join our unique 3-days Global Onboarding program in our Headquarters in Breda, a deep dive into the culture of CM.com.

- Healthy food: Daily healthy lunches and snacks to keep you energized.

- Effortless commute: The Shuttle mobility card, commuting allowance and Lease-a-bike options get you where you need to be. We have CM company cars that you can use for client visits as well.

- Invest in your future : A solid pension plan.

- Time off: Recharge with 25 vacation days, plus the option to purchase 10 additional days.

- Own your success: Become a shareholder with our Employee Share Purchase Program.

- Your Development : We support your growth and development through initiatives like the CM Academy, Udemy courses, exclusive meetups with thought leaders, the Young Professional Program, and our own CM Business Adventure (CMBA), ensuring you’re always learning and evolving

- Vitality : Our Vitality Team organizes a year-round vitality program to support a healthy body and mind for all colleagues. Think of stress prevention workshops, ergonomist visit, weekly bootcamps, yoga sessions and our CM sports day.

- Together at CM.com : Weekly drinks, board game nights, karaoke throwdowns, yearly ski trip, and more! We have something for everyone.

Our diverse perspectives fuel innovation and drive us forward. We welcome everyone, regardless of age, background, or beliefs.

Before you apply 

We work on-site, move fast, and expect you to bring your own thinking. Priorities shift, AI is actively changing how we work and we embrace that reality. If that sounds like a great environment to you, we'd love to hear from you.

Note: For this position, we can only consider candidates who already hold a permanent work and residence permit for the Netherlands.

description:

· Een betrokken en dynamisch team.

Wat is de procedure? 

Na een succesvolle telefonische kennismaking volgt een face to face gesprek met Sven Fremeijer. Als we beiden voldoende aanleiding zien om verder te gaan stelt Sound je voor bij SnelStart. Daar volgen 2 gesprekrondes.

De eerste gespreksronde wordt gezamenlijk gevoerd door de CCO en HR De tweede ronde zal plaatsvinden met de CCO en een externe adviseur. Als laatste een finale selectie en arbeidsvoorwaarden worden vastgesteld in afstemming met de CEO en het MT.

title: Mission Critical Security Engineer – Threat Hunting
description:
Help protect what truly matters in our customers' most critical environments by proactively identifying threats and improving how they are detected and addressed. 

As a Mission Critical Security Engineer with a focus on Threat Hunting, you will be part of a dedicated customer team responsible for securing and continuously improving a complex, mission-critical application landscape.

Working alongside other engineers and security specialists, you will help ensure the environment remains as secure and resilient as possible. You combine a strong engineering foundation with a security mindset, taking ownership of security improvements and understanding how systems, applications, and infrastructure behave.

Your specific focus will be on threat hunting and detection engineering. Using your in-depth knowledge of the customer's technology stack and application landscape, you will fine-tune existing detection use cases and develop new ones tailored to the environment. You will use our custom SIEM/SOAR-based Managed Detection and Response (MDR) platform to turn emerging threats and technical insights into actionable detection capabilities.

This role bridges security engineering, detection engineering, and threat intelligence. You don't simply follow predefined playbooks. You understand system behavior, identify gaps, and develop practical solutions that strengthen the security of the customer's environment.

/ What you will do

Threat intelligence & continuous improvement 

- 
Actively follow security developments, vulnerabilities, and threat intelligence and translate these into relevant hunts and detections.

- 
Identify security risks and gaps in detection coverage and proactively propose improvements.

- 
Use your knowledge of the customer's application and infrastructure landscape to continuously strengthen its security posture.

- 
Contribute to the evolution of the team's security monitoring and detection strategy.

Continuously refine detection logic to improve quality, relevance, and signal-to-noise ratio.

Build and fine-tune custom detection scenarios based on the specific characteristics and security requirements of the customer's environment.

Platform collaboration

Leverage our custom SIEM/SOAR-based MDR platform to implement detections and analyze data.

Collaborate with platform and automation engineers to improve integrations and detection capabilities.

Apply engineering and automation practices to ensure detection solutions are scalable, reliable, and maintainable.

/ What you bring

We are looking for someone who combines solid engineering fundamentals with a strong interest in security and is motivated to move towards or deepen their expertise in threat hunting and detection engineering.

You don't necessarily need to be an experienced threat hunter already. What matters is your ability to understand complex systems, recognize unusual behavior, and translate technical insights into practical security improvements.

Solid engineering fundamentals, including Linux, networking, and infrastructure behavior.

Familiarity with SIEM or log analytics platforms such as OpenSearch, Elastic, Splunk, or Microsoft Sentinel.

- 
Strong understanding of security principles, including threat detection and response.

- 
Ability to distinguish normal from abnormal system behavior.

- 
Analytical, curious, and driven to understand how systems and threats behave.

- 
Ownership mindset, with responsibility for security quality and continuous improvement.

- 
Strong communication skills to translate technical findings into actionable insights.

- 
Ability to connect business and customer context to technical security solutions.

Nice-to-have skills

Hands-on experience with threat hunting, detection engineering, or advanced SOC operations.

Experience developing or improving detection use cases and security monitoring rules.

- 
Experience with SOAR or security automation.

- 
Deep knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, and other Microsoft cloud services.

- 
Familiarity with threat intelligence frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

- 
Experience integrating SIEM/SOAR platforms or forwarding security telemetry between different environments.

/ Who are you?

You are an engineer with a strong interest in security, driven to understand how systems behave and how threats manifest.

You don't follow playbooks blindly. You want to understand why detections exist, how systems interact, and where security can be improved.

You combine analytical thinking with a hands-on mindset and enjoy working with complex applications, infrastructure, and data. You are curious, proactive, and take ownership of the quality of your work.

title: Junior Product Manager – IT Fulfillment
description:

As Junior Product Manager for IT Fulfillment, you will help build and improve the services that make that happen: the order flows, data and interfaces that connect our webstore, our stores, our warehouses and our customer service teams.

You will work in a small team inside the IT Fulfillment domain, alongside the Group Product Manager and our own engineers. The Group Product Manager shapes the functional direction with the business and sets priorities; together you turn it into clear requirements, well-defined tickets and working software, built with engineers and AI agents. This is a technical product role: we build our own services, so you will spend your time in data models, interfaces and requirements rather than managing a vendor’s roadmap. You start close to delivery, with support while you learn the domain, and grow into owning more of the roadmap.

What you will do 

- Turn mapped-out functional flows into clear, buildable work: technical requirements, acceptance criteria and user stories that engineers and AI agents can pick up without coming back with questions.

- Own the detail as both product manager and business analyst: the data model, the way systems talk to each other, and the edge cases nobody thought of yet.

- Break large changes into chunks that can be built, tested and released safely, and keep the backlog in a state where work can start at any moment.

- Work with engineers day to day in refinement, planning, reviews and releases, and use our AI tooling to draft, structure and pressure-test the work before it reaches them.

- Design our order data and interfaces so that AI agents can read, reason over and act on them as reliably as our own systems do.

- Create visibility across the end-to-end fulfillment journey, so anyone from a customer service agent to a supply chain lead can see where an order is and what happened to it, and turn that into measures the business trusts.

- Take on discovery for smaller and mid-sized roadmap items as your domain knowledge builds: the options, the trade-offs and the recommendation.

Who you are 

- Business analysis experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience as a Business Analyst or Product Owner. You have written functional and technical specifications, worked directly with developers, and been accountable for the detail being right. The analysis craft is what we are hiring for.

- Domain experience: That experience is in fulfillment, order management, supply chain, e-commerce or retail operations. You know what an order, a shipment, an allocation and a return actually are, and what it costs operationally when one goes wrong.

- Eye for detail: You chase the last open question rather than leaving it for someone else to find in production.

- AI-native mindset: You already work with tools like Claude and Cursor every day to analyse, draft, prototype and check your own thinking, and you know what to hand over and what to validate yourself.

- Technical fluency: You can hold your own in a technical conversation without being an engineer, and you say “I don’t understand that yet” rather than guessing.

- Communication: You are a clear writer who asks the uncomfortable question early rather than the polite one late.

- Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

What you will get

- Corporate Social Responsibility: Our commitment to sustainability and ethical business is unwavering. We work exclusively with suppliers who uphold the highest standards, in alignment with the International Labour Organization.

description:
Ben jij analytisch sterk en wil je impact maken binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan moeten we jou hebben! 

Jouw rol 
Bij Heras krijg je de kans om als stagiair bij te dragen aan het Nimble-programma: een strategisch verbeterprogramma gericht op het vereenvoudigen en automatiseren van bedrijfsprocessen. Als stagiair werk je aan het verbeteren van processen binnen domeinen zoals sales, projecten in nieuwbouw en finance. Je analyseert hoe processen vandaag werken en vertaalt dit naar slimme oplossingen met behulp van Power BI en Power Automate. Je levert concrete procesverbeteringen, procesbeschrijvingen, automatiseringen en Power BI dashboards voor operationele en financiële sturing aan alsmede werkende Power Automate flows. Jouw werkzaamheden 

- In kaart brengen van huidige processen en knelpunten.

- Automatiseren van handmatige processen met Power Automate.

- Ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages in Power BI (zonder daadwerkelijk programmeren).

- Verbeteren van datakwaliteit en inzicht in KPI’s.

title: Senior Specialist, T2 / Target2 Payment Operations
description:
About Finom 

Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.

We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.

Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.

Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

Senior Specialist, T2 (Target2) Payment Operations 

Location: Remote in Netherlands, Spain, Cyprus or Poland

The role

We’re moving from indirect to direct participation in TARGET2 (T2), and we need someone to own the operational side end to end. You’ll design and document the Payment Operations processes, validate them in the August UAT, cut over BIC by BIC, and then run them as business-as-usual. You’ll be the operational contact for the T2 scheme, DNB and our partner banks.

What you’ll do

- Own core payment processes: SCT / SCT Inst recalls, investigations (including pacs.028), SWIFT enquiries (MT199/MT999, RFIs), missing or incoming funds, and rejects, returns and refunds.

- Run the T2 platform day to day: work in the T2 GUI (U2A/A2A), maintain CRDM reference data, and set up four-eyes controls and the manual-vs-automated split.

- Manage the migration: move traffic from BNP Paribas to direct participation, with every payment traceable by BIC and path, and define when each BNPP-dependent step can be retired.

- Cover reconciliation and liquidity: be the Payment Ops link to the reconciliation team (funding and defunding stay with Finance Ops/Treasury).

- Handle incidents and contingency: build the incident process around DNB, FIS and TARGET escalation routes, own Payment Ops’ role in DNB reporting, and define the ECONS II contingency approach.

- Coordinate with others: work with the Eurosystem, DNB, SWIFT/NEXI, FIS and correspondent banks, and partner with Product and Engineering to specify how the platform should behave.

What success looks like

- Every direct-participation process has an owner, documented procedures, and passing UAT evidence.

- The migration causes no impact on customers, and Customer Support has clear guidance.

- After go-live, T2 runs as stable BAU with no remaining BNPP operational dependency.

What we’re looking for

- Hands-on experience with T2 / TARGET Services (RTGS, TIPS), including the GUI and U2A/A2A actions

- Around 2-3+ years in payment operations at a bank, EMI or PSP, ideally with SEPA schemes (SCT, SCT Inst)

- Familiarity with investigations, recalls, returns and SWIFT / ISO 20022 messaging

- Experience writing SOPs and controls, or the ability to pick it up quickly

- Comfort working with regulators, partners and technical teams

- Enough ownership to make sign-off and escalation decisions with support from the team

- Fluent English

Nice to have

- Experience with CRDM reference-data maintenance

- Involvement in a direct-participation onboarding or sponsor-bank migration

- Knowledge of DNB / TARGET-NL conditions, IPR, PSD2, or ECONS II contingency processes

Work in the EU 

Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.

Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.

Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer 

Wil jij technische projecten van begin tot eind begeleiden? Krijg jij energie van het organiseren van complexe technische projecten en vind je het leuk om verschillende partijen met elkaar te verbinden? En wil je werken aan innovatieve oplossingen op het gebied van energieopslag en vermogenselektronica? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen? 

Als Project Engineer begeleid je projecten binnen AEP Hybrid Power vanaf de technische overdracht na opdracht tot en met de oplevering. Jij bent de verbindende schakel tussen de klant, engineering, productiepartners, leveranciers en service.

Je zorgt ervoor dat technische eisen, planning, budget, documentatie en testen goed op elkaar aansluiten. Je houdt overzicht, signaleert mogelijke problemen op tijd en zorgt ervoor dat acties en afspraken worden opgevolgd.

Je taken omvatten onder andere:

• Overnemen en structureren van projecten na opdracht, inclusief scope, specificaties, planning, budget en risico’s
• Vertalen van klant- en contracteisen naar duidelijke technische specificaties en werkpakketten
• Opstellen en bewaken van projectplanningen, actielijsten, mijlpalen en technische opleverpunten
• Coördineren van engineering, inkoop, productie, testen en documentatie met interne en externe partners
• Afstemmen van verschillende technische interfaces, zoals converters, ultracapacitorsystemen, besturingen, koeling en beveiligingen

title: Senior AI Software Engineer
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

The team 

NiCE Labs (nice.com/nice-labs) is where NiCE explores what's next in AI for customer experience. This role is on AI Innovation, the Labs pillar that builds and validates new AI capabilities through prototypes, so the company can make better product decisions, faster. 

We're a deliberately small, senior team of builders inside NiCE Cognigy, the AI agent platform. We operate in fast iteration cycles: spot an emerging capability, build a working prototype, validate it against real metrics (quality, latency, cost, user impact), and then decide: kill it, iterate, publish it, or hand it off to a product team. Some of our work is public, like the open-sourced Cognigy Platform MCP server; most of it shapes the product roadmap from the inside. 

We hire for product mindset and builder mentality. Everyone on the team takes ideas from zero to working software, shows them to real users, and argues from evidence. 

So, what’s the role all about? 

You'll work at the intersection of frontier AI capabilities and a real enterprise product. The field moves faster than any roadmap can track. Your job is to close that gap: turn new models, protocols, and agent patterns into working systems, prove what matters in realistic scenarios, and produce the insights and reference implementations that let product and engineering teams move with confidence. 

You'll need to be comfortable with ambiguity, at home where best practices don't exist yet, and quick to move on when the results point elsewhere. 

How will you make an impact? 

- Build agentic systems and full-stack prototypes end-to-end, shipping a first version in days and learning from real use

- Track the frontier (new models, agent patterns, protocols like MCP) and turn the promising ones into working prototypes rather than slideware 

- Design experiments that show whether a concept holds up, measured in quality, latency, cost, and user impact 

- Work directly with internal users, product managers, and customers to validate concepts early and iterate quickly 

- Turn validated prototypes into reference implementations and write-ups that product teams can build on, then hand off cleanly and move to the next bet 

- Give product and platform teams concrete feedback on where AI capabilities shine and where they fall short 

- Move between initiatives as priorities shift. What you learn on one bet compounds into the next 

Have you got what it takes? 

- Have 4+ years building full-stack software, including things you started from nothing. We weigh what you've shipped more than years on a CV 

- Have shipped LLM-powered systems to production:features real users depended on, not demos or notebooks 

- Understand AI agents below the framework level: message arrays, tool calling, context management, prompt caching. You could build an agent loop from scratch and explain why it works 

- Use AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar) as your default way of working, and it makes you measurably faster, not just busier 

- Are full-stackin practice: comfortable taking a prototype from API to demo UI on your own (our stack centers on TypeScript/Node.js and React) 

- Do your best work when the ground is still moving. New territory energises you more than a settled plan 

- Think in user problems first, solutions second 

You will have an advantage if you also have:

- A strong eye for UX/UI: you can make a prototype feel like a product, and you notice when one lacks that eye

- Experience with voice and real-time AI: streaming, speech-to-text/text-to-speech, voice-to-voice models 

- Open-source work on agent tooling (MCP servers, harnesses, evals) 

- Experience designing evaluations for AI systems 

- Background in conversational AI or customer-experience products 

Enjoy NICE-FLEX! 

At NICE, we work according to the NICE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.
