title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
About the role 

0G is hiring its first dedicated DevOps engineer to own our cloud platform end to end: infrastructure, deployments, networking, security hygiene and cost. Today that work is spread across several developers.

Our platform runs on five providers: Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, AWS, Cloudflare and Vercel. It includes:

- Validator, seed, RPC, and archive nodes for our mainnet and testnet

- Confidential-computing (TEE) workloads, GPU machines and storage nodes

- Kubernetes clusters and managed databases

- A global RPC load balancer at the edge, and our web apps

All together, that is more than 200 virtual machines. You will be the person who knows what runs where, why it runs there, and what it costs.

What you'll own 

You own the platform, from the network edge to the bill.

- Cloud operations: provisioning, upgrades, capacity and the full resource lifecycle on Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud and AWS. That includes rightsizing and releasing what nobody uses.

- Kubernetes: run, upgrade and scale our clusters. Keep them on supported versions and design node pools, autoscaling and Spot capacity.

- Blockchain node fleet: operate validator, sentry, seed, RPC and archive nodes, including peering topology, snapshots, sync and client upgrades.

- Networking and edge: VPC design, load balancers, DNS, Cloudflare Workers, Tunnels and WAF, and keeping internet egress deliberate and cheap.

- Infrastructure as code and CI/CD: every environment defined in Terraform or Pulumi. You design and run CI/CD on Jenkins or an equivalent such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, covering builds, tests, security scans and releases from commit to production, with no manual steps.

- Observability and on-call: metrics, logs, alerts and dashboards, including control of metric cardinality. You also run incident response and write the postmortems.

- Security and access: least-privilege IAM across every provider, secrets management, and no databases or admin ports open to the internet.

- Cost management: billing exports, budgets and alerts, tagging, a monthly cost review and commitment planning.

- Developer enablement: templates, preview environments, documentation and support for the engineers who ship on the platform.

Our stack 

Kubernetes: GKE, EKS, Helm, Ingress and Gateway API, autoscaling, RBAC, network policies

Networking: TCP/IP, subnets and CIDR, routing, NAT, L4 and L7 load balancers, DNS, TLS, firewalls, VPC peering

Google Cloud: Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud SQL, Cloud Run, IAM, Cloud Monitoring, billing export to BigQuery

Infrastructure as code: Terraform, Pulumi

CI/CD and containers: Jenkins or an equivalent (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), Argo CD, Docker and BuildKit, container registries

Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Cloud Monitoring, CloudWatch, Alibaba CloudMonitor

Linux: Systems administration, systemd, disks and filesystems, performance debugging

Alibaba Cloud: ECS, VPC, NLB and ALB, ESSD disks, RDS, PolarDB, SAE, Cloud Firewall

AWS: EC2, EKS, RDS, ALB and NLB, Route 53, S3, Organizations

Cloudflare: DNS, Workers, Tunnels, WAF and rate limiting, Zero Trust

Databases (operations): PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, managed Kafka

Blockchain nodes: CometBFT-based chains, reth and other EVM clients, P2P networking

Vercel: Projects, builds, ISR, team access

Confidential computing: Intel TDX virtual machines on Google Cloud and Alibaba Cloud

Must-haves 

- We want 5+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform roles, including 3+ years running production Kubernetes and owning CI/CD pipelines.

Kubernetes, in depth 

- Upgrading control planes and node pools with no downtime, and keeping clusters on supported versions.

- Scheduling: requests and limits, affinity, taints and tolerations, priority, and eviction under node pressure.

- Autoscaling with the HPA, cluster autoscaler or Karpenter, plus Spot or preemptible node pools for non-critical work.

- Networking inside the cluster: CNI, Services, Ingress or Gateway API, network policies, and DNS within the cluster.

- Security: RBAC, Pod Security, workload identity, and secrets that never sit in plain environment variables.

- Stateful workloads: StatefulSets, persistent volumes and CSI drivers, and backup and restore.

- Packaging and delivery with Helm or Kustomize, ideally through GitOps with Argo CD or Flux.

- Debugging a failing pod, node or rollout from events, logs and metrics.

CI/CD, in depth 

- Pipeline design: you have built and run production CI/CD on Jenkins or an equivalent (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, Tekton). Pipelines are defined as code in a Jenkinsfile or workflow YAML, with shared libraries and reusable templates.

- CI platform operations: running Jenkins controllers with ephemeral agents on Kubernetes, or self-hosted runners. That includes plugin and version upgrades, credential handling, and scaling build capacity.

Ralph baut das Operating System für Wohnimmobilien. Der Markt ist riesig, und er läuft noch größtenteils auf Aktenordnern, Outlook und USB-Sticks. Wir sind der erste AI Property Manager, der auf einem eigenen Operating System läuft, und betreiben Gebäude damit End-to-End. Ralph OS automatisiert Zahlungen, Buchhaltung, Compliance und Kommunikation. AI-Agenten bereiten die Arbeit vor, und unser Team gibt sie frei. Die Hausverwaltung ist unser Einstieg. Das Ziel ist die neue Infrastruktur für die ganze Kategorie, mit Fintech, Versicherung und Finanzierung auf derselben Plattform. Heute verwalten wir über 10.000 Wohneinheiten und wachsen schnell, organisch und durch Zukäufe. Verantwortung bekommst du bei uns früh, und was du baust, nutzen wir direkt im Alltag.

Deine Rolle

Du baust bei Ralph die Produktorganisation auf und bist dabei die erste Produktperson im Team. Durch AI verändert sich die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Produkt, Engineering und Design gerade grundlegend, und wir wollen sie bewusst neu denken statt nach dem alten Lehrbuch aufzusetzen. Du gestaltest Vision, Organisation und Prozesse und treibst gleichzeitig selbst Produktthemen von der ersten Idee bis zum Rollout.

Deine Aufgaben

Produktorganisation & Prozesse aufbauen

- Du baust unsere Produktorganisation auf und definierst, wie Produkt, Engineering und Design im Zeitalter von AI zusammenarbeiten.

- Du etablierst schlanke Produktprozesse und Prinzipien, die schnelles Lernen ermöglichen – Backlog-Grooming ist dabei nebensächlich.

- Du stellst das Produktteam ein und entwickelst es weiter.

Produktvision verantworten

- Du verantwortest Produktvision, Strategie und Roadmap für unsere Kernprodukte – insbesondere unser Eigentümer-Portal und das interne Operations-Dashboard.

- Du arbeitest eng mit Julius (CEO), Cip (CTO) und unserem In-House Verwalterteam zusammen und triffst Produktentscheidungen nah am realen Betrieb.

Selbst Produktthemen treiben (IC)

- Du gehst selbst tief in unsere Verwaltungsprozesse hinein und übersetzt sie in digitale Workflows, in denen AI echten Mehrwert liefert statt Feature-Kosmetik.

- Du treibst eigene Themen end-to-end: vom Problemverständnis über Prototyp und Test bis zum Rollout – inklusive der Frage, ob wir überhaupt Software brauchen oder erst den Prozess ändern.

- Du validierst Annahmen mit Kunden und internen Nutzern – lieber ein schneller Test mit drei Verwaltern als ein perfektes Konzeptdokument.

Beispielhafte Projekte

- AI Co- und Auto-Pilot für unsere Property Manager

- Mobile App für Eigentümer und Mieter mit voller Transparenz über Finanzen

- Deutschlandweit genutzter Control-Tower für das Leadership Team

Das bringst du mit

- Berufserfahrung: Mind. 8 Jahre im Produktmanagement im Tech- oder Startup-Umfeld

- Erfahrung im Aufbau von Produktteams und Produktprozessen, idealerweise in einer frühen Phase oder in einem skalierenden Startup, und Erfahrung außerhalb der Beratung

- Hands-on-Mindset: Du willst selbst Produkte bauen und nicht nur Teams führen

- Eine klare Haltung dazu, wie AI die Zusammenarbeit von Produkt, Engineering und Design verändert, und Lust, das praktisch auszuprobieren

- Starke analytische Fähigkeiten und klare Priorisierung: Du denkst Business-Ziele und Nutzerbedürfnisse zusammen

- Bonus: Erfahrung im PropTech oder in prozessorientierten Geschäftsmodellen

- Bonus: Erfahrung damit, analoge, fragmentierte Prozesse gemeinsam mit Nutzer:innen vor Ort zu digitalisieren

- Bonus: Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen Entwickler:innen, Designer:innen und Verwalter:innen und zwischen Detail und Gesamtbild

- Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, hohe Verbindlichkeit und Eigenverantwortung

- Starkes Kommunikationsvermögen & Offenheit für neue Herausforderungen und digitale Tools

- Deutsch: C1 oder höher & Englisch: C1 oder höher

Das bieten wir

- Modernes Setup: MacBook, iPhone und moderne Tools von Tag eins

- Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten ohne Mikromanagement

- Hybrides Arbeiten

- Urban Sports Club Zuschuss

- Regelmäßige Team-Events, Team-Lunches und Getränke im Büro

Bewerbungsprozess

- Intro Call (ca. 30 Min.) mit Recruiting

- Kennenlerngespräch (ca. 30 Min., remote)

- Fachgespräch mit Tech inklusive erstem Teil der Fallstudie (remote)

- Vor Ort in Berlin: zweiter Teil der Fallstudie und Kennenlernen von Kolleg:innen aus verschiedenen Teams

- Finales Gespräch mit der Geschäftsführung

- Angebot

Eckdaten

- Standort: Berlin

- Anstellungsart: Angestellte/r

- Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit

- Arbeitsmodell: Hybrid

- Büroregelung: 2 Tage pro Woche im Büro in Berlin

BTT Health manufactures medical devices for bone health. Moreover, it manufactures and distributes Bone4ce/Melmak for bone regeneration, both with distribution partners in the US, Canada, Australia and Central Europe. 

In summer 2026, an investor group acquired the company. Now we're rebuilding BTT Health as a start-up with proven products: a sharper strategy, new markets and a broader portfolio. You'll work directly with our Head of Growth, one of the investors – and since we use AI to move fast as a small team, that's exactly where you come in.

What You'll Do 

AI-Powered Workflows & Automation

● Spot the potential – find tasks in marketing, sales and admin that AI chatbots and agents can do faster and better

● Build it – set up AI workflows and automations (e.g. Power Automate, Zapier, HubSpot), from prototype to daily use

● Digitize sales – help shape our CRM, sales reporting and dashboards

● Enable the team – create prompt templates, quick guides and mini-trainings

Sales & Business Development

● Partner support – help manage our distribution partners in the US, Canada, Australia and Central Europe

● New markets – research and qualify potential new distribution partners and markets

● Portfolio scouting – evaluate new products and technologies, from first research to a decision paper for management

● Deal prep – presentations, quotes, analyses and partner meetings

Marketing & Market Analysis (strategic focus)

● Campaigns & content – for our website, LinkedIn, newsletters and professional audiences – AI-assisted from idea to launch

● Market intelligence – research markets, competitors, trends and growth opportunities

● Science to story – turn clinical study data into clear content for partners, clinicians and patients

What You Bring

● Studies – Bachelor's or Master's student in business, industrial engineering, medtech, life sciences, informatics, healthcare management or similar

● Curiosity – real interest in medtech, medicine and technology – and in the business side

● AI-native – you use ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot & co. daily; Power Automate, Zapier or Python is a plus

● Structured thinking – analytical, well organized and confident in Excel and PowerPoint (old school, we know, but we use it and need it)

● Languages – fluent in English, German is a big plus but no requirement

● Start-up energy – hands-on, full of ideas, at home in a fast-paced start-up

● Availability – up to 20 hours/week (more during semester breaks) for min. 6 months

What We Offer

● €1,500 gross per month – based on 20 hours/week, adjusted pro rata for fewer hours

● Start-up spirit with substance – help rebuild a medtech company with established products and partners

● Real ownership – your own projects from day one that shape the rebuild

● Direct line to the top – work with our Head of Growth; flat hierarchies, fast decisions

● AI playground – test new tools and put your ideas into practice right away

● Hybrid & flexible – hours around your lectures; Kissing is 30 min by direct train from Munich Hbf

● Real impact – products for bone health (Marodyne LiV vibration therapy, LIPUS) and the option to write your thesis with us

How to Apply

Ready to help us rebuild BTT Health? Just send your CV – that's all we need. A short motivation letter is welcome but optional. Please mention your earliest start date. Bonus: tell us in two or three sentences one skill that would definitely help you to excel at this job (e.g., medtech knowledge, technical skills..). Humans will read your application; we do not use AI in the hiring process.

title: Senior AI Security Engineer
description:
Clariness is looking for a Senior AI Security Engineer (f/m/d) based Germany, UK, SA, or Serbia.
- Full-time; unlimited - 

About the role: 

This role is about building, operating and continuously improving Clariness’ security capabilities across applications, cloud infrastructure and AI systems. As our founding-level security hire, you will establish the security engineering function, define its priorities and work directly with engineering teams to embed effective security controls throughout our technology environment.

As a Senior AI Security Engineer, you would be responsible for: 

- Defining Clariness’ security engineering strategy and roadmap, and building and operating the security function across application security, cloud security, AI and LLM security, vulnerability management and supporting security tooling.

- Working directly with engineering teams on secure system design, threat modelling, penetration testing and vulnerability remediation, while embedding appropriate security controls into development processes and CI/CD pipelines.

- Owning AI security and governance across LLM-powered features, RAG systems and agentic pipelines, including assessing and mitigating risks covered by the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

- Designing and validating safeguards for AI agents, including sandboxing, privilege and access controls, secure tool use and adversarial red teaming of AI systems.

- Evaluating, deploying and continuously improving AI-powered security automation, including autonomous vulnerability triage, LLM-powered alert analysis, compliance evidence gathering and AI-assisted threat intelligence.

- Assessing commercial and open-source security tools based on effectiveness, operational fit and cost, and developing custom solutions where existing tooling does not meet Clariness’ requirements.

- Managing Clariness’ IT security compliance programme—including SOC 2 Type II, applicable EU AI Act high-risk obligations, GDPR Article 32 technical measures and GxP IT security controls—while maintaining audit-ready documentation and acting as the primary security liaison for external auditors, regulators, Legal and Compliance.

We would like you to have: 

- At least five years of hands-on experience in security engineering, application security or information security, with strong technical depth beyond advisory or governance responsibilities.

- Proven experience building or significantly developing a security programme within a product engineering environment, ideally as an early or founding security hire.

- Strong practical experience across application security, cloud security, secure software development, threat modelling, penetration testing, vulnerability management and security controls within CI/CD pipelines.

- Experience assessing, testing or implementing security controls for LLM-powered applications, RAG systems or agentic pipelines.

- Hands-on experience with AI agents, either building them for security automation or securing them through adversarial testing, sandboxing and privilege controls.

- Demonstrable compliance experience involving at least one SOC 2 audit cycle, GDPR programme ownership or implementation of EU AI Act requirements, including the ability to produce audit-ready documentation and work with external auditors.

- Experience in a regulated industry such as clinical research, pharmaceuticals, healthtech or fintech, with knowledge of GxP or comparable regulated data-handling requirements considered a strong advantage, alongside strong English communication skills at C1 level.

You may ask now, why should I work for you? Let us give you a few reasons – and you'll learn more during the process. 

- A varied and exciting job with a lot of personal responsibility in an international company, where you can develop and expand your skills.

- Professional and personal development opportunities - incl. personal development budget.

- Flexible working hours and mobile working.

- Regular team events and open feedback culture.

- A versatile field of activity and challenging projects.

- A supportive and open company culture, providing the opportunity to collaborate with a diverse and professional team.

- Impact healthcare by accelerating medical innovation through improved access to clinical trials, potentially bringing needed treatments to patients faster.

How to apply & what to expect:

- We aim to move promptly and keep you updated at every step.

title: Online Marketing Trainee (m/w/d)
description:
Hallo!

Wir sind Klickkonzept. Eine datengetriebene, KI-orientierte Online-Marketing-Agentur im Herzen von Frankfurt. Als Teil der internationalen Cosmo5-Gruppe betreuen wir großartige Marken aus E-Commerce, Luxus, Beauty und B2B. Was uns besonders macht? Echte Leidenschaft, eine offene Kultur und die Überzeugung, dass jeder Einzelne bei uns Großes bewirken kann.

Du stehst am Anfang deiner Karriere im digitalen Marketing und hast keine Lust auf Kaffee kochen oder monotone Dateneingabe? Du willst tief in die Mechanik von Google, Amazon, Meta & Co. eintauchen und verstehen, wie Unternehmen heute online wirklich Geld verdienen – von der Suchanzeige über den Social Feed bis zum KI-Chatbot, der Kaufentscheidungen prägt? Dann bist du hier genau richtig.

Unser Versprechen: Vom Anfänger zum Strategie-Designer 

Wir suchen keine fertigen Experten. Wir suchen smarte, analytische Köpfe mit dem unbedingten Willen zu lernen. In unserem Trainee-Programm bilden wir dich zum sogenannten „T-Shaped Marketer" aus. Was das heißt? Gemeinsam wählen wir deinen vertikalen Schwerpunkt – deine Spezialdisziplin, in der du echte Tiefe aufbaust:

- Paid Search (SEA) - bezahlte Sichtbarkeit in Google & Co.

- Paid Social - Performance-Kampagnen auf Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn & Co.

- Amazon Ads / Retail Media - Werbung dort, wo gekauft wird

- SEO & GEO - organische Sichtbarkeit in klassischen Suchmaschinen und in KI-Antwortsystemen wie ChatGPT, Gemini oder Google AI Overviews

Das ist der vertikale Strich im „T". Gleichzeitig bringen wir dir bei, wie das gesamte digitale Marketing-Ökosystem zusammenspielt (der horizontale Strich) – denn die spannendsten Ergebnisse entstehen genau dort, wo die Kanäle ineinandergreifen. Du lernst nicht nur, wie man Knöpfe in Werbekonten oder Tools drückt. Wir machen dich zum strategischen Berater, der versteht, wie messbarer Impact und echter Umsatz für Unternehmen generiert werden.

Aufgaben

Deine Lernkurve (Das erwartet dich):

- Das Handwerk lernen: Du lernst von der Pike auf, wie Kampagnen und Maßnahmen in deiner Spezialdisziplin aufgebaut, umgesetzt und optimiert werden - ob Paid-Kampagnen, Amazon-Werbung oder SEO/GEO-Maßnahmen.

- Operative Exzellenz: Recherche und Analyse, das Verfassen psychologisch cleverer Texte und Creatives, Zielgruppen- und Keyword-Definitionen sowie das Erstellen aussagekräftiger Performance-Reports werden zu deiner täglichen Routine.

- Analytisches Arbeiten: Du unterstützt unsere erfahrenen Account Manager bei Marktforschungen und Analysen. Du lernst, wie man Rohdaten interpretiert und in strategische Empfehlungen für den Kunden übersetzt.

- Verantwortung übernehmen: Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitung wirst du Tag für Tag und Woche für Woche mehr lernen und eigene Schwerpunkte in deinen Kundenprojekten setzen.

- KI verstehen: Du bekommst Einblicke in unser „AI Lab" und lernst, wie moderne Marketer Künstliche Intelligenz nutzen, um ihre tägliche Arbeit effizienter zu gestalten - und wie sich Sichtbarkeit im Zeitalter von generativer Suche neu definiert.

Qualifikation

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium (BWL, Marketing, Medienwissenschaften o.ä.) oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung - aber viel wichtiger ist uns dein Mindset!

- Du hast ein Faible für Zahlen. Daten schrecken dich nicht ab, sie wecken deine Neugier.

- Du hast ein gutes Auge fürs Detail, arbeitest strukturiert und verlierst auch bei komplexen Aufgaben nicht den Überblick.

- Du hast Lust auf eine steile Lernkurve, nimmst Feedback als Chance zum Wachstum und bringst dich proaktiv ins Team ein.

- Du hast idealerweise schon eine Idee, in welche Richtung es für dich gehen könnte - oder Lust, das gemeinsam mit uns herauszufinden.

- Erste Praktika oder Berührungspunkte im digitalen Marketing sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

- Deutsch fließend und sicheres Englisch.

Benefits

- Mentoring & Training: Du nimmst an zahlreichen internen und externen Schulungen teil. Erfahrene Kollegen stehen dir permanent als Mentoren zur Seite.

- Fokus-Squads & Teamspirit: Wir arbeiten in agilen, 6–7-köpfigen Fokus-Squads direkt an unseren Kunden. Das bedeutet für dich: kurze Wege, ein intensives Teamgefühl und gemeinsamer Erfolg, den ihr als Einheit feiert.

- Agenturleben, das Spaß macht: Eine harmonische Zusammenarbeit, flache Hierarchien und Kollegen, die sich gegenseitig pushen. Dazu Teamevents, kostenlose Getränke und Snacks.

- Flexibilität: Auch als Trainee genießt du bei uns flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice.

- Internationale Luft: Durch unser Netzwerk von 28 Partnerbüros arbeitest du in einem wirklich globalen Umfeld.

- Die Perspektive: Unser klares Ziel ist es, dich nach erfolgreichem Abschluss deines Traineeships als festen Junior Manager in deiner Spezialdisziplin in unser Team zu übernehmen.

Bist du bereit für diese Herausforderung?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Ein klassisches Anschreiben ist kein Muss – zeig uns in deinem Lebenslauf oder in ein paar persönlichen Zeilen, warum du für das digitale Marketing brennst und warum Zahlen deine besten Freunde sind. Verrate uns dabei gern, welche Disziplin dich am meisten reizt (oder ob du dich bewusst noch nicht festlegen willst).

Bei uns zählt Vielfalt. Wir leben Inklusion, Respekt und Chancengleichheit.

Wir sind DGX, ein kleines Team aus Energieberatern und Fördermittelexperten. title: ZFA/ZMV für Customer Success (m/w/d) - Dental Startup - Hybrid oder Remote

Du hast selbst am Empfang gestanden, Recalls abtelefoniert oder HKPs hinterhergejagt? Dann weißt du genau, wie viel Zeit dabei verloren geht. Bei uns machst du aus dieser Erfahrung deinen Beruf. Das erwartet dich

- Begeistern statt verkaufen: Du zeigst Praxen, welche Funktionen ihnen noch mehr Zeit sparen, und hilfst ihnen, Roger voll auszuschöpfen.

- Mitgestalten: Dein Feedback aus der Praxis fließt direkt in unser Produkt. Bei uns wird gehört, was du sagst.

- Im Team wachsen: Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Product und Support zusammen und entwickelst Prozesse mit uns weiter.

Das bringst du mit

- Erfahrung als ZFA, ZMV oder an der Rezeption einer Zahnarztpraxis

- Lust auf Digitalisierung: Du musst kein Technik-Profi sein, aber neugierig und offen für neue Tools

- Freude daran, Menschen zu erklären, zu motivieren und zu begleiten

- Empathie, Geduld und eine klare, freundliche Kommunikation

- Hands-on-Mentalität: Du packst an und übernimmst gern Verantwortung

- Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau, gute Englischkenntnisse

Das bieten wir an

- Raus aus der Praxis, rein ins Startup: Kein Schichtdienst am Behandlungsstuhl, sondern ein moderner Job mit Zukunft

- Hybrides Arbeiten und ein schönes Office mitten in Berlin (Münzstraße 21, 10178 Berlin) - remote möglich

- Strukturiertes Onboarding & Mentoring: Wir bringen dir alles bei, was du über Software und Customer Success wissen musst

- Echte Entwicklungschancen in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen

- Attraktives Gehalt - erfolgsorientiert und wettbewerbsfähig

- Ein Team, das zusammenhält: junges Team, kurze Wege, flache Hierarchien, viele Kolleg:innen mit Praxishintergrund

description:

Das individuell geltende Mindestentgelt ergibt sich aus der Einstufung und den anrechenbaren Vordienstzeiten. Wir sind ausdrücklich bereit, über diesem Mindestentgelt zu bezahlen.

Über uns

Lexaru ist ein junges GovTech-/LegalTech-Startup, das Verwaltungsprozesse mit modernen Anwendungen digitalisiert. Unsere Produkte unterstützen Sachbearbeiter:innen im Verwaltungsalltag und tragen zu effizienter Verwaltung und besseren Services für Bürger:innen bei.

Wir entwickeln Fachanwendungen für Kommunal- und Landesverwaltungen und verbinden moderne Produktentwicklung mit KI-gestützten Funktionen in sicheren und nachvollziehbaren Systemen.

Unterstützt werden wir unter anderem durch das Legal Tech Colab der TU München und die Plattform AI Nation.

Was wir dir bieten

Du arbeitest remote-first mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direktem Austausch mit den Gründern. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen und gestaltest gesellschaftlich relevante Produkte für die öffentliche Verwaltung mit.

Wir unterstützen deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung durch praktische Erfahrung, regelmäßiges Feedback und eigene Projekte.

Deine Entwicklung gestalten wir gemeinsam mit dir – durch technische Spezialisierung, wachsende Verantwortung oder Führungsaufgaben.

Deine Aufgaben

Produkt & Entwicklung

Du entwickelst Full-Stack Features und vollwertige interne Tools von der Idee über Architektur, Implementierung und Testing bis zum Rollout. Dazu gehören die Gestaltung einfacher UI/UX und das notwendige Backend Engineering. Du baust schnelle MVPs und entwickelst ausgereifte Funktionen für den produktiven Einsatz.

AI / LLM

Du konzipierst und entwickelst LLM-basierte Funktionen und agentische Workflows und integrierst sie in unsere Produkte. Dabei nutzt du Prompt- und Context Engineering, RAG, Tool Calling und strukturierte Modellausgaben. Du triffst Architektur- und Modellentscheidungen, entwickelst geeignete Evaluierungen und stellst durch Guardrails, Logging und Monitoring einen zuverlässigen Betrieb sicher. Qualität, Laufzeit und Kosten verbesserst du anhand messbarer Ergebnisse.

Architektur & Betrieb

Du wirkst an der Architektur unserer Plattform (Services, Datenmodell, Security) mit, verantwortest gemeinsam mit uns Deployment, CI/CD und Monitoring und achtest auf Security, Performance, Kosten und Stabilität im produktiven Betrieb.

Zusammenarbeit & Produktdenken

Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern und Kunden zusammen, übersetzt Nutzerbedürfnisse in technische Lösungen und klare User Stories und bringst eigene Ideen ein. Du wirkst an der Priorisierung mit und triffst pragmatische technische Entscheidungen.

Dein Profil

Das bringst du mit

- Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in professioneller Full-Stack Produktentwicklung. Als Richtwert gelten vier oder mehr Jahre. Auch mit weniger Erfahrung freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung, wenn du uns von deiner Expertise überzeugst.

- Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript und modernen Frontend-Frameworks, idealerweise Svelte oder Vue.

- Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in modernen Backend-Technologien wie Node.js oder Django.

- Du hast Erfahrung mit relationalen Datenbanken, idealerweise PostgreSQL, einschließlich Schema-Design und Grundlagen der Performanceoptimierung.

- Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und im Betrieb LLM-basierter Anwendungen, einschließlich RAG, Tool Calling und strukturierter Modellausgaben. Du kannst KI-Workflows eigenständig entwerfen, integrieren und ihre Qualität durch systematische Evaluation und Fehleranalyse weiterentwickeln.

- Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig, kommunizierst klar und bringst Aufgaben zu Ende. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen.

- Du möchtest verstehen, wie Fachverfahren in Verwaltungen funktionieren, um sinnvolle UIs und Nutzerflüsse zu bauen.

- Du kannst in einer frühen Phase mit wenigen Prozessstrukturen selbst priorisieren und Entscheidungen treffen.

- Du führst saubere Dokumentation, zum Beispiel Architektur-Notizen, ADRs und Onboarding-Docs.

- Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess

Wir gehen den Bewerbungsprozess Schritt für Schritt mit dir durch. Du weißt dabei immer, wo du gerade stehst und was als Nächstes folgt.

- Bewerbung über das Formular

Nach erfolgreicher Bewertung deiner Bewerbung laden wir dich ein, einen vertraulichen Take-Home Case zu bearbeiten.

In einem zweiteiligen Gespräch besprechen wir deinen Case und deine Bewerbung einschließlich konkreter Vergütungsmodelle.

title: (Senior) Operations Manager // AI Music Video Platform
description:
Neural Frames is a leading AI music video generator, turning any song into a fully produced music video in minutes. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and generating more than $7M in annualized revenue. Our ambition is to build a category-defining company that helps tens of millions of audio creators visualize and promote their work.

We've got here with a small team and very little overhead. Now we're growing quickly, and the operational side of the company - finance, people admin, tooling, office, contracts - run through the founder and Founders Associate. We're looking for the person who takes that over and makes it quietly reliable.

This is a hands-on role. You'll be the one the tax firm calls, the one who makes sure a new hire is on payroll and has a laptop and every tool on day one, the one who knows when every contract and insurance renews, and the one who fixes reconciliation mess instead of filing a ticket about it. You'll work directly with the founder, alongside our Founder's Associate and with our external accountants and virtual assistant.

Tasks

- Own finance operations: be the point of contact for our tax firm and payroll provider, run the monthly close inputs, keep Stripe invoicing, refunds and credit notes clean and reconciled, and resolve open questions before they reach the founder

- Assemble a monthly numbers pack - revenue, cash, margin, cloud costs, payroll, headcount - from Stripe, the accountants and our internal data

- Own people administration: contracts, probation periods, holidays, absence and time tracking, documents and compliance. Be the person the team asks about payslips, holiday balances and contract

- Manage our virtual assistant and the work we outsource

- Own tool access, equipment and IT: accounts, licences, laptops, security basics, and the day-one setup for every new hire from the onboarding checklist

- Own the office: lease, supplies, equipment, access, the practical things that make the place work

- Track every recurring vendor, contract, insurance and compliance obligation in one place so nothing depends on somebody remembering it

- Handle the booking, budget and logistics behind team events and the annual offsite

Requirements

- You have 3–6 years of experience in operations, finance operations or people operations at a small, fast-growing company, and have been the person who kept it running

- You have personally owned the relationship with an external tax firm and payroll provider, including monthly close and the questions that come with it

- You are hands-on with Stripe or a comparable payment system and understand invoices, refunds, credit notes and reconciliation; DATEV experience is a strong plus

- You are familiar with Personio or a similar HRIS and know German employment administration

- You make things tidy without being asked, close loops reliably, and are slightly allergic to loose ends

- You are comfortable making small decisions on your own and bringing the founder only the ones that need him

- You communicate clearly in German and English

- You are based in Berlin and can join us in the office at least four days per week

Bonus points:

- Experience in consumer subscription or SaaS, especially with Stripe at volume and international VAT

- Google Workspace, Notion, Slack, and Linear administration

- You have worked in both a structured company and a scrappy startup and know what is worth copying from each

How we measure success

Within your first month, you’ve audited all recurring finance, admin, and tooling tasks currently handled by the founder, agreed on clear ownership of what you’ll take over, established yourself as the main point of contact for our tax firm, and mapped every vendor, contract, and compliance deadline.

Within 90 days, finance operations, people admin, tool access, and office management run smoothly without input from the founder or Founder's Associate. The founder has received the monthly financial numbers pack twice without having to put it together himself. Our Founder's Associate can hand you a new hire, and you'll have them on payroll, fully equipped, and ready to go within a day.

Within a year, a new hire can be contracted, paid, equipped, and fully onboarded into our systems without any involvement from the founder. No contract renewal or compliance deadline has been missed, and the company has scaled significantly without operational processes becoming a bottleneck.

Benefits

VSOPs and profit sharing, bi-weekly team lunches, regular team events, an annual summer offsite, learning and development support, productivity tools, a headphone allowance, Deutschlandticket, and a €5,000 referral bonus.

Neural Frames is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives, and are committed to building an inclusive and supportive workplace.

title: Working Student - LLM Quantization & Inference Performance
description:
About Tensordyne (formerly Recogni) 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

Role summary 

How much numerical precision does an LLM need, and where in the model architecture does it matter most? When does quantization improve runtime, and what does it cost in model quality?

We’re looking for a motivated working student to help turn these questions into experiments and experiments into maintainable code. You’ll explore optimization methods and build reusable evaluation tooling. You’ll work closely with our quantization, compiler, and runtime engineers, and your findings will directly influence how we optimize models for Tensordyne hardware.

What you will do 

- Model quality evaluation: Measure how low-precision computation affects performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks. Diagnose where quantization has the greatest impact.

- Quantization research: Implement and compare post-training quantization methods to improve inference efficiency while preserving task accuracy.

- Build reproducible tooling: Automate evaluations, track configurations and results, and make experiments accessible to engineers and AI agents.

- Measure runtime performance: Characterize latency, throughput, and memory usage to understand bottlenecks under different deployment scenarios.

A first project could involve exploring the quality–performance Pareto frontier of a Qwen or LlaMa model. You’ll experiment with 16-bit, 8-bit, and 4-bit quantization configurations to find the best runtime-quality tradeoff.

Core qualifications 

- Current enrollment in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related master’s degree program.

- Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including the ability to understand and modify model implementations.

- Effective use of AI coding tools and critical review of their output.

- An experimental mindset: you can formulate hypotheses, design comparisons, and draw careful conclusions from noisy results.

- Clear communication and the ability to present experimental findings and technical tradeoffs to the team.

Strong pluses: experience with quantization, LLM evaluation, performance profiling, or inference optimization.

This role is for you if you thrive on responsibility, learn quickly, and are naturally proactive .

What we offer

Join a deep-tech team building the next generation of AI inference systems. Put your university knowledge into practice with leading open-source LLMs, deepen your understanding of quantization and inference optimization, and build skills in experimental design, software engineering, and AI coding tools. You’ll own a focused project, receive close mentorship from experienced engineers, and have room to explore ideas that shape our optimization methods.

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values 

- Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.

- Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone.

- Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.

- Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.

- Own it and get it done. Results matter!

- Make each person better together than they would be as an individual.

- Embrace each other’s differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. 

A note to recruitment agencies: Please do not contact Tensordyne employees or leaders regarding this role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees associated with unsolicited submissions.

You’ll build and manage co-sell and marketplace programmes with AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud, and build joint GTM and delivery motions with Regional and Global Systems Integrators. The goal: get ElevenLabs deeply embedded in hyperscaler partner networks and SI practices, so that when enterprises modernize their contact centers or build on cloud infrastructure, ElevenLabs is the natural AI voice layer, and partners have both the incentive and the capacity to sell and deliver it.

- Partner-sourced pipeline: qualified opportunities sourced or co-sold through hyperscaler and SI field teams each quarter

- Field activation: measurable engagement with hyperscaler sellers and SI client partners and delivery teams, not just BD or alliance leads, translating to warm intros and joint account planning

Requirements

- 8+ years in technology partnerships, alliances, or GTM roles within SaaS or cloud, with direct experience running hyperscaler partner programmes and SI/GSI partnerships

- Hands-on experience with hyperscaler co-sell programmes (AWS ISV Accelerate and ACE, Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Programme, Google Cloud Partner Advantage or equivalent) and marketplace operations (listings, private offers, commit burndown). You know how field co-sell actually works, not just the theory

- A builder mindset: experience creating co-sell and SI motions from 0→1, rather than inheriting a mature programme

Recare is one of the leading digital startups in the German healthcare industry and has set itself the task of rethinking healthcare with a platform for digital care coordination. We search, find and coordinate capacities so that the healthcare actors have more time for their patients.

Renowned hospitals and hospital groups such as Vivantes, Sana Kliniken AG, München Klinik, Hannover Medical School and Essen University Hospital are among Recare’s customers and use the Recare platform.

We believe artificial intelligence will transform healthcare more profoundly than any technology since the internet, and we’re building that future today, not tomorrow. While the German healthcare sector has historically focused on the risks of new technologies, we see an unprecedented opportunity to solve the industry’s most pressing challenges with AI. With most German acute hospitals now using the Recare platform, we take our leadership responsibility seriously: we’re helping clinics achieve what once seemed impossible, from automation of administrative workflows with the Recare AI platform to unlocking billions in value through predictive analytics. The potential is real, the technology is ready, and the time is now.

Role & team summary

As a senior member of the AI team, you will work on building cutting-edge agentic systems that work reliably in production environments where privacy and correctness are top priorities. This is a hands-on role: you will own key AI initiatives end to end and work across products, since the hardest problems here span more than one team.

Our team is small but growing fast; we are highly independent and hold ourselves accountable for the quality of our work. - GenAI observability: Set up and improve logging, tracing, metrics, dashboards, and prompt management for our AI systems.

- Safeguarding health data: Embed security best practices and uphold compliance to protect sensitive health information.

- Technical direction: Track new AI developments, turn the promising ones into production-ready implementations, and help set the direction of our AI work.

What we’re looking for

- 8+ years of relevant industry experience, with a strong AI/ML background, at senior level or above.

- Hands-on experience designing, shipping, and operating LLM-powered products (RAG, agents) in live production. Research projects and prototypes alone aren’t enough here; we want to hear about systems real users depended on. If your background is in productionizing traditional ML systems rather than LLMs, we still want to hear from you.

- Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation, such as golden datasets, LLM-as-a-judge, or offline and online metrics, and with systematically improving prompts and models.

- Solid deep learning experience applied to real-world problems, with a focus on system-level integration rather than model training alone.

- Strong coding skills across the stack. Ours includes Python, Go, GitHub Actions, and AWS, and you’re comfortable reading and fixing code outside the main codebase.

We are seeking a highly skilled Principal Statistician to lead statistical activities for clinical trials. This role requires hands-on statistical expertise, strong communication skills, and the ability to independently lead projects while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Join our team: you can be part of making a difference in peoples' lives and experience a fulfilling and rewarding career! 

Key Responsibilities 

- 
Lead and provide statistical support for clinical studies. 

- 
Act as the lead statistician on assigned studies, overseeing statistical strategy and deliverables 

- 
Author and review key statistical documents, including: 

- 
Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs) 

- 
Analysis Database Specifications (ADS) 

- 
Statistical sections of clinical study reports 

- 
Review and interpret analysis outputs, ensuring accuracy, quality, and regulatory compliance 

- 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Clinical, Programming, Data Management, and Regulatory 

- 
Provide guidance and oversight to statistical programmers as needed 

- 
Communicate statistical concepts, results, and risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

- 
Ensure adherence to regulatory standards (FDA, ICH, GCP) and company SOPs 

Required Qualifications 

- 
MS or PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, or a related field

- Demonstrated understanding and insight in statistics, drug development process, and relevant FDA regulations. 

- Pharmaceutical, CRO, or related industry experience with clinical trials, including interaction with Regulatory Agencies, especially the FDA.

We have over 28 years of proven high-quality delivery and results across all our services, with over 4,000 professionals in more than 20 countries across the Americas, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.

The continuous training keeps the resources qualified in terms of competence and expertise and gives all personnel the clear tools needed to manage both internal and client processes with the same methodology. The success of these core values is evidenced by our below industry average turnover rates. 

ClinChoice is an equal opportunity employer. We have based our success on attracting, developing, and promoting talent guided by diversity and inclusivity. Our employees come from very diverse backgrounds: gender, race, beliefs, and ethnicities. We recognize this is our strength and celebrate it.

About You 

We’re looking for a Senior Paid Social Manager who can strategically lead and scale our acquisition efforts across paid social channels in the UK and Europe. You’ll bring deep expertise in managing multi-million-pound budgets, a data-driven approach, and a proven track record of driving large-scale growth. You will be responsible for leading strategy, execution, and innovation in our paid social performance, ensuring we stay ahead of platform changes and industry trends. You’ll also have a clear view on how AI is changing performance marketing, and you’ll build a team that uses it well.

You’ll be a Meta expert, with hands-on experience across bidding strategies, audience segmentation, attribution, and creative testing. Additionally, you’ll have experience scaling campaigns across TikTok, Twitter, LinkedIn. You’ll be a martech-savvy professional, comfortable with tracking solutions, first-party data activation, working with MMPs and advanced attribution modeling.

You will play a key role in shaping Tide’s international expansion and long-term paid social strategy, ensuring that performance marketing continues to be a key growth driver. This is an opportunity to lead and grow Tide’s in-house Paid Social team as an AI-enabled team, making a significant impact on the business.

Some of the things you’ll be doing: 

- Owning and scaling paid social performance globally , ensuring we maximise efficiency and return on investment across all platforms.

- Managing and optimising multi-million-pound budgets , using advanced bidding strategies and automation tools to drive sustained growth.

- Building an AI-enabled paid social team , deciding which work AI should handle (creative production, reporting, bid and budget management) and which stays with people, then training the team to work that way.

- Embedding AI into creative and testing workflows , using generative tools to develop concepts, copy and variants faster, with clear quality, brand and compliance checks.

- Using AI and automation across the account , from platform tools such as Advantage+ to custom scripts, agents and reporting workflows that cut manual work.

- Developing and executing the paid social roadmap , identifying new opportunities, testing innovative strategies, and expanding our presence across emerging platforms.

- Driving a full-funnel approach , from awareness campaigns to high-intent lead generation and conversion, leveraging creative and audience insights.

- Collaborating with cross-functional teams (Data, Product, Web, Creative, and more) to align paid social strategies with Tide’s wider growth objectives.

- Championing attribution and measurement , ensuring best-in-class tracking, incrementality testing, and first-party data activation.

- Leading creative strategy , working closely with designers and copywriters to continuously test and optimise assets for performance.

- Staying ahead of industry changes , including privacy regulations (SKAD, ATT, IFDA), AI-driven platform updates , and new advertising solutions.

- Building and mentoring a high-performing, AI-literate paid social team , shaping the function as we scale both in the UK and internationally.

You’ll be a great fit if: 

- You have 7+ years of experience in paid social marketing, managing large-scale campaigns across multiple platforms.

- You have a proven track record of driving large volumes of B2B acquisition through paid social.

- You’re an expert in Meta advertising (Facebook & Instagram), with deep knowledge of bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and ad creative best practices.

- You have extensive hands-on experience with LinkedIn Ads, Twitter, TikTok, and other secondary paid social platforms.

- You’re highly analytical, comfortable with incrementality testing, MMM, and data-driven decision-making.

- You have strong technical knowledge of tracking solutions, attribution modeling, and martech tools (Appsflyer, GA4, GTM, CDPs, Looker/Tableau, etc.).

- You have hands-on experience using AI in marketing, such as generative tools for creative and copy, LLMs for analysis, and automation for reporting and optimisation.

- You have experience building or leading a team that uses AI day to day, including setting standards, sharing prompts and workflows, and measuring the productivity gain.

- You have a test-and-learn mindset, with a structured approach to experimentation and optimisation.

- You can effectively communicate complex insights, using data visualisation tools to tell compelling performance stories.

- You have experience managing agency relationships, but also thrive in an in-house, hands-on environment.

- You’re a natural leader, with experience mentoring and growing a team of paid social professionals.

- Fluency in a second language (French or German) is preferable.

title: Software Engineer I
description:
At OneStream, we're on a mission to empower every Finance organization and professional to exceed their potential. Our global teams span continents, cultures, and time zones, united by a shared purpose as we build the operating system for modern Finance and help organizations move with greater speed, clarity, and confidence.

That mission comes to life through our people. Behind every innovation, customer success, and milestone are talented people working together to make a difference. That's why we're looking for people who are bold enough to think big, authentic in how they lead and collaborate, curious about what's possible, and committed to delivering results. 

Want a closer look before you apply? Explore our Careers site to learn more about our people, culture, and benefits.

SUMMARY 

OneStream Software delivers a unified Corporate Performance Management (CPM) platform designed to meet the complex financial, operational, and analytical needs of large enterprises. OneStream operates at enterprise scale, supporting mission-critical workloads for the Office of the CFO across highly regulated industries. 

The OneStream platform is built on a sophisticated technology stack that includes distributed, multi-threaded services, OLAP and multidimensional data models, modern web frameworks, SQL-based persistence, and increasingly cloud-native, SaaS-oriented architecture on Microsoft Azure. 

The Software Engineer designs, develops, tests, and maintains software components within OneStream, building high-quality features using established design patterns and best practices. This role owns assigned features through the full software development lifecycle, collaborates with senior engineers, Product, and Quality Assurance, and develops user interfaces, APIs, and data access logic. The Software Engineer participates in code reviews and assists in diagnosing and resolving defects and production issues to ensure reliable, high-performing solutions and positive customer experience. Success in this role is measured by code quality, reliability, learning velocity, and the ability to deliver well ‑ scoped features safely and predictably. 

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

- Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality software components within OneStream solutions. 

- Implement features using established design patterns and best practices under guidance from senior engineers. 

- Contribute to UI development using modern UI frameworks including Angular, React, and Blazor. 

- Develop and integrate APIs and services following RESTful standards and practices. 

- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code with appropriate unit test coverage. 

- Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate development, refactoring, test creation, and documentation, while validating AI-generated output for correctness, security, and architectural alignment. 

- Participate in peer code reviews to improve code quality and consistency. 

- Assist in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving software defects across development and test environments. 

- Collaborate with Product, QA, and other engineering team members to deliver features that meet functional and quality expectations. 

- Follow established SDLC, security, and compliance protocols 

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE 

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

- 2–4 years of professional software development experience. 

- Experience with object-oriented programming and the Microsoft technology stack, including C#, .NET, and ASP.NET. 

- Basic experience with modern UI frameworks such as Angular, React, Blazor, and WPF. 

- Familiarity with data formats and markup languages such as JSON and XML. 

- Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL fundamentals. 

- Experience using source control systems (Git) and participating in CI/CD workflows. 

- Ability to write and review unit tests to validate functionality. 

PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE 

- Experience building enterprise or platform-oriented applications. 

- Familiarity with cloud ‑ hosted or SaaS ‑ based systems. 

- Introductory experience with automated testing practices. 

- Azure Fundamentals or entry-level Azure certification. 

- Familiarity with Cursor, Claude Code, etc. 

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES 

- Solid understanding of software development fundamentals and object-oriented design. 

- Ability to learn new technologies and frameworks quickly. 

- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. 

- Effective written and verbal communication skills. 

- Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment. 

- Attention to detail and commitment to code quality. 

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES 

There are no supervisory responsibilities required for this role. 

TRAVEL 

Travel Requirement: Regular travel is not expected for this position 

#LI-Remote #LI-KA1

Total compensation is based on experience, skills, and location using objective, job-related criteria. Additional variable compensation and benefits may apply. 

Gross annual base salary

€49.000 — €64.000 EUR 

All candidates must be legally authorized to work for any company in the country where this position is located without sponsorship. 

OneStream Software is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations, and ordinances.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Event Streaming Systems
description:
Our Global Structure 

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do.

Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and merchants every day. From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo’s (& Doordash’s) growth at scale.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Event Streaming Systems team. This is a hybrid role.

In this role, you’ll provide technical leadership for the event streaming infrastructure that powers business-critical workflows across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt. You’ll help define the long-term direction of our messaging and streaming platforms, lead high-impact technical initiatives across teams, and raise the reliability, scalability and operational excellence bar for Tier-0 infrastructure.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Event Streaming Systems team within the broader Storage organisation. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, Event Streaming abstractions (internally called EventBus), messaging platform capabilities, and future streaming technologies. The team also partners closely with Database Reliability, Storage, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure teams to ensure our most critical data and messaging systems remain reliable, operable and cost-efficient at global scale.

These systems support Tier-0 workflows and are foundational to how engineering teams build reliable, event-driven products at scale.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

- Define and drive the technical vision and roadmap for our event streaming and messaging platforms, balancing reliability, scalability, cost, operability and developer experience.

- Lead team-level and cross-team initiatives for Kafka, EventBus and related streaming infrastructure, from ambiguous problem definition through architecture, delivery, rollout and adoption.

- Act as a trusted technical advisor for Kafka, messaging, storage-adjacent and DBRE-related platform decisions across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.

- Design durable, extensible systems and platform capabilities that can be leveraged by other engineers and teams, reducing duplicated effort and operational risk.

- Lead the resolution of complex distributed systems problems, including reliability incidents, performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, data-safety risks and production-operability gaps.

- Raise the operational excellence bar for Tier-0 infrastructure through observability, automation, incident response, runbooks, operational readiness and continuous improvement.

- Proactively build alignment with partner teams, including EventBus, Storage, DBRE, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure, shaping joint goals and mitigating cross-org delivery risks.

- Mentor and grow engineers through technical guidance, design, feedback, code review, incident review facilitation and knowledge-sharing across the engineering community.

- Evaluate emerging streaming, storage and automation technologies, including AI-enabled operational tooling where appropriate, and champion pragmatic adoption where they can materially improve quality, velocity or efficiency.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in several of these areas and the judgment to lead others through ambiguity:

- Significant experience building, operating and evolving distributed systems in production, ideally for platform or infrastructure teams supporting critical workloads.

- Deep hands-on experience with Kafka or comparable event streaming systems as a platform, infrastructure service or business-critical production dependency.

- Strong technical leadership skills, with a track record of defining technical direction, shaping roadmaps and leading multi-engineer or cross-team initiatives.

- Ability to make and own technical decisions in ambiguous situations, using data, operational signals, customer needs and long-term system health to guide tradeoffs.

- Strong coding ability in Java, Go, Python or similar languages, with a focus on reliable, maintainable, observable and scalable production systems.

- Experience improving production reliability through automation, observability, capacity management, incident response, operational readiness and sustainable on-call practices.

- Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including Linux, networking, storage, JVM-based systems, fault tolerance, backpressure, capacity planning and performance tuning.

- A force-multiplier mindset: you create leverage through reusable technical foundations, clear documentation, strong engineering practices, mentoring and removing single points of failure.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence platform, infrastructure, product and reliability teams without relying on authority.

Nice to have

title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud
description:
Our Global Structure 

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.

We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.

This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.

We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.

This role will be based in London , UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.

What you'll do:

- Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.

- Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.

- Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.

- Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.

- Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.

- Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team.

- Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. In fraud, a silent failure is a loss event.

Our expectations:

- 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including backend services you have shipped and owned in production.

- 1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly.

- A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. Real-time decisioning comes with a latency budget, and you are keen to learn to build inside one.

- Hands-on experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, and some exposure to event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar).

- Willingness to operate what you build, including a share of on-call, with a pragmatic approach to reliability.

- Uses AI tooling in day-to-day development and can critically evaluate its output for correctness and quality.

Nice to have 

- Experience in fraud, risk, payments, lending, or financial crime, especially money movement fraud, bank account linking fraud, payout abuse, or lending fraud.

- Experience with rules engines, real-time feature stores, or ML model serving in a decisioning path.

- Background in Kotlin, Java, Python, or Node.js alongside Go.

- Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP).

- Experience working across multiple brands, regions, or regulatory regimes.

What we value 

- A product-oriented mindset. You think beyond the ticket, understand the "why" behind the work, and take a high level of responsibility for outcomes rather than output.

- Comfort with ambiguity. This is a new team on a new surface; parts of the charter are still being drawn, and you will help draw them.

- A track record of owning a project or feature end to end, especially in fast-paced environments.

- Clear and proactive communication, with a collaborative spirit. We work across three companies and several time zones, so we move fast, but we succeed together.

- An adversarial instinct. The best fraud engineers enjoy thinking like the attacker.

title: Senior Electrical Product Engineer - Maritime Engineering
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Role

The Senior Product Engineer is the primary electrical design engineering presence on the production floor, bridging the gap between design intent and production execution. The role sits within Platform Engineering and is based primarily at the production site, dispositioning nonconformances and Material Review Board (MRB) actions for electrical systems and sub-assemblies, resolving design questions in real time, and closing the loop between production and design so that issues get root caused and fixed at the source. To hold that authority credibly, this role also contributes to upstream electrical design - architecture, analysis, schematics, and design reviews - so they have the depth needed to make sound disposition decisions on the floor. This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong technical judgement in electrical and power systems engineering, the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced production environment, and the credibility to influence both design engineers and production teams. You will be expected to drive systemic improvements, cutting repeat nonconformances through changes to the design and documentation, as well as resolving individual issues.

Key Responsibilities

Production Floor Engineering Support

- Serve as the primary electrical design engineering point of contact on the production floor for assigned programs and product lines

- Represent the design authority at Material Review Board (MRB) for electrical systems, working with Quality and Manufacturing to minimise production hold time without compromising product safety and integrity

- Resolve production process-blockers, design ambiguities, and schematic/drawing interpretation issues in real time, exercising engineering judgement within defined authority boundaries

- Provide rapid-response engineering support and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to Production, Quality, and Test teams for electrical nonconformance resolution, use-as-is/rework/scrap decisions, and repair dispositions

- Identify and escalate systemic electrical design issues to core Design Engineering teams with clear problem statements, data, and recommended corrective actions

- Perform detailed electrical calculations, simulations, and analysis to support MRB dispositions, deviation requests, and use-as-is justifications (e.g. power budgets, thermal derating, circuit analysis, connector/harness assessments)

Electrical Design Contribution

- Contribute to the design, development and integration of electrical systems and subsystems, maintaining the technical depth needed to hold disposition authority on the production floor

- Perform detailed electrical calculations, simulations and analysis (circuit analysis, power budgets, thermal derating, EMC/EMI) to support both design decisions and MRB dispositions

- Participate in design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR) and contribute to system-level trade studies

- Collaborate cross-functionally with mechanical, software, and systems engineering to integrate electrical systems into the vehicle

Design Intent Translation & Multi-Site Support

- Support the translation of electrical design intent into production-executable work across multiple product versions, configurations, and manufacturing sites

- Support the stand-up and ramp of production at new or expanding manufacturing sites, ensuring electrical design engineering knowledge transfers effectively

- Raise and implement engineering changes to correct production issues that originate in the electrical design, through the Anduril configuration management and change process

- Feed production observations, failure modes and DFM/DFA opportunities back into Platform Electrical design work through structured feedback, prioritised using data

Design to Production Interface

- Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering on work instruction (WI) development, tooling validation, and First Article Inspection (FAI) activities for electrical assemblies, communicating the design intent and acceptance criteria

- Own the resolution of EBOM discrepancies found in production for electrical assemblies, and give engineering input to Configuration Management and Manufacturing Engineering on PLM workflows, BOM reconciliation and work instruction tooling

- Identify patterns across electrical nonconformances, test failures and build issues, and lead engineering root cause analysis and design corrective action implementation

- Collaborate on the improvement of key tool and functional interfaces (PLM workflows, digital work instructions, BOM reconciliation) that impact design-to-production efficiency

- Support the development of scalable frameworks for multi-site production: configuration management alignment, site-specific work instruction adaptation, and cross-site lesson-learned sharing

- Build repeatable playbooks for standing up production of new product variants, reducing ramp time and first-unit defects at each additional site

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Metrics

- Maintain strong working relationships with Quality, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering, and Program Management to ensure aligned priorities and rapid issue resolution

- Collate and drive corrective actions on design-originated production issues, providing data-backed prioritisation to core Design Engineering teams

- Participate in Production readiness reviews, design reviews (P&DFMEA, DFM/A/T) and engineering change assessments

Key Competencies & Attributes

- Engineering Judgement: Technical depth in electrical and power systems combined with production pragmatism - able to make sound engineering decisions under time pressure without over-engineering solutions

- Design Authority Integrity: You protect product safety and integrity under schedule pressure, understand the limits of your delegated authority and escalate when you should

- Cross-Functional Influence: Credibility with both design engineers and production operators; able to speak both languages and bridge communication gaps

- Autonomy & Initiative: Comfort with ambiguity and competing priorities in a fast-moving production environment; able to self-direct and prioritise without constant direction

- Systems Thinking: Thinks beyond individual issue resolution to identify patterns, root causes, and scalable solutions that prevent recurrence across sites and variants

- Communication: Clear, concise technical communication - written dispositions, engineering reports, and presentations to leadership

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field

- Proven experience in a senior role within defence, tech or any fast-paced environment, driving successful electrical engineering projects from concept to market launch

- Expertise in electrical engineering principles, techniques, and technologies, with a track record of delivering innovative solutions

- Proficiency in using industry-standard electrical design and simulation software

- Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate and mentor junior engineers while fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation

- Strong time management and organisational abilities, with a demonstrated ability to deliver projects on time and within budget

- Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to think creatively and adapt to diverse and evolving challenges

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Familiarity with fast paced environment best practices, including agility, adaptability, and the ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

- Ability to obtain and maintain a NV2 Australian Government Security Clearance

- Demonstrated hands-on experience working on or directly supporting a production floor

- Understanding of Material Review Board (MRB) processes, nonconformance management, and engineering disposition (use-as-is, rework, scrap, return to vendor)

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience designing electrical and power systems for unmanned vehicles

- Experience in the subsea or maritime domain

- Experience working on defence programs and familiarity with current Defence standards

- Previous experience as a Product, Sustaining, Liaison or Production Support Engineer with delegated design or disposition authority

- Experience with first article inspection (e.g. AS9102) and production test development

- Familiarity with IPC/WHMA-A-620 and/or IPC-A-610

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Job Overview: 
We are seeking a Manufacturing Test Engineer to join Anduril, working in a cutting-edge start-up environment to advance the state-of-the-possible in subsea robotics. The Manufacturing Test Engineer will be charged with developing and implementing high-fidelity, automated test processes on both the component and system level. Working closely with engineering staff and a team of skilled electro-mechanical technicians, this role is key to advancing our testing capabilities to ensure the highest levels quality are achieved as we continue drive scalability into our production operations.

About the Team 
Anduril’s Manufacturing team is producing the next generation of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles globally at rate. The Manufacturing Engineering team owns production readiness and process engineering across the Undersea Dominance product range — from core vehicle platform to specialised mission payloads, spanning mechanical and electrical hardware build through to full system integration & test.

About the Job 
You will own the test software, automation and tooling that proves every Dive-XL vehicle works before it leaves the building — the Python frameworks that drive instruments and vehicle hardware, the operator-facing GUIs that make complex test sequences safe and repeatable under production pressure, and the interlocks that protect people and product when the system is commanding real high-voltage DC. You will also own the infrastructure underneath: NixOS-based station builds, test result flow into MES, and the configuration management that keeps a fleet of test stations reproducible and rollback-safe. If you thrive hands-on — oscilloscopes and protocol analysers as often as a code editor — in a fast-paced environment where the architecture is yours to build, this role is for you.

title: Senior Manager, AI Architect
description:

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty.
