title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Building the intelligence behind Solskin

Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive?

We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow.

In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist.

What you will do

This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day.

Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better.

Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team. 

Lead what comes next : With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products. 

Our stack: 

- Backend: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch

- Frontend: React, TypeScript

- Hardware: C/C++, STM32 microcontrollers, Beckhoff PLCs

- Database: PostgreSQL (TimescaleDB)

- DevOps & Cloud: Linux, Docker, AWS, Grafana

What we are looking for

Required: 

- Education : MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or similar.

- Python : This is a must. You write clean Python that runs in production, on real systems.

- Embedded & Hardware: Shipped C/C++ on microcontrollers running on physical hardware; comfortable working with sensors, actuators, and basic electronics. 

- Applied AI & Control: Understanding of modern control and ML/RL methods, with hands-on PyTorch experience applied to physical or dynamic systems.

- Cloud & data : You are comfortable with PostgreSQL, Docker and AWS.

- Leadership attitude : You take ownership, make decisions, and want to grow as a leader.

- Languages : English. German is a big plus.

- Hybrid setting : You will be expected to be on-site at least three days per week, and sometimes at customers’ locations, to work on real products.

- Availability : 100%, as soon as possible.

- Work-permit: You need the right to work in Switzerland for this position.

Preferred: 

- Startup experience: You have worked in a startup before and know what that means.

- Building modeling and control: You have prior experience handling building data, modeling building dynamics, and developing building controllers; ideally with ML and RL tools. 

- Frontend: React and TypeScript.

Mindset: 

- Hands-on: You lead, and you still do the hard work yourself.

- Fast: You are pragmatic and iterate quickly. Things break, and plans change, and that doesn't scare you.

- Purpose: You care about climate and want to make buildings smarter.

Benefits

Impact: Your code runs on real buildings. You see the result of your work.

Ownership: A key role with a real say in our product and technology, and room to grow with the company.

Flexibility: Hybrid work and flexible hours. We like being in the Zurich office together, so plan for regular office days.

Team: A small, skilled, and down-to-earth team that helps each other out.

The reality: We are a startup. It is often messy; things rarely work the first time, and the workload is real. In return, you get a lot of freedom and responsibility from day one.

Sounds like you?

Send us your CV and a short document instead of a classic cover letter. It doesn’t need to be long, just enough for us to understand who you are and where you stand. Please cover these points:

- About you: A short description of yourself.

- Proud of: One thing you are really proud of, in a few sentences.

- Startup: Why do you fit a startup?

- Software meets hardware: Your experience where software and hardware come together.

- Juggeling many hats: You’ll rarely finish one thing from A to Z without interruptions: different stacks, different people, different projects, and on-site surprises. Describe a time your work was like that, and how you handled it.

title: Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
About Papers

Papers AG is a Swiss cyber security engineering house and an incubator for our product portfolio. We build device-level alternatives to centralized cloud and trust. Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it.

Your portfolio includes:

- Acurast: Decentralized confidential compute running on ordinary smartphones.

- Obsidio: A continuous, AI-assisted pentesting subscription. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks.

- Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets.

As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges.

Your role

We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline.

Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking.

If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you.

Success Metrics (First 90 Days) 

- 30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics.

- 60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows.

- 90 Days: Launch at least two multi-channel growth experiments and demonstrate a measurable reduction in CAC or an increase in content throughput.

Core Responsibilities 

1. Storytelling That Converts 

- Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy.

- Audience-First Messaging: Understand who the campaigns speak to (developers, technical decision-makers, business stakeholders or end users) and frame each capability around what that audience cares about, at the right level of technical depth.

- Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion.

- Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct.

2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution 

- Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers.

- Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel.

- Rapid A/B & Multivariate Testing: Design, set up, and evaluate rapid growth experiments (copy variants, landing page layouts, audience segmentation, offer positioning) on a weekly sprint cycle.

3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA 

- Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale.

- Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI-generated copy, visual assets, landing page content, and email sequences before deployment.

- Prompt Engineering & Template Optimization: Continuously iterate on, standardize, and version-control skills, design systems and context workflows to ensure output matches brand voice, compliance standards, and conversion best practices.

- Scale & Efficiency Metrics: Track content throughput, error rates, and time-to-market reduction, driving continuous improvement in pipeline efficiency.

4. Analytics, Attribution & Data Ops 

- Tracking Infrastructure: Implementation and maintenance of event tracking, pixel setups, UTM parameters, and server-side tracking across all digital properties.

- Attribution Modeling: Own multi-touch attribution models to accurately trace pipeline generation, conversions, and revenue back to specific campaigns, channels, and AI-driven experiments.

- Data Integrity & Governance: Regularly audit marketing data across CRMs, marketing automation platforms, and internal databases to clean anomalies and maintain a single source of truth.

- Performance Reporting: Build and manage real-time dashboards providing actionable insights into CAC, LTV, conversion rates, and ROI across experiments.

What We Are Looking For 

Essential Experience & Qualifications 

- 3–5+ Years in Growth/Marketing Operations: Proven track record in a fast-paced B2B or B2C growth environment, managing campaign ops, marketing automation, and technical data pipelines.

- Passionate Builder: You deeply identify with our products. We are a fast-moving, mission-driven team, and this role requires intrinsic dedication rather than a standard 9-to-5 mentality.

- Hands-on AI Tooling Expertise: Demonstrated experience applying modern LLMs and generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Higgsfield) into real-world marketing workflows, beyond simple basic prompts.

- Technical Analytics Proficiency: Deep hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and data visualization tools.

- Automation Skills: Proficiency with automation platforms to connect API endpoints and pass payload data reliably.

- CRM & Automation Platforms: Direct administration experience with platforms like Zoho.

Preferred Technical Skills 

- Basic technical understanding of Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS for lightweight API scripting, data manipulation and rapid landing page iterations

Mindset & Soft Skills 

- Systems Thinking: Ability to map out complex, multi-step processes and translate business requirements into efficient technical architecture.

- Agile Adaptability: Comfort operating in fast-paced sprint cycles with changing priorities and a bias toward continuous shipping and learning.

- Obsessive Attention to Detail: An eagle eye for QA; AI speeds up production, but your judgment ensures quality control and brand alignment.

Working Environment & Expectations 

- Execution Velocity: We prioritize shipping experiments quickly, learning from real-world data, and iterating fast.

- Tooling Ownership & Independence: You will have complete autonomy over our stack. We expect you to proactively recommend and implement the best modern automation and AI solutions. You define the tools you need to win.

- Asynchronous Communication: Clear documentation, meticulous task tracking, and transparent status updates are core to how we work, allowing you to manage your own time effectively.

Why join Papers? 

- Work with cutting-edge technology that actually matters with a team that is obsessed with redefining what cutting edge means.

- High ownership, low bureaucracy. Your voice drives the strategy, giving you the independence to define your own processes.

- Influence the Growth strategy from day one.

- Competitive compensation structure tied directly to your impact, with clear pathways for career growth.

- 25 days paid vacation per year.

- Regular team events and retreats (at least quarterly).

- Support for your ongoing learning and development.r

You’ll work closely with firmware, hardware and cloud colleagues, shape our CI/CD pipelines, and help improve how we build and deploy as we grow. It’s a hands-on role for someone who likes variety and wants to see their work running in real shipments.

📍 Location: We need you to be within commutable distance to Basel given the role requires 50%+ time spent on-site.

Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions.

Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide.

Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains.

Why SkyCell? 

🌱 Purpose-Driven Work: Make a real difference by contributing to a more sustainable future in global logistics and healthcare.

🚀 Innovation at Heart: Work with cutting-edge technology and be at the forefront of supply chain innovation.

🌎 Stronger together: Join a supportive team of talented individuals from over 40 countries, where we work together every step of the way.

💡 Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in our people – continuous learning and development are key pillars of SkyCell.

🏆 Award-Winning Culture: Join a workplace recognized for its commitment to excellence with a ‘Great Place to work’ award, as well as a Platinum Ecovadis rating highlighting our sustainability and employee well-being.

What You'll Do: 

- Design and implement embedded firmware for low-power IoT devices using C/C++ (RTOS or bare-metal)

- Integrate wireless communication technologies such as BLE, LoRa or Cellular

- Design, build and operate cloud-side ingestion pipelines and device fleet management systems for large-scale IoT deployments

- Contribute to the design and deployment of cloud architectures for IoT integrations

- Implement secure and reliable OTA update mechanisms for remote firmware management

- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for firmware and cloud components (e.g. GitHub Actions)

- Collaborate with colleagues across firmware, hardware and cloud teams

- Troubleshoot complex system-level issues across device, connectivity and cloud layers

- Contribute to architecture and process improvements based on emerging best practices

What You'll Bring: 

- Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

- Experience developing embedded firmware in C/C++ (RTOS or bare-metal), with a good understanding of common interfaces (I2C, SPI, UART)

- Experience with wireless protocols (BLE, LoRa or Cellular) and IoT communication protocols and data formats (MQTT, HTTP/REST, CoAP, Protobuf, JSON)

- Experience designing and operating cloud-based ingestion and device fleet management systems for connected IoT devices at scale

- Experience implementing OTA updates in production systems

- Proficiency in a backend language (e.g. Python, Go, Node.js or Java) for device integration, automation and diagnostics, with excellent system-level debugging and problem-solving skills

- Good written and spoken German and English

If you don't meet every requirement but bring relevant experience and skills, we'd still like to hear from you.

title: Solutions Consultant
description:
As OpenSpace's Solutions Consultant for Germany, Austria and Switzerland, you'll be the technical and commercial partner to our Account Executives. You'll win deals by proving the business value of OpenSpace, get new customers live quickly, and drive the adoption that turns first projects into long-term, growing accounts. You'll work across the whole customer lifecycle, from first demo through renewal, with regular visits to customer offices and job sites across the region.

What you will be doing 

- Owning the technical win with the Account Executive, from discovery and tailored demos through to a signed contract

- Scoping, running and closing out pilots and proofs of value, with clear success criteria agreed with the AE and the customer

- Finding and qualifying expansion opportunities in existing accounts and building pipeline with the AE

- Leading the value and ROI conversation at renewal and expansion, using usage data and customer outcomes to build business cases

- Onboarding new customers: project setup, capture training for field teams and admin training for project managers

- Driving adoption after go-live through usage reviews, project check-ins and value reviews with customer stakeholders

- Answering technical, security and data privacy (GDPR) questions, supporting tenders and RFPs, and advising on integrations such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma)

- Bringing market feedback to the Product team and building German-language enablement material with Marketing

What we are looking for 

- A bachelor's degree in civil engineering, construction management, architecture or a related field, or equivalent work experience

- 5+ years in a customer-facing role at a construction technology or AEC software company, or in project or site management at an owner or construction company

- A proven track record in pre-sales, solutions consulting or customer success with shared revenue targets

- Native German and business-fluent English, spoken and written

- Ability to travel regularly to customer offices and job sites across DACH

- A solid understanding of how construction projects run, from preconstruction to handover, including site documentation and progress tracking

- Experience with complex B2B sales cycles, value selling and qualification methods such as MEDDPICC

- Familiarity with construction software such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (Forma) and BIM tools

- Reality capture or 360° imaging experience is a plus

- Knowledge of the DACH construction market and its main contractors is a plus

How you like to work 

- Commercially minded: You spot expansion opportunities, build the ROI case and help the AE move deals forward. You can turn usage data into a clear story about customer value.

- A clear communicator: You adapt your message to site managers, project managers and executives, and you explain technical concepts in plain language.

- Organized and independent: You can run several onboardings and pilots at once, and you're comfortable in a small regional team that works closely with colleagues in other countries and time zones.

title: Computational Scientist / Scientific Machine Learning
description:
Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation, and control stack for the fusion energy reactors of the future.

Spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and backed by top investors, our technology enables reliable operation, real-time monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices. We are founded by world-class experts at the intersection of fusion physics, advanced control, and AI (ex-Google DeepMind, EPFL). We are assembling a founding engineering team in Lausanne to build our core technology platform.

We are looking for a Computational Scientist specialized in Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) to join our team. This job is for you if you know how to write numerical solvers that are fast, correct and differentiable end to end, and want to see them run against real plasma data and inside real control systems.

We are looking for a PhD-level or senior computational researcher for this role.

Responsibilities

- Design, implement and validate differentiable solvers in JAX for plasma physics problems such as free-boundary equilibrium, transport and state estimation.

- Make them robust and fast enough for production use via advanced numerical techniques for differential equation time stepping, as well as optimization of GPU/TPU performance.

- Using automatic differentiation for model calibration against experimental data, parameter estimation and controller design and optimization, working with our data and control engineers.

- Code ownership: quality, testing, verification against reference solutions, packaging and documentation.

Requirements

- Substantial code written in a differentiable framework. Our stack is in JAX, Julia or PyTorch experts are very welcome if they’re happy to switch.

- Strong background in numerical methods for ODEs and PDEs: discretisation, stiff and implicit solvers, nonlinear and sparse linear solvers.

- Demonstrated ability to operate at the frontier of SciML, Universal Differential Equations, Neural ODEs, and other emerging hybrid data-driven/mechanistic paradigms.

- Evidence of independent work at the highest level: a PhD or thesis, published code that is used by others, or an industry project you owned.

- Proficient using Agentic coding and other modern AI technologies to accelerate your work, while remaining accountable for the results.

Experience in the following fields an advantage but not strictly required:

- The JAX ecosystem: Diffrax, Equinox, Optax, Lineax.

- Plasma, fluid, electromagnetic, or other multiphysics simulation.

- Having led the design of a scientific codebase used by others.

What we offer

- Play a key role at a dynamic, fast-growing startup, shaping the technical solutions and products from the ground up.

- Build cutting-edge technology to monitor and control plasmas in real fusion devices, working side-by-side with leading plasma and control experts.

- Great working conditions, located in Lausanne, Switzerland, a city and country known for its high quality of life.

- Competitive salary and equity compensation and benefits including immigration assistance.

title: Senior C/C++ Low Latency Engineer
description:
Your job 

This role is crucial for our organization. Our Technology team is small and therefore you get a lot of responsibilities and freedom! As a C/C++ Engineer at Mathrix in the low latency environment, your focus will be on the code which facilitates the automated trades on various exchanges worldwide.

Our companies’ performance is highly dependent on the performance of our data processing pipelines. You will regularly need to appeal to all aspects of your developers’ skillset to find new and innovative ways to optimize your code. Some examples:

- low-latency networking code for fast communication with exchanges

- context-switch-free code

- design and implement custom data storage structures with minimalistic footprint

- data pipelines using a streaming paradigm

- complex trading logic for the decision engine with the lowest possible compute time

- re-implement existing code using advanced features of the CPU (SIMD)

To accommodate the growth of the company, we spend increasing efforts on the maintainability and manageability of our large, highly optimized and multithreaded codebases while preserving its main purpose (low latency). - extensive and thorough knowledge of C and C++ in Linux

- understanding what (GNU/Linux) system calls you invoke will do and cost

- knowledge of x64 hardware and how to use it efficiently

- understanding what storage structures to select or implement given their use (time complexity)

- ability to work with debuggers and profilers

- operative coding (git, documentation)

- ability to absorb from and provide knowledge to the team

- pro-active, a self-starter, honest, flexible and stress resistant

In addition to the above, having a background in one of the specializations below are nice to have:

- experience with network engineering; either (low latency) networking hardware deployment or networking protocol implementations

- experience with Big Data engineering and knowledge of Big Data best practices and implementations best suited for different use cases

title: Strategic Account Executive - Switzerland
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role 

We're looking for an experienced, driven Strategic Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs' growth across Switzerland's largest enterprises. Our ideal candidate has a well-established network and a proven track record of selling to C-level and senior decision-makers at major Swiss brands and is passionate about the transformative possibilities of AI voice technology.

- Passion for voice and audio AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers.

title: Junior adviseur bedrijfsovernames
description:
Ben jij het zonnetje in huis? En heb jij al affiniteit met de wereld van bedrijfsovernames? 

Lees dan vooral verder! Wij zoeken namelijk een junior adviseur bedrijfsovernames. Je bent - samen met een senior collega - verantwoordelijk voor het gehele overnameproces van MKB bedrijven.

Wat is je takenpakket? 

- Je stelt anonieme overname profielen en informatiememoranda op en controleert ze

- Je spreekt met geïnteresseerden, nadat deze door je collega’s gekwalificeerd zijn 

- Je voert onderhandelingsgesprekken met geïnteresseerden

- Je maakt de deal en het begeleidt het LOI-proces

- Je onderhoud korte lijnen met jouw klant (de ondernemer die zijn bedrijf gaat verkopen). Die voelt dat jij aan z’n kant staat.

We hebben specialisten op elk gebied van het bedrijfsovernameproces; waardebepalingen, juridische afwikkeling en het informeren van geïnteresseerden. Dit is dus allemaal al geregeld en hoeft dus niet alles zelf te doen. Ondanks dat dit niet bij jouw verantwoordelijkheden hoort, krijg je hier wel alles van mee. We werken namelijk als een team. Mocht je ervaring en interesse hier liggen, dan kunnen we je takenpakket hiermee uitbreiden. 

Wie is onze ideale kandidaat? 

- Je hebt affiniteit met overname processen

- Je communiceert op een natuurlijke en informele wijze met diverse partijen

- Je hebt affiniteit hebt met cijfers en je kunt uit de voeten met jaarrekeningen en financiële rapportages

- Je vind het leuk jezelf te verplaatsen in MKB ondernemers uit diverse sectoren en van allerlei niveau’s 

- Je hebt overredingskracht en geeft tegengas aan je klant wanneer het nodig is

- Je hebt een winnaarsmentaliteit en gaat daarvoor graag “the extra mile”

- Je kunt gemakkelijk tussen cases schakelen: bij een fulltime dienstverband werk je doorgaans aan 10-15 cases tegelijkertijd

Over Take 5 

Over het algemeen zijn ondernemers ongeduldige mensen. Het liefst is alles gisteren al gebeurd. Wij kennen het overnameproces. We zijn hierin deskundig en ervaren. Dat wil zeggen: we hebben alle expertise in huis om een MKB’er zo goed mogelijk mee te nemen en we doen dit al een hele tijd.

Het verkopen van een bedrijf doen MKB ondernemers maximaal 1-2 keer in hun leven. Ze staan hun kindje af. Dit is een emotioneel en spannend proces. Wij zijn toegewijd en pro-actief. We zijn streng op de kwalificatie en nemen alleen genoegen met het beste voor de ondernemer.

We zijn authentiek en gelijkwaardig. Dat wil zeggen: we gaan naast een ondernemer staan en nemen die stap voor stap mee. We gebruiken ons karakter en eigenaardigheden om de connectie met de ondernemer te maken. Hoe lekkerder je zelf in je vel zit, hoe beter je iemand kunt helpen.

Wat wij je bieden 

- Een hecht team waar jouw werk direct zichtbaar impact heeft

- Een omgeving waar keihard werken en keihard lachen hand in hand gaat 

- De ruimte om te mogen zijn wie je bent

- Veel verantwoordelijkheid en geen hiërarchisch gedoe

- Ruimte om te groeien in wat je nog niet kan maar wel wil leren

- Een werkomgeving waar ‘doen waar je energie van krijgt’ het aller-belangrijkste is

- Salaris en arbeidsvoorwaarden, daar komen we uit

Belangrijk om te weten: voor deze functie zoeken we iemand die in loondienst komt. Daar tegenover staat dat je alle verantwoordelijkheden en voordelen krijgt die horen bij ondernemerschap. Arrogant

title: Merchant Growth Specialist
description:

Full-time

About SOUS 

SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all.

Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Every order through that owned channel generates data that sharpens the next cycle of visibility, personalisation and retention, compounding in the restaurant's favour instead of the platform's.

Our long-term bet is simple. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. We are building the infrastructure to make the first outcome the default, not the exception.

We are a team of 27, working from our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre, and we are growing fast across the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa.

About the role 

Our promise to restaurants is simple: SOUS helps you grow. As our merchant base grows quickly, we want every single restaurant to see that growth in its numbers.

As Merchant Growth Specialist you make that promise real. You dive into each merchant's online performance, find the biggest opportunities and help them capture them. What you learn flows straight back into our product and playbooks.

Your team

description:
Bouw mee aan hoogwaardige hoorzorg binnen een zelfstandige optiekwinkel

Dan is dit misschien wel jouw volgende stap.

Premium hoorzorg, zoals het bedoeld is

Binnen onze zelfstandige optiekwinkels staat persoonlijke aandacht centraal. Onze klanten kennen ons vanwege onze deskundigheid, kwaliteit en service. Diezelfde benadering willen we verder uitbouwen binnen horen.

Daarom zoeken we een audicien die samen met ons wil bouwen aan een sterke audiotak. Afhankelijk van de situatie gaat het om het verder ontwikkelen van een bestaande klantenkring of het opbouwen van een nieuwe activiteit binnen een winkel waar al een vertrouwde klantenbasis aanwezig is.

Je krijgt daarbij de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen zoals jij vindt dat goede hoorzorg hoort te zijn: met tijd voor de klant, persoonlijke aandacht en premium hooroplossingen.

Wat maakt deze functie anders?

Je werkt in een professionele, persoonlijke omgeving waar niet de snelle verkoop, maar de beste oplossing voor de klant centraal staat.

Je kunt rekenen op:

· Premium hooroplossingen

· Ruim voldoende tijd en aandacht voor iedere klant

· Een bestaand klantenbestand vanuit de optiek

· Warme leads via onze partner Audibene

· Professionele ondersteuning en coaching vanuit de organisatie

· Ruimte voor jouw ideeën en vakmanschap

· De kans om daadwerkelijk mee te bouwen aan de audiotak

· Dagen en uren in overleg, met aandacht voor een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé

Voor wie is dit een mooie stap?

Misschien werk je nu bij een grotere keten en zoek je meer persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en betrokkenheid. Of je bent toe aan een omgeving waarin je niet alleen audicien bent, maar ook kunt meedenken over hoe we de beste hoorzorg voor onze klanten organiseren.

Ruime ervaring is voor ons niet het belangrijkste. Veel belangrijker is dat je passie hebt voor horen én voor mensen.

Je bent iemand die kwaliteit belangrijk vindt, graag persoonlijk contact heeft met klanten en energie krijgt van samen iets moois opbouwen. Je wilt onderdeel zijn van een professioneel en kundig team, maar vindt het tegelijkertijd leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor je eigen vakgebied.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Een zelfstandige functie met veel ruimte voor vakmanschap en persoonlijke aandacht, maar mét een professioneel team en organisatie achter je.

Geen omgeving waarin iedere minuut wordt gestuurd door targets en agenda’s, maar een plek waar we geloven dat tevreden klanten en goede hoorzorg de basis zijn voor duurzaam succes.

En minstens zo belangrijk: werk moet passen bij je leven. Daarom bespreken we graag samen welke dagen en uren het beste aansluiten. Of je nu een aantal dagen per week wilt werken of juist een volgende stap zoekt met meer verantwoordelijkheid: we kijken vooral naar wat bij elkaar past.

Ben jij audicien en spreekt de combinatie van kwaliteit, persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en bouwen je aan?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Ook als je nog niet jarenlang ervaring hebt, maar wel gepassioneerd bent over het vak, nodigen we je van harte uit om te reageren.

title: Adviseur Loopbaan en Mobilteit Zuid NL
description:
Als je goed zorgt voor je mensen, zorgen zij goed voor jou. Deze overtuiging van de oprichter van ADG Dienstengroep vormt de basis van Koersmakers. Koersmakers is een nieuw bedrijf dat werkt aan duurzame inzetbaarheid voor vakmensen, zodat zij maximale regie krijgen over het (werkende) leven. Om dit goed in de praktijk te brengen zijn we op zoek naar een adviseur in de regio Zuid Nederland

Omschrijving van het team 

Koersmakers is een jong, maar groeiend team van 9 collega’s. De mobiliteitsadviseurs Annemiek, Celine, Wilco, Miranda, Mariëlle, Dana en Inez, begeleiden ieder in hun eigen regio vakmensen in verschillende trajecten: van spoor 2 re-integratie tot (loopbaan)coaching en van gespreksbegeleiding tot leiderschapstrainingen. Zwaantje ondersteunt hen in de dagelijkse operatie en Sterre is kwartiermaker en eindverantwoordelijk voor Koersmakers.

Taken

Wat ga je doen? 

Als adviseur ga jij in de verschillende trajecten de verhalen, doelen en talenten van hun vakmensen naar boven halen. Op dit moment begeleid je hoofdzakelijk medewerkers in een Spoor 2 re-integratie traject. Tegelijkertijd worden we inmiddels ook steeds vaker gevraagd om vakmensen te begeleiden in (loopbaan)-coaching trajecten en bij gespreksbegeleiding. En die beweging naar preventieve dienstverlening omtrent de inzetbaarheid van vakmensen is precies de stap die ze de komende tijd samen met jou willen zetten. 

In de begeleiding van vakmensen maak je gebruik van passende (interesse)testen, waaronder de Predictive Index. Jij zet vervolgens dat wat iemand wil, drijft en kan, om naar concrete acties om de inzetbaarheid van deze vakmensen te vergroten en behouden. Hierbij houd je rekening met de actuele regels tot Wet Verbetering Poortwachter en de verzuimcyclus van het UWV. Daarnaast ondersteun je de leidinggevenden van de verschillende ADG bedrijven hoe zij samen met hen de regie van vakmensen op het (werkende) leven naar de praktijk kunnen brengen. 

Ze vinden het geen probleem als je geen tot weinig ervaring hebt met het gebruik van onze testen.

Vereisten

Wat ze wel belangrijk vinden: 

- Je hebt ervaring met het uitvoeren van Spoor 2 re-integratie trajecten.

- Je vindt het leuk om te werken aan de duurzame inzetbaarheid van hun medewerkers. Vakmensen die werk doen wat vaak niet gezien wordt, juist als het écht goed gedaan wordt. Schoonmaakmedewerkers, onderhoudsmonteurs, hospitality professionals, BOA’s en zorgmedewerkers. Zij houden Nederland draaiend. Zij doen het voor hén.

- Jij zorgt dat de uitvoering van hun dienstverlening (in geval van Spoor 2 re-integratie) voldoet aan de eisen die de verzuimcyclus en de Wet Verbetering Poortwachter stelt.

- Je legt makkelijk contact met andere mensen, ook in onbekende situaties. Je toont interesse in wie zij zijn en kunt een leidende en sturende rol goed afwisselen met een luisterende en afwachtende rol. 

- Je werkt zelfstandig, beschikt over probleemoplossend vermogen en neemt regie over de trajecten die je begeleidt. Je schakelt gemakkelijk met verschillende gesprekspartners en vertaalt doelen naar concrete stappen, ook wanneer de situatie nog niet volledig duidelijk is

- Je werkt gericht toe naar (nieuwe) mogelijkheden voor vakmensen om (weer) inzetbaar te worden en blijven. Je vertaalt doelen en mogelijkheden in concrete afspraken en houdt jezelf, medewerkers en leidinggevenden aan deze afspraken. 

- Jij blijft je, ook bij weerstand of uitdagingen, inspannen om de inzetbaarheid van vakmensen te vergroten of behouden.

- Je werkt precies en zorgvuldig en signaleert bij onvolledigheden en afwijkingen in de begeleiding of rapportages. Hierbij schroom je niet om te benoemen wat je ziet en hoort, durf je kritische vragen te stellen, altijd met het doel om tot oplossingen en mogelijkheden voor inzetbaarheid te komen en altijd met respect voor de ander.

Benefits

Dit mag jeverwachten 

- Een maandsalaris van EUR 3500 tot EUR 4500 op basis van 40 uur

- Een jaarcontract voor 24 tot 40 uur

- 27 vakantiedagen op basis van 40 uur

- Een dertiende maand!

- Opleidingsmogelijkheden, denk bijvoorbeeld aan:

o De predictive index practitioner

o Of een andere opleiding die bijdraagt aan de doelstelling van Koersmakers: regie over het (werkende) leven naar de praktijk brengen.

- Een fijne werkplek in Houten of bij een van onze ADG zusjes.

- Mogelijkheid om thuis te werken.

- De kans om echt impact te maken en mee te bouwen aan een nieuw bedrijf

Over Koersmakers 

Koersmakers is een startup van ADG. Een Twents familiebedrijf met ruim 11.000 collega’s dat groot is geworden met en dankzij hun vakmensen op de werkvloer. ADG zet zich in voor vakmensen met waardering en ondersteuning.

Bij Koersmakers geloven ze in gelijke kansen voor iedereen en in een open organisatie waar iedereen zich prettig voelt. Zij willen dan ook een diverse en inclusieve werkgever zijn. Inclusie zorgt ervoor dat werknemers, ongeacht hun achtergrond, overtuigingen, voorkeuren etc, zich gewaardeerd, gerespecteerd en betrokken voelen. Koersmakers gelooft dat dit leidt tot een creatievere en productievere werksfeer, waar innovatieve ideeën kunnen bloeien, betere besluiten worden genomen en talenten volledig tot hun recht kunnen komen.

title: Marketing & Content Intern (Haarlem)

Six restaurants. Six dishes. One afternoon, every dish with a pairing to match. An introduction to a city's food scene, and to the people shaping it.

We have been making those introductions in the Netherlands as WijnSpijs since 2013. Table6 carries the same standards into the UK and Germany.

The Netherlands is where we started and it is still the market we know best. Keeping it that way takes a steady stream of content: Dutch restaurants and creators to find and contact, footage and photography to collect and label, stories filmed on event days, posts prepared and checked after they go out. We are looking for a Marketing & Content Intern to work on all of it with us.

The briefs, templates and guidelines already exist, so you are never starting from a blank page. You will use them from week one and take on more of the work yourself as you go. Most of what you do will be in Dutch.

- Come to selected events, including some Sundays, and film dishes, pairings, guest moments and the walk between restaurants to a short brief.

- Upload, name and label everything in Notion and Google Drive, so an editor can find it without asking you.

- Watch what our restaurant partners post, respond where it makes sense, and flag anything the marketing team should see.

- Prepare approved posts for scheduling, with captions, tags, links and locations, and check afterwards that they went out properly.

In your first weeks you and your Marketing Lead agree what you want out of the internship and what you will own by the end of it.

Requirements

- Fluent Dutch and strong English, written and spoken.

- Enrolled in a relevant study, and available full time for at least four months.

- Organised and accurate, with several requests and deadlines running at once.

- Comfortable writing to restaurants and creators yourself, and confident enough to ask when something falls outside the guidelines.

- At home on social platforms, and comfortable with Google Drive and simple spreadsheets.

- Available for selected Sunday events. They are always planned in advance.

Nice to have, not essential 

- Filming or editing for social; Canva, Notion or Meta Business Suite.

- Experience in a customer-facing job in hospitality or retail.

Benefits

title: Production Planner
description:
At Harvey Performance Company, we're more than a team; we're a community. Our thriving, dynamic, and rapidly expanding organization values community, celebrates success, and fosters personal and professional growth opportunities.

Taken

The opportunity 
Harvey Performance Company manufactures consumable precision cutting tools for industrial customers. We are seeking an experienced Production Planner to own production scheduling and material planning across our manufacturing operations.

This role is responsible for translating demand forecasts and customer orders into achievable production schedules, ensuring material and capacity availability through disciplined use of SAP/Epicor ERP and Material Requirements Planning (MRP), and driving on-time delivery in a fast-paced, high-volume parts production environment

In this role, you will be responsible for 

- Develop, publish, and maintain detailed production schedules across manufacturing cells/lines to meet customer demand, on-time delivery targets, and inventory objectives.

- Own and execute Material Requirements Planning (MRP) within SAP/Epicor ERP, reviewing planned orders, exception messages, and net requirements to ensure timely material availability.

- Maintain accuracy of SAP planning master data, including planning parameters, lead times, lot sizes, safety stock levels, BOMs, routings, etc.

- Balance production capacity against demand forecasts and customer orders, adjusting schedules for a high-volume, high-mix precision manufacturing environment.

- Partner with Purchasing/Supply Chain to resolve material shortages, expedite critical components, and manage supplier lead times.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering and Customer Service/Sales to resolve scheduling conflicts and support new product introductions.

- Monitor work-in-process (WIP), backlog, and finished goods inventory; identify and drive inventory optimization opportunities.

- Participate in and support the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, providing planning input and capacity analysis.

- Track and report key planning KPIs (on-time delivery, schedule adherence, machine/labor utilization, inventory turns) to operations leadership.

- Identify, recommend, and implement continuous improvement initiatives to planning processes, systems, and data integrity (Lean/Six Sigma principles).

- Support daily production meetings and escalating schedule risks proactively.

Vereisten

You’ll bring: 

- Minimum 5 years of production planning/scheduling experience in a high-volume parts manufacturing environment (required).

- Demonstrated hands-on experience with SAP ERP (PP and MM modules) and Epicor for production planning and material management (required).

- Highly competent in Material Requirements Planning (MRP) concepts, execution, and troubleshooting (required).

- Experience in precision manufacturing, cutting tools, metalworking, or a related consumable parts industry is strongly preferred.

- Strong analytical and Excel/data analysis skills; comfortable working with large datasets and planning reports.

- Excellent communication, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Proven ability to manage competing priorities and make sound decisions in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

- Qualification in supply chain management, Business, Industrial Engineering and advantage or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

- Advanced knowledge of MRP logic, demand planning, and capacity planning principles.

- Strong problem-solving skills with a data-driven, root-cause approach.

- Ability to read and interpret BOMs, routings, and production schedules.

- Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies.

- High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

Benefits

What Harvey provides: 
Do you want to get the very best out of yourself? So do we! That’s why, in addition to great colleagues and a cutting-edge high-tech environment, we offer

- a competitive, market-based salary of €55.000,- to €65.000,-

- a high degree of independence, responsibility, and opportunities to learn

- an in-house fitness center

- 26 vacation days

- several fun company outings and parties each year

- Occasional travel to other group/ divisional manufacturing sites

title: Business Developer B2B & Retail
description:
Bij de meeste salesbanen stopt je werk bij de afspraak. Bij MarketLeap begint het daar pas.

Ik ben Luc, mede-oprichter van MarketLeap. Wij zijn het externe salesteam van online gepositioneerde merken met een fysiek product. Onze klanten verkopen o.a. stoomreinigers, elektrische scooters, spark machines, pilates-reformers, stoelviltdoppen en autopoetsmiddelen. Wij zorgen dat die producten bij grote retailketens, groothandels en distributeurs terechtkomen, zowel nationaal als internationaal. Niet met alleen een lijst aan leads of een ingeplande afspraak, maar met een getekende deal en een product in het schap.

Onze merken vind je terug bij de Makro, Coolblue, Albert Heijn, Decathlon, Praxis, Karwei, Bouwmaat, Welkoop, Intratuin, MediaMarkt, Intersport, Sport2000, en we zitten aan tafel met grote internationale distribiteurs. Dat zijn dus niet alleen logo's op onze site, dat zijn concrete deals die ons team heeft gerealiseerd. We bestaan sinds 2023, hebben ruim 140 klanttrajecten gedraaid en zijn winstgevend. We zoeken per direct versterking van één a twee business developers voor ons team van zes business developers en twee founders in Utrecht.

Taken

Je bent de business developer van vijf tot zes merken tegelijk. Voor elk merk maak je een projectplan met heldere targets, zoek je de juiste afnemers, vindt je de beslissers, belt, mailt, plant de afspraak, voert het gesprek, maakt het voorstel en onderhandelt tot de handtekening. Daarna blijf jij het aanspreekpunt, want de herhaalorders zijn waar het geld zit, voor de klant en voor jou.

Zo ziet dit er in de praktijk uit. Zelf heb ik voor een van ons klanten een stoomreiniger bij Makro in het assortiment geplaatst, en de tweede,derde en vierde bestelling volgde. Een collega bouwde bij Decathlon een relatie op waar de orders sindsdien blijven doorlopen. In de eerste 30 dagen zorgde dit al voor tienduizenden euro's extra omzet voor onze klant.

Elke week bel je zo'n 80 tot 100 keer, ongeveer twee uur per dag. De rest van je tijd gaat naar het uitdenken van de strategie, klant management, voeren van warme gesprekken, voorstellen uitwerken, op afspraak gaan en het bijhouden van je pijplijn. Elke maandag stuur je de ondernemer achter het merk je weekplan en elke vrijdag je evaluatie. Het repeterende werk, zoals leadlijsten bouwen, research op een keten en de eerste opzet van een pitchdeck, hebben we in Claude Cowork geautomatiseerd met eigen skills. Jij werkt met HubSpot, Aircall, Apollo, Lusha, Notion en Claude, zodat je tijd gaat naar het voeren van gesprekken en closen van deals.

Hoe je start: 

In je eerste maand krijg je één of twee eigen klanten. We doen niet aan een meeloopperiode van een kwartaal. Vanaf dag één heb je direct een klant waar jij verantwoordelijk voor bent. Zo leer je accountmanagement, sales en relatiebeheer op de enige manier die werkt, door het te doen. Je doet dat niet alleen. Week 1 zit je in het inwerkprogramma. Hierin neem je onze SOP's door, leer je de systemen kennen en kijk je mee bij een collega op een lopende deal. Daarna heb je een ervaren buddy die je eerste mails valideert en na je eerste gesprekken met je terugkijkt. Wekelijks krijg je salestraining en heb je een 1-op-1 met mij. Dagelijks kun je bij mij en de buddy terecht.

Vereisten

- 2 tot 5 jaar werkervaring in een commerciële rol. 

- Je hebt al deals geclosed en kunt dit aantonen. Je hebt ook geleerd waarom een deal niet doorging en wist dit vervolgens snel te implementeren. 

- Je woont binnen een uur van Utrecht en bent drie dagen per week op kantoor.

- Rijbewijs en een eigen auto zijn een must. Je gaat naar onze klanten en potentiële afnemers toe.

- Vloeiend Nederlands, in spraak en op papier.

- 40 uur per week beschikbaar, in loondienst. 

- Je neemt eigenaarschap over je pijplijn en je resultaten. Je krijgt energie van targets, deals en een product dat door jou uiteindelijk in het schap terug te vinden is.

Benefits

- Basissalaris 3.200 tot 3.700 euro per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring.

- De helft van de commissie die wij factureren over deals die jij sluit. Ook over elke herhaalorder, twee tot drie jaar lang. Geen plafond.

- Extra bonussen bij grote wins.

- Kilometervergoeding van €0,23,-per kilometer.

- 25 vakantiedagen

- Interne salestraining en dagelijks aan het werk met de nieuwste AI-tooling, ingericht voor dit werk.

- Een hecht team van zes business developers en twee founders, 28 lopende klant trajecten, winstgevend en groeiend.

- Hybride: drie dagen kantoor in Utrecht, twee dagen thuis.

- Regelmatige leuke teamuitjes en sportieve activiteiten zoals padel.

Herken je jezelf hierin? Stuur je CV en drie regels over een deal waar je het meest trots op bent. Binnen twee werkdagen hoor je van mij. Daarna plannen we een belafspraak in van 20 a 30 minuten, gevolgd door een gesprek op kantoor in Utrecht met mij en een van de business developers. Bij een match vanuit beide kanten ontvang je een concreet aanbod. Van sollicitatie tot handtekening duurt zo'n twee weken en eventueel sneller als het kan.

Luc Broos, mede-oprichter MarketLeap

Je krijgt ruimte om je stage mede vorm te geven. Samen kijken we welke opdrachten passen bij jouw opleiding, talenten en onze organisatie.

title: Engineering Manager - Feegow (100% Remote within Brazil)
description:
Welcome to the good side of tech 

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner . The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group .

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

Where does Feegow fit here? 

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale 

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 80 million patients trust us every month. 130.000 specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management, and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

And why should you join us? 

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote-friendly (you will work 100% from home, but you will also be welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro).

Job Description 

Role 

As an Engineering Manager in this group, you’ll be fully responsible and accountable for managing your team(s), ensuring predictable, high-quality delivery with high operational standards. You’ll also actively partner with your Product counterparts and Staff Engineers to shape the direction of our area and the company as a whole. You will lead the Fintech team responsible for domains like clinic payments, invoices, financial reports, health insurance integrations and others. The role reports directly to the Engineering Director.

We are committed to continuous improvement, open feedback, and working efficiently towards our goals. This role provides an opportunity to influence the strategic direction of the area while receiving mentorship and support as needed.

While expertise in specific technologies isn’t required, this is a technical role, and a solid technical background is essential to effectively support the teams.

What you will be doing 

- 
Manage, coach, and develop team members through regular feedback and performance assessments.

- 
Define and manage the technical vision and strategy for your area.

- 
Ensure accountability for all team initiatives.

- 
Serve as a point of reference for the Leadership team and key stakeholders.

Qualifications 

You’re likely a great fit for this role if you 

- 
Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.

- 
Strong technical background across the SDLC, with the ability to support and unblock your teams in complex technical discussions.

- 
Experience modernizing legacy systems into modern architectures, as well as leading teams’ ways of working.

- 
A lean, proactive, and positive approach to software development, balancing impact with long-term, sustainable development, and taking strong accountability for delivering high-quality solutions.

- 
Embrace the “you build it, you run it” philosophy.

- 
Believe in continuous learning and improvement.

- 
Experience not only mentoring others, but also developing future mentors and leaders.

- 
Previous experience in fintech is a plus.

Important: Docplanner is an international English-first company. Therefore, please be sure to send your CV in English

Let’s talk money 

- 
A salary adequate to your experience. The range is broad so that we can accommodate our roles for all levels of experience, but we will show you the career ladder to explain where we see your skills and impact within the company". Your salary will be, now and always, 100% transparent to you;

- 
We offer a Meal Voucher worth R$800,00 a month, but if you enjoy cooking at home, you can replace it with a Food Voucher, for the same amount, or do half and half, making life easier for those who are 100% remote or hybrid.

- 
For the commute to the office, we offer transportation vouchers.

- 
We have a robust Partnerships Club, with agreements and discounts ranging from educational institutions. such as colleges and languages, to exclusive banking benefits.

- 
Share options plan after 6 months of working with us.

- 
Did you like working here? Then refer a friend or relative! We love having family and friends around! Our New Warrior Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months.

True flexibility and work-life balance 

- 
Remote or hybrid work model with our hub in.

- 
Our working hours are Monday through Friday, from 9am to 6pm.

- 
Need to work beyond your usual hours? We have a time bank so that you can use those hours as time off later.

- 
Additional paid holiday on your birthday and work anniversary.

- 
Our special leave policies are different here: if you’ve lost a loved one, we offer 10 days off; if you lose your PET, you have 2 days. Are you getting married? 7 days of rest! The baby’s here? We offer 1-month of paternity leave and 6 months of maternity leave.

Health comes first 

- 
Medical and Dental Assistance along with Group Life Insurance.

- 
We have a robust Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services, all the way to exclusive banking benefits.

- 
Access to the iFeel app, for emotional comfort, which combines traditional psychology with AI, helping you through those tough days.

- 
ApoioPass offers free professional support and guidance in the psychological, legal, economic, and social areas, providing support in those more delicate issues.

- 
A Gympass for you and 3 other people! Because working out alone is very boring, isn't it?

- 
Did you think your PET would be left out? Of course not! We offer a Pet Plan extending the care to your pet as well.

- 
Credits: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Product Engineering - UK
description:
Hi I’m Abhik , Ashby 's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. We’re looking for an ambitious full-stack engineer who is laser-focused on solving customer problems and making the right long-term investments to solve them not only today but in our future features and products.

What Ashby gives you in return is the best of both early and growth-stage environments. The agency and no-nonsense of a seed startup: you write product specs, make product and design decisions, and build in an almost-no-meeting culture. While also the product-market fit and scale of a growth-stage startup: tens of thousands of daily users who depend on your software and eagerly await your next feature.

We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet.

You’ve probably seen this role posted before, and it’s because we’re always expanding the team (we’re on track to double this year). We’re bubbling with ideas on how to support Talent Acquisition through software, and we’ve started the journey of building products beyond Talent Acquisition. We read every application and aim to respond to yours within 3-4 days (often sooner).

About the Role and How We Work

Our engineering culture strives to recreate the environments where we did our best work as ICs – where we had the ownership and agency to impact our users with creative and innovative software.

I started my career building software for artists in the Visual Effects industry. It was a formative experience for me as a software engineer because success relied on my ability to be a product manager and designer. I talked to artists to understand their needs. I came up with ideas. I did industry research, designed interfaces, and prototyped ideas. I watched artists use what I built and decided what to tackle in the next iteration. No daily stand-ups, no t-shirt sizing, no planning meetings.

I studied computer science to solve problems, not tickets, and this felt exactly like that. I not only felt creative and fulfilled but the agency and ownership we were given as engineers powered an incredible amount of innovation.

Innovation came differently (or not at all) at technology startups beyond the seed stage, often through an engineer’s force of will and ability to push back against culture (rather than any encouragement from it). Engineering was narrowed to implementation and delivery, partly due to the influence of other departments and partly due to the influx of "Agile" processes like sprint planning. In those companies, I felt like a JIRA jockey. 

At Ashby, we’re building an environment that is optimistic about what engineers can own and achieve. An environment that embraces innovative engineers, and, frankly, often stays out of their way. As a Product Engineer, you’ll take ownership over a large portion of one of our products and own projects end-to-end (wearing hats traditionally worn by product and design). You’ll research competitors, write product specs, make wireframes, and more. To ground it with examples, product engineers at Ashby have:

- 
Designed and built automated interview scheduling. This feature automates scheduling by calculating possible times from a pool of interviewers and other constraints, and then presenting these times to the candidate for selection via our responsive web app. This solves the “Calendar Tetris” problem I talk about in "What We're Building."

- 
Built a generalized declarative filter architecture that allows users to create complex filters for any record with a consistent UI and compile it to SQL in our backend. Many user-facing features use it.

- 
Specced, designed, and implemented a feature that allows users to complete signing offers entirely within Ashby. This project involved talking to customers to understand their requirements, deciding what technologies to use, building a prototype, and working with other team members to integrate the final implementation into additional features.

What We’re Building

As engineers, we are used to tooling that makes us better at what we do. When we started Ashby, we saw the opposite with Talent Acquisition software. Recruiting teams were leveling up how they did their work, but instead of software meeting this new standard, it held them back.

Scheduling a final round is an excellent example. Recruiting teams wanted to schedule candidates faster, track interviewer preparation and quality, and do it with half the headcount. A recruiter needed to manually collect availability from the candidate, identify qualified interviewers, perform “Calendar Tetris” to find who is available to interview the candidate, schedule on the earliest date possible, and make any last-minute adjustments as availability changed. They must do this while considering the interview load on each individual and whether interviewers need to be trained and shadowing others. TA software didn’t help.

As hiring managers, we know TA is a critical function, and as engineers, we know software can do better. So, we built and continue to build Ashby to give TA teams the highest standard of tooling. Software that’s intelligent and powerful. Software that provides insights into where they’re failing and automates or simplifies many of the tasks they’re underwater with. We want other functions and departments to be jealous of what TA teams can do with Ashby, and today they often are!

Why You Should or Shouldn’t Apply

Software engineers come in many flavors, not all of which fit our model. Here are some things to help you decide if this fits you and what you’re looking for:

- 
You’re not afraid to tackle any part of a technology stack. You do what’s necessary to successfully deliver a feature, whether writing frontend or choosing new infrastructure. We’ll provide a supportive environment to do it successfully (e.g., design system, SRE team).

- 
You’ve tackled projects with a lot of product and technical ambiguity, and you thrive at the intersection of the two. We’re not building a simple CRUD app, and many of the challenges we tackle require you to use your knowledge of our customers to build powerful abstractions and flexibility in the system to solve a class of problems.

- 
You know how to strike the right balance between speed and quality. Ashby wasn’t built quickly. We took four years to launch publicly because convincing customers to switch required a high-quality product. However, time isn’t infinite, especially for a startup, so we still move with urgency—we’ve built the equivalent of three or more VC-backed startups with a very small team.

- 
You are ambitious and always looking to improve your skills. For most engineers, this role will give you more freedom and responsibilities than you’ve experienced in the past. To thrive (and level up), you’ll need to be open to feedback (and we give lots of it).

- 
You’re an excellent collaborator and communicator. Ownership and freedom don’t mean you work in a vacuum. You’ll need to vet your decisions with the appropriate stakeholders, keep them up to date when necessary, and work with other engineers to get your projects across the finish line. Clear and concise communication helps a lot here!

- 
You seek to create leverage in your work. The nature of software is that you can often automate or abstract what would be tedious, time-consuming work. Your impatience usually leads to new abstractions, tools to allow Support to debug before Engineering, new lint rules to prevent common bugs, etc. 

Put another way, you shouldn’t apply if: 

- 
You need company-driven process and structure to get your projects across the finish line. Sprint planning and well-defined project management processes are things you need or look to others to lead. You’d rather focus on the technical details and challenges.

- 
You only want to do exciting work. We’re building a team of kind, collaborative folks. Customer issues and investigations are distributed across the team, including our high-level ICs.

- 
You can get lost in the details. Once you start implementation, it can be hard to take a step back and think about the project as a whole. You like everything to be planned upfront.

- 
You haven’t led or taken ownership of projects before. You’re used to working with tech leads and taking on tasks distributed by them.

- 
You want to mentor earlier-career engineers. We rely on engineers owning their projects, so we need engineers with that experience. This requires the team to be reasonably tenured. More than 90% of the team would be considered Senior or above in the industry today, so mentorship opportunities are very limited.

- 
To you, a tech lead, staff, or principal engineer is someone who spends most of their time project managing or doing architecture reviews. Our most tenured engineers spend most of their time building, and we often trust them with our most challenging problems. While they lead product and technical areas and help other engineers plan their most challenging work, it’s not a requirement, nor do engineers need their sign-off.

Engineering Culture

Our engineering culture is motivated by Benji’s (my Co-founder and CEO) and my belief that a small, talented team, given the right environment, can build high-quality software fast (and work regular hours!). We do it through:

- 
Minimal process with ownership over decisions normally made by product and design

- 
Natural collaboration and deliberate communication

- 
Investing in tools and abstractions that give us leverage

- 
Putting effort into building a diverse team

Minimal Process & Lots of Ownership 

The best engineers we’ve worked with delivered reliably magical outcomes. They took customer problems and relentlessly drove them to solutions that were not only successful but often brilliant and creative. While they did this with minimal oversight, stakeholders were never in the dark as to what was going on, and no setback was a surprise.

Traditional product-development processes aren’t meant for the best engineers. Their purpose is to create consistent outcomes regardless of the engineer’s skill. But, consistency comes at the expense of an engineer’s time and freedom—both ingredients necessary to generate those magical outcomes. As a result, process stifles the best engineers and doesn’t give others the opportunity to practice the behaviors that made the best engineers the “best.”

At Ashby, we want to build an environment that encourages every engineer to be their best. So, at Ashby, every Engineer runs their project. Product Managers (and Designers) build strategy, do customer research, and hand off problem briefs to Engineers. Engineers take on the rest: they research the problem, write product specs, build wireframes, and implement their solution end-to-end. We rely on engineers, not process, to push information outward to the relevant folks (e.g., Product Managers) and pull folks in to help (e.g., Designers, Infra). It’s a new level of ownership for many engineers, but we’d rather an engineer fail a bit and coach up their skills than use process as a crutch. Not everyone succeeds in our culture, but those who do thrive .

Collaboration is Natural & Communication is Deliberate 

Our engineering team consists of lifelong learners who are talented but also humble and kind (meet them here !). These attributes create an environment where collaboration happens naturally. We combine this with research, prototyping, and written proposals to see around corners and get feedback from the team across time zones. Focus time is something that we hold sacred, and, with thoughtful and deliberate communication, engineers are in here ).

To drive it home, here's a recent calendar of an engineer who has been with us for over 4 years. ~34 hours of focus time, 2.5h of interviews, and 3.5 hou

title: Ads Quality Rater - Catalan (Spain)
description:
Welo Data is an award-winning localization and data transformation company. We run one of the world’s largest Ads Rating Programs and we want you to join! 

As an Ads Quality Rater , you will review and grade internet advertisements to help shape how ads are delivered to the end users. In other words, you’ll tell the AI program how good or bad its advertisement suggestions are based on the user’s keywords.

You will review ads in both English and Catalan 

This role is great for people who: 

- Surf the internet daily 

- Use major search engines frequently 

- Know what people want based on a few keywords 

- Enjoy researching topics online

- Want a flexible and fun side job

Project Details 

Job Title: Ads Quality Rater Catalan (Spain) 

Pay Rate: Based on tasks (approximately $10.9 per hour)

Location: Remote/work from home - must be based in Spain

Hours: Set your schedule based on the following – Minimum commitment is 5 hours per week. You can choose to work up to 20 hours per week.

Start Date: ASAP

Employment Type: Independent Contractor/Freelance/Self-Employed 

Project Duration: Long-term

Note: 

- Even though the position is WFH, you must reside in the country that is noted in this description. This will be automatically checked during the hiring process. 

Recruitment Process
